title: Branch Manager - GL - Bhavnagar
description:
Designation: Branch Manager


Location: India Gujarat Vasundhra Complex, Gujarat


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**1****) Job Purpose:** *Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)* **(Max 1325 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================

  

The Branch Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving branch\-level business performance, ensuring compliance, delivering superior customer experience, and maintaining portfolio quality. The role leads the frontline team to achieve disbursement, new customer acquisition, yield, audit, collections, and risk KPIs while upholding operational governance. **2\) Dimensions****:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.*  

**New Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Build strong relationships with local customers, partners, authorities, and community influencers to drive branch customer acquisition. **Managing Existing Relationship**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Lead and supervise branch staff including ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE; ensure productivity and performance management **Structuring new Transactions**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure accurate gold valuation, loan structuring within LTV norms, and proper documentation for all new and renewal transactions **Compliance of regulatory guidelines**  

 (Max 254 Characters)

  

Ensure strict adherence to RBI norms, internal policies, risk processes, purity testing, and audit standards. **Portfolio monitoring**

  

Monitor delinquencies, yield, tonnage, auction ratios, spurious/bentex cases, and branch growth metric**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges****:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section **(Max 3975 Characters)**
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity
**4\)** **Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For most jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)\- **Maximum 10 KRAs can be updated**
===========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)** **Business Growth \& Acquisition*** Achieve targets for new CUID creation.
* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5****) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
====================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.
**6\) Relationships:** Describe the nature and purpose of most important contacts or relationship (except superior/team members) with individuals, departments, organizations inside and outside of the organization, that job is required to interact with to deliver the job objectives

**Nature (Max 1325 Characters)**

title: Lead Workday Specialist
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

  

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

  

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector\-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.  



  

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

  

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

  

Wood Mackenzie  

Intelligence Connected

 **WoodMac.com**

 **Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**Role Purpose:**


With broad directions and plans and working with the Senior Manager – Digital HR, support the Workday application within Wood Mackenzie to include, incident management, delivery of enhancements and small projects and participation in the delivery of larger projects. You will work with key stakeholders to understand business requirements, define scope and understand dependencies, allowing you to ensure stability, reliability and data security on the existing Workday platform whilst supporting a continually evolving and growing business through ensuring successful and timely delivery on requirements for enhancements and projects.

**Main Responsibilities:**

* Work to resolve any issues and requests from users relating to the Workday platform working with 3rd party support providers and Workday when required
* Help manage requests for day\-to\-day data maintenance to include but not limited to user access and security, master data values, complex organisational changes
* Work towards becoming a Wood Mackenzie solutions expert on the Workday platform understanding all key components and reliance and integration on other systems
* Contribute to a rolling release program of enhancements and reporting requests as prioritised by the Senior Manager – Digital HR and Business Solutions Governance Board
* Work within the Workday team to understand the application roadmap including the content of the periodic releases and how any changes will impact existing processes, support communication of these impacts to the key stakeholders
* Support testing and regression testing of changes, periodic updates and integrations within the HR systems area
* Support the business to write requirements documents and translate them into functional design documents for complex enhancements and interfaces
* Ensure all process and knowledge share information and tools are kept up to date as the business and processes evolve.
* Support internal and external audit activities as required and ensure that the controls supporting the Workday solution within Wood Mackenzie reflects the governance standards required
* Ensure data privacy remains at the core of everything we do on the platform

**About You:**

* An experienced HR systems support professional with a passion and a genuine interest for Workday HR cloud technologies and products developed over 5\+ years
* Experienced in supporting and configuring Workday HCM, Compensation, Recruiting and Talent Optimisation for a global organisation.
* Experience of working in a business applications environment using Workday technology
* Ability to understand complex business process flows and the data dependencies within them
* Experienced in communicating with HR business stakeholders
* Experience as a HR professional preferred
* Workday Pro or Certification desirable

**Expectations:**

* We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be expected to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment, but this may be subject to change in the future.
* While this is expected to be a full\-time role, part\-time arrangements will be considered.
* Due to the global nature of the team, a degree of flexible working will be required to accommodate different time zones being worked within our team and our wider business.


\#LI\-DB1

 **Equal Opportunities**

  

We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

title: HR Executive
description:
HR Executive

Company: Dr Sachin Mittal Advanced DentistryLocation: Hisar, HaryanaJob Type: Full\-time

About the Clinic

Dr Sachin Mittal Advanced Dentistry is a NABH\-accredited, state\-of\-the\-art dental clinic in Hisar, with a strong focus on advanced dentistry, dental implants, cosmetic dentistry, and digital dentistry.

We are looking for a proactive and responsible HR Executive to manage our growing team and establish strong HR systems and processes.

Job Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for doctors, dentists, dental assistants, front\-office staff, telecallers, housekeeping, and other clinic positions.
* Prepare job descriptions and post vacancies on Indeed and other recruitment platforms.
* Screen CVs, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate final interviews with management.
* Manage employee joining, onboarding, induction, and exit formalities.
* Maintain employee files, HR records, attendance, leave, and salary\-related information.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with the accounts department.
* Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, discipline, and workplace behaviour.
* Coordinate employee performance reviews and appraisals.
* Identify training requirements and organise staff training programs.
* Develop and implement HR policies, rules, and SOPs.
* Handle employee grievances and resolve routine HR issues professionally.
* Promote teamwork, professionalism, accountability, and a patient\-centric work culture.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and clinic information.
* Support NABH\-related HR documentation, training records, and compliance requirements.
* Prepare regular HR reports for management.
* Take responsibility for day\-to\-day HR and administrative activities.

Skills Required

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong recruitment and employee\-management skills.
* Good knowledge of HR processes and documentation.
* Good command of MS Office / Google Workspace.
* Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
* Good problem\-solving and conflict\-management skills.
* Professional, mature, and disciplined approach.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.

Qualifications

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources preferred.
* Graduate candidates with relevant HR experience may also apply.
* Experience in a hospital, dental clinic, healthcare, or service organisation will be an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be people\-oriented but firm on discipline, organised, proactive, and comfortable managing a diverse healthcare team. Experience in managing recruitment and HR operations for a growing organisation will be highly valued.

What We Offer

* Professional and growth\-oriented working environment.
* Opportunity to work with a leading advanced dental healthcare organisation.
* Exposure to structured HR and NABH\-oriented systems.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Competitive salary based on experience and capability.

To Apply: Submit your updated CV through Indeed. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Total Rewards Specialist - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**
### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  

### **About the role:**



JumpCloud’s Total Rewards team is looking for a detail\-oriented team player to help support the day\-to\-day administration, analysis, and compliance of our global compensation and benefits programs, focusing on benefits administration across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas and foundational compensation analysis. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on accuracy, enjoys digging into data, and wants to build a career in Total Rewards.You'll partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, and external vendors while supporting our global benefits programs, compensation cycles, audits, and reporting.


### **What you’ll be doing:**


**1\. Core Benefits Administration \& Lifecycle Support**


* **Enrollments \& Status Changes:** Coordinate and execute end\-to\-end processing of benefit enrollments and status changes across US and international platforms.
* **Onboarding \& Communications:** Generate and distribute benefit enrollment documentation; follow up with new hires to ensure timely registration within mandated windows.
* **Leave of Absence Support:** Assist with administrative tracking and compliance tasks for medical, parental, and maternity leaves.
* **Offboarding \& Terminations:** Manage the benefit termination process across carrier portals and ensure exiting employees receive accurate and timely insurance continuation notices.

**2\. Compensation Analysis \& Support**


* **Market Benchmarking \& Analysis:** Conduct basic compensation analysis, including market benchmarking, pay equity checks, and salary range comparisons.
* **Annual Cycle Support:** Support annual merit, bonus, and equity cycles, including data preparation, validation, and system loading.
* **Job Architecture Maintenance:** Assist with job leveling and job architecture maintenance.
* **Compensation Structure Control:** Help maintain compensation structures (salary bands/ranges) and keep documentation current

**3\. Financial Operations, Billing \& Reconciliations**


* **Invoice Support:** Prepare accurate self\-billing schedules. Retrieve, format, and forward approved premium invoices to the Accounts Payable team while maintaining meticulous compliance records. Partner with Payroll and insurance carriers to research and resolve any billing discrepancies.
* **Payroll Deductions:** Calculate benefit premium adjustments and coordinate directly with regional Payroll teams to execute accurate monthly deductions and contributions.

**4\. Seasonal Programs \& Project Support**


* **Benefits Enrollment \& Renewals:** Deliver comprehensive support during annual enrollment and renewal periods. Compile and organize multi\-country census datasets, clear background system errors, and assist with back\-end setup configurations.
* **Documentation \& Implementation Support:** Coordinate, track, and assist with the completion of insurance carrier paperwork, applications, and implementation forms.
* **Employee Communications:** Help draft, edit, and localize employee\-facing resources and communication materials. Assist in scheduling and supporting informational benefits webinars.
* **Knowledge Management:** Continually update and maintain Total Rewards documentation, process guides, FAQ’s, and employee intranet sites to guarantee accuracy.
* **Special Projects Support:** Support the team with special projects, including system implementations, program redesigns, and vendor evaluations

**5\. Compliance, Auditing \& Data Analysis**


* **Data Integrity Auditing:** Perform structured benefits and compensation data validation audits across HRIS and vendor platforms.
* **Cross\-Functional Reporting:** Pull, validate, and format recurring and ad hoc compensation and benefits reports for HR, Finance, and leadership.
* **Compliance:** Support compliance reporting requirements (e.g., pay transparency, benefits compliance reporting and filings) as needed.
* **Retirement and Savings Plan Support:** Process global pension and 401(k) contribution updates and adjustments for payroll processing; assist with Savings Funds and other global financial products.

**6\. Employee Experience, Wellness \& Shared Services**


* **Employee Support:** Assist in responding to day\-to\-day employee benefits inquiries, resolving carrier access issues, and coordinating claims escalations with brokers.
* **Wellness Programs:** Contribute to and collaborate on company\-wide wellness campaigns and health initiatives.
* **Global Resources:** Research, assemble, and update annual international paid holiday calendars across regions (Americas, APAC, EMEA).

**7\. General Total Rewards Support**


* **Ad Hoc Analytical Support:** Provide general administrative and analytical support across the Total Rewards function as priorities evolve.
### **We're looking for:**


* **Experience:** 1–2 years of experience in compensation, benefits, or a related HR function.
* **Availability:** Ability and willingness to be available for calls in the evenings 2\-3 days per week, in order to align with US/Mexico team members.
* **Compensation Fundamentals:** Working knowledge of compensation fundamentals (base pay, bonus, market pricing, pay equity concepts).
* **Learning Mindset:** Prior exposure to benefits or an eagerness and ability to quickly master varied global statutory frameworks.
* **Analytical Toolkit:** Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data sorting) to confidently manipulate census data, execute audits, and reconcile invoices.
* **Systems \& Platforms:** Exposure to modern HRIS platforms (ADP preferred). Meticulous document control habits using platforms like Egnyte and DocuSign.
* **Core Traits:** High attention to numeric accuracy, absolute discretion regarding sensitive PII/PHI data, and strong communication skills.
###### **\#LI\-YM1**

  

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**
**Language:**JumpCloud® has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

title: HR Manager
description:
The role
   

  

 The company goes from a handful of people to a full team inside three months, on fixed joining dates that do not move. You own that landing cleanly: contracts, onboarding, statutory registration, and the recruiters and payroll bureau who work alongside you. Week one has to be useful, not administrative.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Own hiring across every function and hold the joining rail on its dates
* Design employment contracts for every kind of seat, from engineers to field staff
* Build onboarding so that a new joiner is productive in their first week, not orientating
* Own provident fund, insurance and statutory registration and filings
* Manage the payroll bureau and the external recruiters without losing control of quality
* Own the confirmation and performance process, and keep it honest and timely
* Track headcount and hiring risk, and raise a gap well before it becomes one


 Eligibility
   

  

* Five to eight years in human resources with hands\-on recruitment ownership
* You have scaled a team quickly and kept the bar
* Solid grounding in Indian labour law and statutory compliance
* Comfortable managing external recruiters and a payroll provider
* Fluent Tamil and English


 What you get
   

  

* The people function of a company at its founding moment
* Direct influence on hiring pace and policy, with the Founder listening


 How the process runs
   

  

* Fill in the short form on this page.
* We read it ourselves. Every application is read.
* If we want to meet you, we call you.

title: HR, Accounts & Tender Compliance Executive
description:
We are an IT services company specializing in mobile application development, web application development, software solutions, and related technology services. We are seeking an experienced HR, Accounts \& Tender Compliance Executive to manage HR operations, corporate accounts, statutory compliance, and documentation for government tenders.

Hands\-on experience with **Zoho Books** and **Zoho People** is **mandatory**.

**Key Responsibilities HR \& Employee Compliance**

* Manage recruitment coordination, onboarding, employee records, attendance, leave, payroll inputs, appraisals, and exit formalities.
* Maintain employment agreements, HR policies, employee files, statutory registers, and confidential records.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour and employment laws, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, and leave\-related requirements, as applicable.
* Manage employee attendance, leave, workflows, and records through Zoho People.
* Coordinate payroll information, reimbursements, deductions, employee benefits, and statutory filings with internal and external teams.
* Address employee queries professionally and support a positive workplace culture.

**Accounts \& Statutory Compliance**

* Manage daily bookkeeping, invoices, quotations, vendor bills, expenses, receivables, payables, and bank reconciliations in Zoho Books.
* Maintain accurate ledgers, supporting documents, purchase records, sales records, and expense vouchers.
* Assist with GST invoicing, GST returns, TDS deductions/returns, payroll compliance, and other applicable financial documentation.
* Prepare monthly MIS reports, cash\-flow reports, outstanding payment reports, expense summaries, and basic profitability reports.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors, banks, vendors, and other external consultants.
* Ensure accounts and documentation are audit\-ready and maintained in accordance with applicable corporate and tax requirements.

**Government Tender \& Company Documentation**

* Support participation in government and PSU tenders by preparing, organizing, and submitting required company documents.
* Maintain updated tender documents, including company profile, GST registration, PAN, MSME/Udyam registration, certificates, financial statements, experience certificates, work orders, and declarations.
* Track tender submission deadlines, EMD/security deposit requirements, bid documentation, corrigenda, and tender\-related correspondence.
* Coordinate with management, technical teams, and finance teams to collect accurate technical, commercial, and compliance documents.
* Maintain records of submitted tenders, awarded projects, purchase orders, agreements, and performance\-related documents.
* Support compliance documentation relevant to IT services contracts, vendor registrations, and government procurement requirements.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in HR, accounts, compliance, or administration.
* Mandatory practical experience with **Zoho Books** and **Zoho People**.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour laws, employer/employee compliance, payroll processes, GST, TDS, and routine accounting practices.
* Experience handling documentation for government tenders, GeM, e\-procurement portals, or PSU tenders is highly preferred.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Excellent documentation, filing, coordination, and follow\-up skills.
* High level of integrity, accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced IT services environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in an IT/software services company.
* Familiarity with GeM, CPPP/eProcure, state tender portals, or vendor registration processes.
* Knowledge of Companies Act\-related filings and coordination with CA/CS professionals.
* Experience with Zoho Payroll, Zoho Expense, or Zoho CRM.
* Knowledge of MSME, Startup India, ISO, and other business compliance documentation.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* HR \& Accounts: 2 years (Preferred)

title: Junior IT Recruiter
description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 08/22/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 1\-3 years
* City Coimbatore
* State/Province Tamil Nadu
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 641014
### **Job Description**


Website: https://fyerx.com

  

Experience Required: 1–3 years  


Work Arrangement: Work from Office (Hybrid)  


Employment Type: Full\-time  


Salary: ₹1\.5 LPA for the initial 12 months
  

Salary After 1 Year: ₹2\.5 LPA, based on performance **Role Overview**

  

We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented Junior IT Recruiter to manage recruitment for technical roles. The ideal candidate should have experience in sourcing, screening, and coordinating IT professionals across different technologies and experience levels.

  

The candidate should be comfortable working in a remote environment, managing multiple job requirements, maintaining regular follow\-ups, and delivering quality candidate profiles within agreed timelines.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Understand technical job requirements and candidate specifications shared by hiring managers or clients.
* Source suitable IT candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, job portals, professional networks, employee referrals, social media, and internal databases.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on technical skills, relevant experience, project exposure, location, availability, notice period, and compensation expectations.
* Conduct initial screening calls to assess candidates’ communication skills, technical background, job interest, and overall suitability for the role.
* Source candidates for IT roles such as Software Developers, Full Stack Developers, Frontend Developers, Backend Developers, Java Developers, Python Developers, React Developers, Angular Developers, DevOps Engineers, Cloud Engineers, QA Engineers, Data Analysts, UI/UX Designers, Business Analysts, and other technical positions.
* Coordinate interviews between shortlisted candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates and stakeholders for interview availability, interview feedback, selection updates, documentation, and joining status.
* Share candidate profiles in the required format, along with relevant details such as current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, location, and availability.
* Maintain accurate candidate records, job status, interview schedules, sourcing details, and recruitment trackers using Zoho Recruit, ATS platforms, Excel, Google Sheets, or other relevant tools.
* Build and maintain a strong database of IT professionals for current and future hiring requirements.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience through clear, timely, and professional communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Assist with offer coordination, document collection, background\-verification follow\-ups, and joining formalities when required.
* Meet assigned sourcing, submission, interview, and closure targets.
* Stay updated on current IT skills, technology trends, recruitment practices, and sourcing methods.

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in IT recruitment, technical recruitment, talent acquisition, or staffing recruitment.
* Experience in sourcing and hiring candidates for technical and IT roles.
* Basic understanding of IT technologies, skills, job titles, and technical recruitment terminology.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Java, Python, .NET, React, Angular, Node.js, SQL, AWS, Azure, DevOps, testing, data analytics, and cloud platforms is preferred.
* Strong experience using LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, job portals, Boolean search, social\-media sourcing, and referral\-based recruitment.
* Familiarity with Zoho Recruit, ATS, HRMS, CRM, or recruitment\-tracking tools will be an added advantage.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong follow\-up, negotiation, coordination, time\-management, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple open requirements, and meet deadlines in a remote work environment.
* High level of professionalism, ownership, attention to detail, and confidentiality.

### **Benefits**


If you have a passion for IT recruitment, candidate sourcing, and connecting skilled professionals with the right opportunities, we encourage you to apply for the Junior IT Recruiter role at FyerX.

title: Field Test Engineer
description:
The role
   

  

 You are the company’s eyes in the field. You commission the stations, you run acceptance testing with real farmers and pilots, you check what the telemetry says against what the ground says, and you capture the evidence that two signatures rest on. No station opens without your signature on its scripts.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Run the published commissioning scripts in person, on site, with evidence — no step may be signed remotely
* Measure the real boundary of at least ten blocks with a handheld device against the computed polygon
* Time the geofence breach alert with a stopwatch — the published number is one you measured
* Recruit real farmers for acceptance sessions, and recruit past the minimum, because runs are voided by rain and by withdrawn consent
* Spot\-check at least one flight per station per week against the logs
* File any field\-reported defect with steps, screenshots and logs within four hours
* Countersign the acceptance runs and file their evidence folders


 Eligibility
   

  

* One to three years in quality or support
* Fluent Tamil — speaking, reading and writing
* A two\-wheeler and a valid licence, and willingness to travel across districts
* Comfortable around drones, batteries and field kit — not an expert, but not nervous either
* Bug\-report discipline: steps, context, evidence and timestamp, every time
* Patience with checklists, and the alertness to notice when a checklist is itself wrong


 What you get
   

  

* The remote pilot certificate sponsored for the stronger of the two seats
* Company accommodation in Erode during the posting, a proper travel allowance paid on a schedule rather than on claims, and scheduled rest days
* The QA Lead on site twice a week, not on a call

 You stand up and hold the entire estate: the production node, the pipelines that reach it, the observability that explains it, and a restore that has actually been performed rather than described. You also build fifteen workstations before nine people arrive on the same morning.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Provision and harden production, and own database, cache and application deployment
* Build continuous delivery with automatic rollback — every merge tested, built and deployed to staging in ten minutes or less
* Own backup and disaster recovery to a four\-hour restore and fifteen minutes of acceptable data loss
* Run a restore drill every month from September, each producing a filed evidence record
* Deliver observability in week one: structured logs correlated by job, metrics on gate and settlement variance, alerts that mean something
* Build and sign into fifteen complete workstations before the second wave arrives — a hard gate
* Write every procedure as a runbook somebody else could follow at two in the morning


 Eligibility
   

  

* Four to six years in infrastructure, with a dedicated or bare\-metal estate managed solo for two years or more
* Postgres\-class database operations: backups, restores, replication, tuning
* A pipeline you built from nothing, including stabilising the flaky tests
* Disaster\-recovery drills you personally ran, with a story about what failed the first time
* Monitoring built from scratch rather than bought as a bundle
* Cost awareness, and the instinct to read the exit clause before the price


 What you get
   

  

* The whole estate, yours to design — hosting chosen on cost and exit terms, with no lock\-in accepted
* A company that treats a rehearsed restore as the job, not as paperwork


 How the process runs
   

  

* Fill in the short form on this page.
* We read it ourselves. Every application is read.
* If we want to meet you, we call you.

title: O&M Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – O\&M / PROJECT TECHNICIAN

Company: Gram Envo Solution Pvt. Ltd.

Department: O\&M / Projects

Designation: O\&M / Project Technician

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Work Location: Project / Site Locations

Job Summary

Gram Envo Solution Pvt. Ltd. is looking for technically skilled O\&M / Project Technicians to support the operation, maintenance, installation and commissioning of STP, ETP, WTP and RO Treatment Plants.

The candidate will be responsible for plant operations, equipment maintenance, troubleshooting, installation and project execution activities as assigned.

Key Responsibilities

\- Operate and monitor STP, ETP, WTP and RO treatment plants.

\- Carry out routine inspection and maintenance of plant equipment.

\- Handle pumps, motors, blowers, valves, pipelines and other mechanical equipment.

\- Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance.

\- Identify technical faults and carry out basic troubleshooting.

\- Support installation, erection and commissioning of treatment plant equipment.

\- Assist Project Engineers in project execution and site activities.

\- Read and understand basic engineering drawings and layouts.

\- Assist in piping, mechanical and electrical installation works.

\- Support testing, trial runs and commissioning activities.

\- Monitor plant parameters and maintain daily operational records.

\- Maintain logbooks, checklists, maintenance reports and site records.

\- Coordinate with O\&M In\-charge, Project Engineer and Project Manager.

\- Ensure proper chemical handling and dosing as per requirements.

\- Maintain tools, equipment and work areas properly.

\- Follow company safety procedures and use required PPE.

\- Attend breakdowns and support timely restoration of plant operations.

\- Travel to different project/site locations whenever required.

\- Perform other technical duties assigned by the reporting manager.

Educational Qualification

\- ITI / Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Civil or related technical disciplines.

\- Candidates with relevant experience in STP / ETP / WTP / RO will be preferred.

\- Freshers with good technical knowledge may also be considered.

Experience

\- Freshers to 3\+ years of relevant experience.

\- Experience in water treatment plant operation, maintenance, installation or commissioning will be an added advantage.

Required Skills

\- Basic mechanical and electrical knowledge

\- Pump and motor troubleshooting

\- Preventive \& breakdown maintenance

\- Installation and commissioning

\- Basic drawing/diagram reading

\- Technical problem\-solving

\- Site coordination

\- Safety awareness

\- Teamwork and discipline

\- Good communication and reporting skills

Key Performance Areas

\- Smooth plant operation

\- Equipment uptime and reliability

\- Timely maintenance and breakdown response

\- Quality project execution

\- Installation and commissioning support

\- Safety compliance

\- Proper documentation and reporting

Candidate Requirements

\- Willingness to work at project/site locations.

\- Willingness to travel as per project requirements.

\- Ability to work in shifts where required.

\- Strong work discipline and positive attitude.

\- Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

Reporting To: O\&M In\-charge / Project Engineer / Project Manager

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
* **Role** 
 : Cybersecurity Specialist (Remote)
* **Location** 
 : Remote (Work from Anywhere)
* **Job** 
**Type** 
 : Contract
* **Payout** 
 : $25 \- $80/hour



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Penetration Tester to work on a contract basis. The role involves identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities in systems, networks, and applications to assess security posture. Responsibilities include conducting manual and automated penetration testing, documenting findings, and recommending remediation strategies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 • Perform comprehensive security assessments, including network, web application, and API penetration testing.
 



 • Execute vulnerability scans and analyze results to identify security weaknesses.
 



 • Develop and execute custom exploits to validate risks and simulate real\-world attack scenarios.
 



 • Prepare detailed reports outlining vulnerabilities, exploitation steps, and mitigation recommendations.
 



 • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to triage findings and verify remediation efforts.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




 • Proficiency in penetration testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Metasploit, or similar.
 



 • Experience with scripting languages like Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation and tool development.
 



 • Knowledge of common security frameworks, including OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT\&CK, and CIS benchmarks.
 



 • Familiarity with network protocols, operating systems (Windows/Linux), and cloud security principles.
 



 • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret technical data and communicate findings clearly.
 



  





**More About the Opportunity:** 




 This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Information Services industry, contributing to the protection of critical infrastructure and sensitive data. The contract duration is flexible, with potential for extension based on project needs and performance.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 




 We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.
 



  





**Apply Now!**

description:
**Job Title**

  

**Territory Service Representative – Operations**

  

  

**Function**

  

**Operations**

  

  

**Reports To**

**25%** **50%** **75%** **þ**

  

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations*** Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence*** Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management*** Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance*** Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security*** Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility*** Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration*** Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:
* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:*** Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:*** Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:*** Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.

Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support**

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence

  

  

Quality \& Accuracy

  

Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations

  

  

Operational Discipline

  

Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline

  

  

Teamwork \& Operational Support

  

Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

● Work with APIs, webhooks and basic automation wherever required.

● Understand and troubleshoot data flow between different platforms.

● Learn and implement new software/tools as the company adopts them.

● Maintain documentation of important technical configurations and workflows.

● Research new tools that can improve business productivity and automation.

Manage the company's social media presence across platforms such as:

● Instagram

● Facebook

● LinkedIn

● YouTube

● Other relevant platforms

Responsibilities include:

● Plan and create regular social media content.

● Create attractive posts, carousels, infographics and promotional creatives.

● Create short\-form videos/Reels/Shorts.

● Develop content ideas suitable for the company's industry.

The candidate should be enthusiastic about Artificial Intelligence and emerging AI tools. Responsibilities may include:

● Researching and using new AI tools for business.

● Using AI for content creation, image generation, video creation and editing.

● Using AI for research, data analysis and productivity.

● Creating AI\-assisted marketing workflows.

● Using AI for SEO and content optimization.

● Exploring AI automation and AI\-powered business tools.

● Identifying repetitive tasks that can be automated using AI.

● Helping the company adopt useful AI technologies.

● Continuously learning new AI tools and technologies.

**The candidate is expected to keep learning because AI tools and digital technologies are continuously evolving.**

**6\. Digital Marketing \& Campaign Support**

● Assist in planning and executing digital marketing campaigns.

● Create campaign creatives and supporting content.

● Manage basic campaign\-related technical requirements.

● Coordinate website landing pages, forms and lead\-generation systems.

● Track campaign performance and identify areas for improvement.

● Assist with lead\-generation and conversion optimization.

● Keep websites, plugins and systems updated.

● Identify basic security vulnerabilities.

● Manage website backups and recovery processes.

● Monitor unusual website behavior or technical issues.

Must\-Have

● CSS

● Basic JavaScript

● Website hosting \& domain management

● SEO fundamentals

● Highly curious and willing to learn

● Hands\-on and execution\-oriented

● A good problem solver

● Comfortable researching solutions independently

● Able to work on multiple technical and digital tasks

● Interested in new technology and AI

● Able to understand business requirements and convert them into practical solutions

● Capable of working independently with minimum supervision

● Detail\-oriented and responsible

● Good at troubleshooting

● Comfortable working in a growing company where responsibilities may evolve

**Important: Who Should Apply?** 

This position is particularly suitable for someone who considers themselves a:

**“Tech \+ Digital \+ AI all\-rounder”**

A candidate does not need to be an expert in every single area from Day 1\. However, the candidate must have strong technical fundamentals, a willingness to learn quickly and the ability to independently research and implement solutions.

Candidates who only know basic social media posting or basic WordPress page editing **without technical troubleshooting/development capability are not suitable for this position.**

Similarly, candidates who only know coding but have no interest in digital marketing, SEO, social media and AI tools may not be the ideal fit.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a technically skilled and customer\-oriented **Field Service Engineer** to support our ISP network operations. The role involves installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and restoration of broadband, FTTH/FTTx, fiber\-optic, Wi\-Fi, and networking services at customer and network locations.

The candidate will work closely with the **NOC, Installation, Customer Care, and Network Operations teams** to ensure timely service delivery, network availability, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install and commission **FTTH/FTTx broadband connections**, ONT/ONU, routers, Wi\-Fi devices, and other CPE equipment.
* Perform fiber cable routing, termination, jointing, and basic **fiber splicing** activities.
* Troubleshoot broadband connectivity, low\-speed, signal\-loss, Wi\-Fi, and network\-related complaints.
* Check optical signal levels and identify fiber cuts, attenuation, connector issues, and last\-mile faults.
* Perform testing using **OTDR, Optical Power Meter, VFL, Fusion Splicer**, and other fiber\-testing equipment.
* Configure and troubleshoot routers, ONT/ONU, Wi\-Fi routers, switches, and basic networking equipment.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance of the access/last\-mile network.
* Attend customer complaints and service requests within the defined **SLA/TAT**.
* Conduct site surveys and feasibility checks for new customer connections.
* Coordinate with the **NOC/L2/L3 teams** for issues requiring backend or advanced technical support.
* Support fault restoration for OFC, distribution boxes, FDPs, splitters, and other access\-network infrastructure.
* Maintain proper records of installations, complaints, fault restoration, materials, and customer sign\-offs.
* Ensure proper utilization and maintenance of company tools, equipment, vehicles, and network materials.
* Explain basic equipment usage and troubleshooting procedures to customers.
* Follow company technical standards, safety procedures, and field\-service guidelines.
* Be available for rotational shifts, emergency maintenance, weekends, or holidays when required.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Basic knowledge of **FTTH, FTTx, GPON, OFC, LAN/WAN, Ethernet, and TCP/IP**.
* Knowledge of **ONT/ONU, OLT, routers, switches, Wi\-Fi, and CPE**.
* Basic understanding of IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLAN, and network troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on knowledge of fiber splicing and testing is preferred.
* Ability to identify and troubleshoot fiber cuts, optical power loss, and connectivity issues.
* Knowledge of OTDR and Optical Power Meter is an added advantage.

**Qualification**

* ITI / Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in **Electronics, Telecommunication, Electrical, Computer Science, IT, or related disciplines**.

* Willingness to travel within the assigned service area.
* Good communication and customer\-handling skills.
* Ability to work independently in outdoor/field conditions.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts and during emergency network restoration.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Installation completion within SLA.
* First\-Time Resolution (FTR) of customer complaints.
* Fault restoration TAT.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Network/service quality.
* Preventive maintenance completion.
* Proper utilization of tools and materials.

**Candidate Profile:** A hands\-on technical professional who can independently attend customer locations, troubleshoot fiber/broadband issues, coordinate with the NOC, and ensure reliable ISP service delivery.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager — BabyosaurAbout Babyosaur

Babyosaur is a **young, homegrown brand for little ones aged 0–5**, built around mindful parenting, sustainable choices, meaningful play and beautifully designed everyday essentials.

We’re still at the beginning of our journey — which is exactly why this role is exciting.

We’re not looking for someone to simply “manage our Instagram.” We’re looking for someone who wants to **help build a brand from the ground up**, experiment, learn, create, and grow alongside us.

If you see potential before everyone else does, understand why a Reel works before it goes viral, and love turning an idea into content — we’d love to hear from you.

The Role

We’re looking for a **Social Media Manager / Content \& Social Media Executive** who can take ownership of Babyosaur’s digital presence across:

* Instagram
* Facebook
* YouTube
* LinkedIn
* Babyosaur’s website

You’ll work closely with the founders to translate our brand ethos into content that is **fresh, relatable, engaging and distinctly Babyosaur.**

What You'll Do

**Content \& Social Media**

* Follow and execute a structured monthly content calendar.
* Plan and create Reels, carousels, static posts, Stories and short\-form videos.
* Edit Reels and social videos using tools such as Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar.
* Write captions, hooks and engaging copy.
* Schedule and publish content consistently across platforms.
* Repurpose content intelligently across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and LinkedIn.
* Keep our website content fresh and aligned with campaigns.

**Trend Spotting \& Growth**

* Stay constantly updated on Instagram and social media trends.
* Identify viral audio, formats, memes, hooks and content styles **before they become saturated.**
* Think ahead about what parents will be talking about next.
* Experiment with new formats and ideas rather than simply copying competitors.
* Track analytics and understand what is working — and, importantly, why.
* Help grow our followers, reach, engagement and ultimately our customer base.

**Ads \& Campaigns**

* Assist with creating and scheduling Meta ads and promotional campaigns.
* Develop creative variations for ads.
* Monitor basic performance metrics and suggest improvements.
* Support launches, offers, exhibitions, collaborations and seasonal campaigns.

Who We're Looking For

This role is especially suited to a **fresher or someone in the early stages of their career** who has strong social media instincts.

You don't necessarily need years of experience.

We care much more about whether you:

* **Understand social media naturally.**
* Know what makes people stop scrolling.
* Can spot a trend before it peaks.
* Have a strong eye for aesthetics and storytelling.
* Are creative, curious and willing to experiment.
* Can edit a Reel from start to finish.
* Are comfortable with Canva, CapCut or similar tools.
* Have good writing and communication skills.
* Are organised enough to stick to a content calendar.
* Can work independently without needing to be told what to do every step of the way.
* Are willing to learn quickly.
* Actually enjoy social media rather than simply using it.

Most Importantly — We Want a Co\-Builder

Babyosaur is **small, young and bootstrapped.**

This isn't a corporate job where you'll be handed a brief, execute it and go home.

Sometimes you'll be planning next month's content.

Sometimes you'll be filming a product.

Sometimes you'll be brainstorming a crazy Reel.

Sometimes you'll notice a trend at 10 AM and we'll want to jump on it by lunch.

And sometimes you'll have to figure something out with limited resources.

We want someone who is **comfortable with that.**

Someone who doesn't say:

“That's not my job.”

But instead thinks:

“How can we make this work?”

We want you to genuinely understand and co\-own what Babyosaur stands for — **mindful parenting, conscious consumption, sustainability, Indian design, meaningful childhood and making parenting a little easier.**

What You'll Get

* The opportunity to work directly with the founders.
* Significant creative freedom.
* The chance to shape the social identity of a brand from its early stages.
* Hands\-on experience across content, branding, ecommerce, marketing and digital growth.
* Freedom to experiment and bring your ideas to life.
* A fast\-moving environment where good ideas can actually be implemented.
* The opportunity to grow **with Babyosaur**, not just work for Babyosaur.

This Could Be You If...

You spend way too much time thinking *“this would make a great Reel.”*

You save trending audio.

You notice when a brand's Instagram suddenly changes its content strategy.

You have 15 content ideas sitting in your Notes app.

You enjoy figuring out **why something went viral.**

You'd rather build something from scratch than inherit something that's already established.

And you want your work to have a visible impact.

**If that sounds like you, we want to meet you.**

How to Apply

Send us:

* Your CV / profile
* Your Instagram or portfolio
* **3 social media accounts you think are doing an amazing job — and tell us why**
* One content idea you would create for Babyosaur
* Your expected compensation

**Freshers are encouraged to apply.**

We’re looking for **potential, creativity, ownership and hunger to learn — not just years of experience.**

**Come build Babyosaur with us.** 

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

description:
At Dscout, we're building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world's top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.
   

  

 AI native product is fundamentally different engineering problem than building deterministic software: the same input won't always produce the same output, and "working" means the agent behaves well across the full distribution of real world scenarios, not that it passes a fixed test suite.
   

  

 We're looking for an
 **Applied AI Engineer** 
 with 2\-5 years of experience building and shipping AI systems used by professionals at enterprise. You're comfortable working with modern LLM\-based systems and agentic workflows, and you know how to turn powerful models into reliable product features. You have strong product judgment and think deeply about tradeoffs between LLM approaches and traditional ML when designing solutions. You care about evaluation, iteration speed, and making sure AI systems actually drive measurable business impact
 **reliably** 
 .
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Own the production improvement loop across agent behavior, customer and operator feedback, evaluation, experimentation, and verified business outcomes
* Instrument agent workflows so model interactions, tool use, decisions, failures, human edits, and downstream outcomes can be understood in context
* Define meaningful quality standards, representative evaluation datasets, regression coverage, and production monitoring.
* Investigate why agents underperform across context, knowledge, instructions, tools, routing, guardrails, or workflow design
* Design and ship targeted behavior improvements, including changes to prompting, context construction, decision logic, tool use, and human\-review paths
* Build backend services, APIs, data models, and feedback pipelines that make agent behavior observable, steerable, and reproducible
* Run controlled experiments, production replays, or staged rollouts to measure whether changes improve quality and downstream business results
* Partner with Product, Data Science, and Sales to prioritize high\-value problems and define customer and business success
* Ship with appropriate safeguards for privacy, security, reliability, human oversight, and safe operational rollout


 What you bring
   

  

* 2\-5 years of software engineering experience, with hands\-on experience building or operating LLM\-powered features or agents in production \- not just prototypes or demos
* Fluency with prompting and context engineering as an engineering discipline: you iterate on prompts, context construction, and tool definitions the way you'd iterate on code
* Experience building or maintaining evaluation harnesses for AI systems: offline eval sets, LLM\-as\-judge or human\-in\-the\-loop scoring, regression detection
* Genuine comfort with non\-determinism: you reason about agent behavior across a distribution of production traffic, not a fixed set of test cases, and you don't treat variance as a bug to be argued away
* Experience running experiments (A/B, staged rollouts, production replay) to validate whether a change actually improved outcomes, not just whether it shipped
* A track record of shipping features real users depended on, and owning what happened after launch
* A high\-agency mindset: comfortable investigating an ambiguous "why is this underperforming" problem across context, tools, routing, and workflow design without a fully\-scoped ticket
* Comfort using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) as a real part of your workflow


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience with voice or real\-time conversational AI systems
* Familiarity with LLM observability/tracing tools (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Datadog LLM Observability)
* Experience with agentic orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph or similar)
