title: R&D Engineer — Drone Systems
description:
The role
   

  

 You stand at the boundary between airframe and software. When a pilot says the position fix was bad, you are the person who can say whether it was sky obstruction, multipath, or our code. From November there are no black\-box failures on your watch.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Own the telemetry lab — bench, replay, visualisation and ground\-truth data, live and reproducible
* Own protocol work with the first drone manufacturer and the evaluation of second and third\-source adapters
* Run new\-technology spikes: correction services, edge inference, alternative power
* Deliver field diagnostics into the war room a week before stations go live — a diagnostic first used under pressure is one that does not work
* From November, give every flight anomaly data and a written hypothesis within four hours
* Pin the decoder to a declared protocol version and fail loudly on an unknown message rather than dropping it silently


 Eligibility
   

  

* Three to five years at the hardware–software boundary: serial protocols, radio links or flight controllers
* Comfortable with a standard telemetry protocol
* You understand what a flight controller is doing — inertial measurement, barometer, compass, how they fuse and how they fail
* Three or more solo proofs of concept taken from nothing to a written finding
* Lab discipline: documented, reproducible setups and honest negative results
* Willing to travel to Erode for field validation in October and November


 What you get
   

  

* A real lab, and spikes with a defined question and a stopping rule
* Findings written up honestly, including the ones that did not work

title: Process Quality Engineer [Power Electronics Manufacturing]
description:
**About Us**

Statcon Electronics India Limited is a leading power electronics company specializing in the design and manufacture of reliable power electronics solutions for critical applications across Railways, Defence, Power, and Solar sectors. With decades of industry experience, we are committed to delivering high\-quality products through strong engineering, manufacturing, and quality practices.

**Position Overview**

Statcon Electronics India Limited is seeking a Quality Control / Process Quality professional to support quality assurance activities across the production process. The selected candidate will be responsible for in\-process inspection, final inspection, defect identification, process monitoring, and maintaining quality records on the shop floor.

The role requires a practical understanding of Process Quality Control, engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, inspection methods, and basic measuring instruments. The candidate will work closely with the Production and Quality teams to identify and resolve quality issues and ensure that products meet defined specifications.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Monitor and maintain quality standards at different stages of the production process.
* Perform in\-process and final inspection of products as per defined quality standards.
* Inspect product dimensions, fitment, assembly, appearance, workmanship, and overall quality.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and specifications.
* Use basic inspection and measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, measuring tape, meter tape, and other relevant tools.
* Identify production defects, quality issues, and process deviations during manufacturing.
* Coordinate with the Production and Quality teams to identify root causes and resolve quality\-related issues.
* Ensure that production activities are carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Maintain inspection records, check sheets, rejection reports, and other quality\-related documentation.
* Report quality deviations and non\-conformities to the concerned team or reporting manager.
* Support corrective and preventive actions for recurring quality issues.
* Conduct regular shop\-floor checks to ensure adherence to defined process and quality standards.
* Assist in maintaining proper documentation and traceability of inspection activities.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* Diploma in Electronics is mandatory.
* Freshers with strong practical understanding of Process Quality may also be considered.
* 0–2 years of experience in Quality Control, Process Quality, or a related manufacturing function will be preferred.
* Practical knowledge of In\-Process Quality Control.
* Basic understanding of engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and specifications.
* Familiarity with basic measuring and inspection instruments.
* Good observation and attention to detail.
* Basic problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of quality documentation and inspection reports.
* Willingness to work in a shop\-floor / manufacturing environment.

**Employment Prerequisites**

* Location: Statcon Electronics India Limited, Noida, Uttar Pradesh.
* Full\-time, on\-site position.
* Comfortable working in a shop\-floor manufacturing environment.
* Willingness to coordinate closely with Production and Quality teams.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining product quality.
* Immediate joiners / candidates with short notice periods will be preferred.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented **Mechanical Draftsman** with a strong background in the **metal fabrication industry**. In this role, you will convert complex engineering concepts and rough sketches into highly accurate, detailed 2D production drawings and 3D models. The ideal candidate understands sheet metal fabrication, structural steelwork, welding symbols, and machining processes, ensuring that the workshop team can manufacture products with zero errors.

**Key Responsibilities**

· **Production Drawings**: Create detailed manufacturing drawings, including assembly drawings, part drawings, structural layouts, and cross\-sections for the fabrication shop floor.

· **Bill of Materials (BOM)**: Generate precise and comprehensive Bills of Materials, cutting lists, and material take\-offs to assist the procurement and accounts teams.

· **3D Modelling \& Modelling**: Develop accurate 3D models of fabricated structures, enclosures, and mechanical assemblies to check for interferences and fitment.

· **Welding \& Machining Symbols**: Apply standard welding symbols, geometric dimensioning and tolerance (GD\&T), and surface finish symbols accurately according to international standards (ISO/ASME/IS).

· **Design Optimization**: Collaborate with fabrication supervisors and project engineers to optimize designs for cost\-effective manufacturing and easier assembly.

· **Revision Control**: Maintain an organized engineering database, ensuring strict version control and tracking changes made to drawings during the production cycle.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

· **Education**: ITI (Draftsman Mechanical) or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.

· **Experience**: 1 to 2 years of solid experience as a draftsman specifically within a **heavy fabrication, sheet metal, or structural steel industry**.

· **Industry Knowledge**: Strong understanding of fabrication shop\-floor practices, raw material types (MS, SS), plate thicknesses, and bending allowances.

**Technical Skills \& Competencies**

· **CAD Software Mastery**: Proficiency in 2D and 3D software such as **AutoCAD**, **SolidWorks**, or **Solid Edge**.

· **Sheet Metal Design**: Expertise in creating flat\-pattern developments, calculating bend deductions, and designing sheet metal enclosures.

· **Standards \& Code Compliance**: Familiarity with industrial detailing codes and standards (e.g., ASME Section VIII for pressure vessels or IS codes for structural steel).

· **Attention to Detail**: Exceptional precision to minimize material wastage, re\-work, and dimensional errors on the factory floor.

**What We Offer**

· Competitive salary aligned with fabrication industry standards.

· Safe, structured, and growth\-oriented engineering work environment.

title: Purchase Manager- Redy Mix Concrete
description:
Job Summary

The Purchase Manager – RMC will be responsible for managing the **end\-to\-end procurement of Ready Mix Concrete (RMC), cement, aggregates, admixtures, and other construction\-related materials** required for ongoing projects.

The position will be responsible for **vendor development, rate negotiation, purchase planning, supplier performance, material availability, cost optimization, quality coordination, delivery scheduling, and commercial management**.

Key Responsibilities  
1\. RMC \& Material Procurement

* Manage end\-to\-end procurement of Ready Mix Concrete for construction projects.
* Coordinate procurement of different concrete grades such as **M20, M25, M30, M35, M40 and higher grades**, as required by project specifications.
* Procure cement, aggregates, manufactured sand/M\-sand, admixtures and other RMC\-related raw materials.
* Review material requirements received from project sites and prepare procurement plans accordingly.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of RMC and critical construction materials.
* Plan procurement based on project schedules, concrete pouring requirements and consumption forecasts.
* Coordinate with RMC plants and suppliers for daily/weekly delivery schedules.
* Monitor dispatches and ensure timely delivery at project sites.

2\. Vendor Development \& Management

* Identify, evaluate and develop reliable RMC suppliers and raw material vendors.
* Maintain an approved vendor database for RMC, cement, aggregates, admixtures and related materials.
* Conduct vendor evaluations based on **price, quality, capacity, delivery performance, financial stability and service capability**.
* Negotiate and finalize commercial terms with suppliers.
* Monitor vendor performance and take corrective action for recurring delays, quality issues or commercial discrepancies.
* Develop alternate suppliers to avoid dependency on a single vendor.
* Maintain strong professional relationships with key suppliers and RMC manufacturers.

3\. Price Negotiation \& Cost Control

* Obtain and compare quotations from multiple vendors.
* Negotiate **RMC rates, transportation charges, pumping charges, escalation clauses, taxes, discounts and payment terms**.
* Negotiate volume\-based rates and long\-term rate contracts wherever applicable.
* Analyze market trends for cement, aggregates, sand, admixtures, diesel and transportation costs.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising quality or project requirements.
* Maintain approved rate contracts and periodically review supplier pricing.
* Prepare comparative statements and obtain necessary approvals before finalizing purchases.

4\. Purchase Orders \& Commercial Management

* Prepare and release Purchase Orders / Work Orders in accordance with approved procurement procedures.
* Ensure POs clearly specify:
* Material description
* Concrete grade/specification
* Quantity
* Rate
* Applicable taxes
* Transportation charges
* Delivery location
* Payment terms
* Quality requirements
* Testing requirements
* Other commercial conditions
* Track PO quantities and values against actual consumption.
* Monitor pending orders and ensure timely closure of completed POs.
* Coordinate with Finance and Accounts for invoice verification and payment processing.
* Resolve billing, rate, quantity, tax and delivery\-related discrepancies with vendors.

5\. RMC Delivery \& Logistics Coordination

* Coordinate with project sites and RMC suppliers for daily concrete requirements.
* Monitor scheduled concrete pours and ensure adequate RMC availability.
* Coordinate transit mixers, concrete pumps and delivery schedules wherever applicable.
* Track vehicle dispatches and delivery status during critical pours.
* Take immediate corrective action in case of delivery delays, plant breakdowns, traffic issues or supply shortages.
* Maintain backup arrangements for critical concrete requirements.
* Minimize waiting time, rejected loads and concrete wastage.

6\. Quality \& Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with QA/QC and Civil Engineering teams to ensure procurement is as per approved specifications.
* Ensure RMC suppliers comply with project\-specific quality requirements.
* Coordinate supplier submission of **test certificates, mix designs, material test reports and other quality documents**.
* Ensure materials are sourced from approved suppliers.
* Monitor recurring quality complaints and coordinate corrective actions with vendors.
* Work closely with the QA/QC team regarding concrete quality, slump, cube testing and material specifications.

7\. Inventory \& Consumption Monitoring

* Monitor consumption of cement, aggregates, admixtures and other construction materials.
* Coordinate with Stores and Project Teams to maintain optimum inventory levels.
* Avoid both stockouts and unnecessary accumulation of materials.
* Compare planned consumption with actual consumption.
* Monitor material wastage and identify opportunities for reduction.
* Maintain procurement and consumption MIS for management review.

8\. Market Intelligence

* Regularly monitor market prices and availability of:
* Cement
* Aggregates
* M\-Sand / River Sand
* Admixtures
* RMC
* Transportation
* Diesel and other relevant inputs
* Develop an understanding of regional supplier capacity and market conditions.
* Identify new vendors and alternative sourcing options.
* Provide management with recommendations regarding market price movements and procurement strategy.

9\. Documentation \& MIS

Maintain accurate procurement records including:

* Purchase Orders
* Work Orders
* Vendor quotations
* Comparative statements
* Rate contracts
* Vendor evaluation records
* Delivery challans
* Material receipts
* Invoices
* Test certificates
* Consumption reports
* Pending PO reports
* Vendor performance reports
* Monthly procurement MIS

Prepare periodic reports on **procurement value, savings, consumption, pending orders, vendor performance and material availability**.

10\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

Work closely with:

* Project Managers
* Site Engineers
* Civil Engineering Teams
* QA/QC Department
* RMC / Batching Plant Teams
* Stores Department
* Accounts \& Finance
* Planning Department
* Commercial Department
* Senior Management

Ensure procurement decisions are aligned with **project schedules, technical requirements, budgets and commercial objectives**.

title: Python AI Hardware Developer
description:
**Python AI Hardware Developer**

**Location:** Chennai  
**Company:** Clofus Innovations Pvt. Ltd.  
**Product:** Vikbot – AI\-powered vision automation solutions for warehouses and factories

About the Role

We are looking for a hands\-on **AI \& Edge Hardware Developer** to build and deploy real\-world AI\-powered automation systems.

At Clofus Innovations, we develop **computer vision and AI systems for warehouses and factories**. Our products use cameras, AI models, edge computers, sensors, and custom hardware to automate tasks such as inventory tracking, carton detection and counting, dimension measurement, dispatch verification, safety monitoring, and industrial process automation.

This is not a purely software or research role.

You will work on the complete journey—from experimenting with AI models and cameras to integrating hardware, deploying systems at customer sites, and solving real\-world problems.

What You Will DoAI \& Computer Vision Development

* Develop and optimize computer vision solutions using Python.
* Train, test, and deploy object detection, classification, segmentation, OCR, and anomaly detection models.
* Work with models and frameworks such as YOLO, OpenCV, ONNX, PyTorch, TensorRT, and other modern AI frameworks.
* Improve accuracy and performance for challenging real\-world environments.
* Work with camera streams, RTSP, image processing, and video analytics.
* Collect, analyse, and prepare datasets for model training and testing.
* Optimize AI models for edge devices.

Edge AI \& Hardware Development

* Work with edge computing platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, and industrial PCs.
* Integrate cameras, sensors, lighting, networking equipment, and other hardware components.
* Develop and test prototype hardware systems for AI\-based automation.
* Understand USB, Ethernet, GPIO, serial communication, and other hardware interfaces.
* Assist in selecting suitable cameras, lenses, lighting, sensors, and edge computing hardware.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, and performance issues.
* Optimize systems for reliability in industrial and warehouse environments.

Product Development \& Deployment

* Convert customer problems into practical AI and automation solutions.
* Build prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts.
* Participate in installation, testing, and commissioning at customer locations when required.
* Analyse failures and continuously improve system accuracy and reliability.
* Work closely with the software and engineering team to integrate AI systems with dashboards, APIs, ERP, WMS, and other enterprise systems.
* Document experiments, system configurations, and technical findings.

Required Skills

* Strong programming skills in **Python**.
* Good understanding of **Computer Vision and Image Processing**.
* Experience with **OpenCV**.
* Experience with at least one deep learning framework such as **PyTorch**.
* Experience working with object detection models such as **YOLO** or similar architectures.
* Understanding of model training, inference, datasets, augmentation, and evaluation metrics.
* Basic understanding of **Linux**.
* Experience or strong interest in edge AI devices such as NVIDIA Jetson or Raspberry Pi.
* Understanding of cameras, video streams, USB, Ethernet, and networking basics.
* Ability to troubleshoot both software and hardware problems.
* Comfortable working with physical systems, prototypes, cameras, sensors, and industrial environments.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and curiosity.

Preferred Skills

These are not mandatory, but experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* NVIDIA Jetson and TensorRT.
* ONNX Runtime.
* CUDA acceleration.
* OCR systems.
* Anomaly detection.
* Segmentation models.
* Industrial cameras and machine vision systems.
* Camera lens selection and lighting design.
* Raspberry Pi and GPIO programming.
* Arduino or microcontroller development.
* Serial communication protocols.
* Docker.
* Linux system administration.
* REST APIs and backend integration.
* Git and version control.
* Basic electronics and circuit troubleshooting.
* 3D printing, mechanical prototyping, or CAD knowledge.

What We Are Looking For

More than specific technologies, we are looking for someone who enjoys **building things and solving real problems**.

You should be comfortable with situations like:

“The AI model works perfectly on a laptop, but the customer\-site camera produces poor results. Why?”

or

“The model is accurate, but inference is too slow on the edge device. How can we optimize it?”

or

“The detection accuracy drops because of lighting, camera angle, vibration, or carton variation. Should we solve it with AI, optics, lighting, hardware, or a combination of all four?”

The ideal candidate understands that **not every problem should be solved by training a bigger AI model**. Sometimes the best solution is better lighting, camera placement, hardware design, image processing, or a smarter combination of AI and engineering.

Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related field.
* Strong self\-taught candidates with relevant projects and practical experience are also encouraged to apply.
* Freshers with strong hands\-on projects may be considered.

Why Join Clofus Innovations?

You will get the opportunity to work on **real AI products deployed in warehouses and factories**, rather than only working on datasets or academic projects.

You will gain hands\-on experience across:

* Computer Vision
* Artificial Intelligence
* Edge AI
* NVIDIA Jetson
* Cameras and Machine Vision
* Hardware Integration
* Industrial Automation
* Real\-world AI deployment
* Product Development

You will work directly on building and improving products used by real customers and see your work move from an idea to a functioning system in the field.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a **builder, experimenter, and problem solver**.

If you enjoy AI but also want to connect cameras, test hardware, open devices, experiment with sensors, optimize edge computers, visit real sites, and figure out why something is not working—we would love to hear from you.

**This role is ideal for someone who wants to build real\-world AI systems, not just write code.**

* Hit eight hours fully offline across six jobs, then a clean sync inside a three\-minute window on a poor connection — no lost media, no silent conflicts, no manual repair

 Eligibility

title: Principal Product Manager - HR Platforms & Technology
description:
**We're looking for a**
**Principal Product Manager \- HR Platforms \& Technology**
===========================================================


**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Principal Product Manager \| HR Technology \& Platforms \| Hyderabad**
  

  

**Summary**


Cornerstone OnDemand is seeking a Principal Product Manager to grow our performance and talent management agent portfolio, leading the delivery of AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents that drive measurable customer value.
  

This is a customer\-facing AI\-native product management role for a hands\-on PM who can move quickly from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes, using modern AI\-native product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar platforms. The role requires close collaboration with customers, FDEs, engineering, and cross\-functional teams to validate solutions early, iterate rapidly, and launch outcome agents that solve meaningful business problems. As our agent portfolio grows, individual agents increasingly work together to compound value for customers, and this role will help shape how new agents fit into that broader picture.
  

The ideal candidate is highly execution\-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, and able to translate customer needs into prototypes, product direction, and shipped capabilities with speed and rigor


**About the Team**


You'll join a growing product team building AI\-native agents for the performance and talent management domain, part of a broader portfolio of enterprise outcome agents at Cornerstone. Our agents help enterprise customers connect everyday work to business outcomes, from goal\-setting to performance reviews to coaching and development. As the portfolio expands, we're increasingly focused on how individual agents can work together to create more value than any single agent alone. This role is an opportunity to help shape that next chapter, taking ownership of new agent areas as the team grows.


**What Success Looks Like**


In your first 6 to 12 months, you will:
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of one or more new agent initiatives within the performance and talent domain, from customer discovery through working prototype.
* Build strong relationships with customers, FDEs, and engineering partners, establishing a fast, repeatable feedback loop between discovery and prototype iteration.
* Ship a working AI\-native prototype that customers and internal stakeholders can review, test, and validate against real business problems.
* Identify meaningful opportunities for your agent(s) to complement others in the portfolio, contributing to how the team thinks about multi\-agent value.
* Establish yourself as a trusted, execution\-oriented voice on the team, someone who can take ambiguous customer problems and turn them into shipped product direction with minimal oversight

**In This Role You Will**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of new AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents within the performance and talent management domain, from customer discovery and requirements gathering through prototype creation, iteration, and launch.
* Partner directly with customers to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes in performance management, goal\-setting, and talent development.
* Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, use cases, and solution concepts that can quickly be tested and refined.
* Identify opportunities for new agents to complement existing ones in the portfolio, contributing to a cohesive experience as agents are increasingly deployed together.
* Build and evolve working prototypes using AI\-native tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar rapid prototyping platforms, using prototypes as the new PRD motion so customers, FDEs, and engineering can review, test, and refine solutions directly.
* Collaborate closely with FDEs and engineering to validate feasibility, refine user flows, and prepare solutions for launch, working in tight feedback loops to confirm value and shape deliverable product capabilities.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across product, engineering, design, data science, architecture, and go\-to\-market teams to bring validated concepts into production.
* Turn customer specific outcome agents into re\-sellable out\-of\-the box agents.
* Ensure launched outcome agents are practical, scalable, and easy for enterprise customers to adopt.
* Use customer feedback, adoption signals, and business\-impact metrics to continuously improve product execution and outcomes.


**You Have Got What it Takes If you Have**


* 5\+ years of experience in product management, including significant experience delivering enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or platform products.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-native prototyping and product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot or similar tools to accelerate product definition and validation.
* Strong track record in customer\-facing product delivery for enterprise SaaS or AI\-native products.
* Demonstrated ability to go from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes and launched solutions.
* Experience collaborating closely with customers and technical delivery partners such as FDEs to iterate rapidly and launch customer\-ready solutions.
* Strong product execution skills, including prioritization, prototype validation, release planning, cross\-functional coordination, and delivery tracking.
* Experience translating ambiguous customer problems into structured product requirements and testable product experiences.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-moving, matrixed environments and drive alignment across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications
* Experience in the performance management or broader HR technology space, for example goal\-setting platforms, performance review tools, or coaching and enablement platforms.
* Experience contributing to a multi\-product or multi\-agent portfolio, with an understanding of how individual products can be designed to work well together.
* Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow agents, or decision\-support products.
* Demonstrated success using rapid prototyping to accelerate product\-market fit and customer adoption.
* Experience working in close partnership with customer success, services, sales, and solution delivery teams.

  

  

**Our Culture:**


Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.


**Who We Are:**


Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI\-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million\+ users in 180\+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high\-performing, future\-ready organizations and people today.


Check us out on LinkedIn, Comparably, Glassdoor, and Facebook!

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
About Us  

We are India's first 60\-minute fashion delivery platform, bringing curated, trend\-forward clothing and accessories to consumers within an hour across Bengaluru. We are building India's premium quick\-commerce destination for fashion\-where trend, speed, and curation come together for the modern, style\-conscious consumer.  

Backed by a recent $10M Series A funding round led by top\-tier global venture capital firms, we are one of the fastest\-funded fashion\-tech startups in India. We are aggressively scaling our core teams across tech, product, design, merchandising, category management, and operations, and we are looking for a relentless TA Lead to drive hyper\-growth hiring.  

The Role  

As our Talent Acquisition Lead, you will take complete ownership of our end\-to\-end talent engine. You will partner directly with the Founders, Business Heads, and Hiring Managers to build and execute high\-velocity hiring roadmaps.  

This is not an administrative HR role\-it is a fast\-paced, high\-ownership mandate for a hands\-on recruiting leader who thrives in early\-stage, 0\-to\-1 environments, loves headhunting exceptional talent, and knows how to close top\-tier candidates fast.  

Key Responsibilities  

End\-to\-End Ownership: Own the entire recruitment lifecycle across non\-tech and tech verticals\-including Fashion Design, Merchandising, E\-Commerce/Shopify Operations, Product, Marketing, and Field Ops.  

Proactive Sourcing \& Headhunting: Leverage non\-traditional sourcing channels, deep Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Behance/Dribbble, and talent networks to build strong active and passive candidate pipelines.  

Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Founders and Vertical Heads to understand team capacity plans, craft role profiles, and set clear scorecard\-based evaluation frameworks.  

Candidate Experience: Ensure a transparent, seamless, and high\-touch candidate journey from initial outreach to offer negotiation and onboarding.  

Data\-Driven Recruiting: Track, analyze, and optimize core TA metrics\-including Time\-to\-Hire, Cost\-per\-Hire, Sourcing Channel ROI, Offer Acceptance Rates, and Pipeline Velocity.  

Employer Branding: Help establish our company as the premier employer brand in the quick\-commerce and fashion\-tech space through engaging talent campaigns and campus/industry outreach.  

What We Are Looking For  

Experience: 4 to 8 years of core talent acquisition experience, with a heavy emphasis on early\-stage, high\-growth startup environments (Series A/B preferred).  

Multi\-Discipline Hiring: Proven success hiring across cross\-functional domains (Retail/Fashion/Category, Creative, Operations, and Core Tech).  

Headhunting Prowess: Strong outbound sourcing DNA; someone who relies on proactive outreach and market mapping rather than just waiting for inbound applications.  

Speed \& Agility: Demonstrated capability of closing high\-priority positions within aggressive turnaround times without compromising on talent quality.  

Negotiation \& Closing: Excellent interpersonal communication and negotiation skills with a proven track record of converting passive talent into enthusiastic hires.  

Availability: Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of 15 days or less.  

Why Join Us?  

Hyper\-Growth Phase: Be at the center of building the foundational team for India's fastest\-growing fashion\-tech platform.  

High Visibility: Direct collaboration with the Founding Team and functional leaders.  

Compensation: Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and wealth creation opportunities via ESOPs.  

Culture: High ownership, fast\-paced execution, and a flat hierarchy where great work is recognized immediately.

An exciting opportunity has arisen at **Control Union,** at **Tirupur, India** for **AUDITOR – TEXTILE CERTIFICATIONS.**



As an **Auditor – Textiles** focussed on the Higg FEM Verification, you will be responsible for conducting independent and objective verification of facility environmental performance information in accordance with the applicable Higg Facility Environmental Module (FEM) requirements, verification protocols, and applicable program procedures.



The position may perform verification activities as a Generalist Verifier, Chemical Specialist Verifier, or both, subject to the individual’s approved competency, qualification.



The Higg FEM Verifier is responsible for ensuring that assigned verification activities are performed competently, objectively, consistently, impartially, and in accordance with applicable Higg FEM requirements and the organization’s established verification procedures.



The verifier shall maintain the highest standards of professional integrity and ensure that verification conclusions are supported by adequate and reliable objective evidence.


### **Tasks and responsibilities**


* Conduct Higg FEM verification activities in accordance with applicable FEM requirements, verification protocols, and internal procedures.
* Review facility information, FEM submissions, supporting documents, records, permits, monitoring data, and other relevant evidence.
* Conduct on\-site verification, including facility walkthroughs, document review, management discussions, and worker/employee interviews where applicable.
* Verify the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of information reported by the facility.
* Identify discrepancies, gaps, and findings based on objective evidence.
* Maintain appropriate verification records and evidence for all verification conclusions.
* Prepare accurate and timely verification reports and associated documentation.
* Maintain confidentiality of client information and verification evidence.
* Communicate professionally with facility representatives during verification activities.
* Escalate technical, procedural, or integrity\-related concerns to the appropriate technical/program management personnel.
* Maintain competence through applicable training, calibration, technical updates, and continuing professional development.
* Comply with the organization’s impartiality, confidentiality, code of conduct, conflict\-of\-interest, and information\-security requirements.
* Support internal quality activities such as technical review, calibration, witness assessments, and internal competency evaluations when assigned.
* Maintain awareness of changes to Higg FEM requirements, verification procedures, and applicable environmental and chemical management practices.
* Perform and manage activities and tasks assigned by the Reporting Manager.

### **Requirements**


**General Requirements**


* Cascale Approved Higg FEM Verifier (Generalist/Chemical Specialist)
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Textile Engineering.
* Relevant professional experience in environmental management, sustainability, EHS, manufacturing, chemical management, auditing, inspection, testing, or verification.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes and associated environmental aspects.
* Good understanding of environmental data, records, calculations, and performance indicators.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Fluency of English \& Tamil language is mandatory.
* Proficiency in MS Office and digital reporting systems.


**Performance may be evaluated based on:**


* Timely completion of assigned verification activities
* Accuracy and completeness of verification reports
* Quality and sufficiency of objective evidence
* Compliance with verification procedures
* Technical competency and consistency
* Timely closure of technical review comments
* Client communication and professional conduct
* Compliance with impartiality and confidentiality requirements

From our roots in agricultural inspections, Control Union have been operating for over 100 years and by now are engaged in many fields including inspections, certifications, logistics, collateral management and risk management etc. Our in\-depth knowledge and experience covers all aspects of the supply chain in many industries including agriculture, textile, energy, forestry and sustainability etc.

Bid and Project Management competencies are to be defined and developed as per Learning and Development roadmap for the academy to ensure a global approach across Regions and Product Lines.

Main point of contact reporting to the Senior Training Manager for all operational aspects of competence development regarding the global training offer and the Academy digital learning global catalog offer in Alstom University.


Continuously develop and update based on defined job competencies, the learning and development strategy to cover growing community and business demand of Alstom operating model.

Align with other function / métiers, Alstom University and HR, across all Regions and Product Lines to ensure a high level of competency development.

* Build a strong link between the competency matrixes for each Métier and the learning curriculum. Based on available learning material and yearly competency development gap analysis per métier, identify weak areas and propose corrective actions for training development.

  


* Coordinate training definition, design developments including updates/enhancements of training material with Subject Matter Experts and potentially external agencies.

If an external development is needed, support Request for Proposal process by synthesizing request and following up proposals and selection.


If an internal development is needed, Create/Review training material to ensure compliance with objectives and user\-friendly digital training experience in partnership when required with Alstom University for complex developments.

title: Jr. Associate - Environmental compliance
description:
Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6\.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded  

in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim, who today remains the company’s Chairman.  

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial  

services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across  

the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the  

Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of  

the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian  

flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that  

affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.  

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company.  

We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form  

part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our  

shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions  

including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement  

opportunities for our employees.


The essential elements of the position include:

* Works with Corporate, Field Compliance Managers, Branch Managers, Process/Disposal facility Managers,
* Transportation Compliance and Regulatory Agencies daily.
* Manages the regulatory reporting and associated fees for the company’s locations and fleets to maintain
* compliance with the regulatory requirements.
* Must be flexible each Q1 to work extended periods of time to meet the regulatory dictated deadlines.
* Understanding of chemical compositions.
* Coordinate changes to regulatory reports with MIS, provide overviews of the desired result, and perform
* detailed testing.
* Provide training as needed for the field and co\-workers.
* Update SOPs for regulatory reporting and internal processes.
* Other compliance projects, as requested.

**Competencies:**


Knowledge of:

* US DOT (Dept of Transportation)
* RCRA (Resource Conservation Recovery Act)
* NPDES (National Pollution Discharge Elimination System)
* CWA (Clean Water Act)
* US/STATE EPA (Environmental Protection Agencies)
* Canadian MOE regulations (Ministry of Environment)

  

* Excellent communication (in English) oral and written.
* Work well as a team, independently and under pressure.
* Must demonstrate excellent organizational and time management skills
* Deadline oriented (prioritize projects according to meet the deadlines)
* Able to manage projects effectively and accurately under pressure.
* High diligence, motivated and initiative\-taker.
* Above average competencies in Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Effectively and professionally work with any level of management or regulatory agency.
* Familiar with different process/disposal facilities and methods of waste management (preferred).


Education/Experience:

* Degree in Environmental Science, chemistry or in a related field (required)
* US DOT and RCRA Certifications (preferred)
* Minimum of 1 year employment history in a related field.

The Senior HR Manager is responsible for overseeing and executing all aspects of human resources management, including talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, compliance, training, and development. **Skills and Competencies:**

* Strong leadership and decision\-making abilities.

title: Control Business Partner – ICG / TIPMO / Others
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Job Description:** Control Business Partner – TIPMO / ICG / Others (Suggested Designation : Infrastructure Risk \& Control Analyst – TIPMO / Shared Governance)

**Location:** Pune

**Job Description**
-------------------


Northern Trust is seeking a new team member to join the Infrastructure Control Governance team as a Control Business Partner aligned to TIPMO, ICG, and other shared governance functions. This role will provide embedded advisory support across project governance, infrastructure delivery oversight, reporting, documentation, and cross\-functional control activities. The position will work closely with project managers, TIPMO governance, ADO capability teams, ICG leads, and infrastructure stakeholders to improve control execution, strengthen evidence quality, surface risks early, and support a disciplined governance operating model across project and shared service functions.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* **Project \& Governance Risk Support –** Assess risks and controls across TIPMO and related governance activities including initiation, planning, execution, change control, closure, reporting, and project artifact quality.
* **Control Design \& Operating Effectiveness Reviews –** Evaluate design and operating effectiveness of key project governance and shared\-service controls; identify control gaps, process breakdowns, and opportunities to simplify or automate governance activities.
* **Planning \& Approval Readiness –** Support review of project planning artifacts, risk mitigation plans, communication plans, governance gates, and design approval evidence to improve readiness and consistency before projects move forward.
* **Issue \& Action Plan Governance –** Partner with owners to track governance\-related findings and action plans, validate remediation quality, and escalate aging or high\-impact items to the appropriate leadership forums.
* **KRI / KPI \& Executive Reporting –** Prepare metrics, dashboards, and concise reporting views on project governance health, delivery risk, artifact compliance, and recurring themes for leadership, control meetings, and oversight councils.
* **Documentation \& Evidence Management –** Help ensure project and governance documentation is complete, current, version controlled, and audit\-ready across repositories such as SharePoint, ADO, OneNote, Clarity, and associated tooling.
* **ADO / ServiceNow / Governance Tooling Advisory –** Support the practical use of enterprise tooling for planning, tracking, evidence retention, and governance transparency; identify enhancements that strengthen traceability and control consistency.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination –** Serve as a liaison among TIPMO governance, ADO capability teams, infrastructure stakeholders, control officers, and ICG functions to align expectations, close gaps, and improve response times.
* **Broader Shared Governance Support –** Provide flexible risk and control support to adjacent ICG or other shared governance domains as priorities evolve, including audit support, reporting initiatives, documentation governance, and operational process reviews.
* **Assessment Documentation \& Evidence –** Produce audit\-ready assessment packs, walkthrough records, risk summaries, and evidence repositories using approved tools and templates with strong version control and traceability. Participate in RCSA exercise for Infrastructure Tower RAU.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**
-------------------


As a partner at Northern Trust, you must actively manage and mitigate risk and act with integrity. In accordance with our core values of service, integrity, and expertise, you are expected to:

* Adhere to all applicable risk management programs, policies, and procedures.
* Complete all mandatory training by the deadline.
* Understand how your behavior could expose Northern Trust, its clients, and financial markets to different types of risk.
* Ensure that Northern Trust or its clients are not exposed to inappropriate or excessive risk.
* Escalate any risk concerns, including those resulting from mistakes / errors to a manager or business unit risk officer.
* Exercise diligence regarding cybersecurity.
* Cooperate with internal control functions (including first\-line Control, Risk, Compliance, Audit, self\-assigned, etc.) and applicable regulatory bodies.
* Avoid conflicts of interest or behaviors that might produce unfair outcomes for Northern Trust or its clients or damage the integrity of financial markets.

**Must Haves**
--------------

* Proven experience in Infrastructure Control, IT Risk Management, PMO / project governance, infrastructure delivery oversight, or audit / compliance support.
* Strong understanding of project lifecycle governance, artifact quality, action tracking, reporting disciplines, and change / issue governance in a regulated technology environment.
* Hands\-on experience with ADO, ServiceNow, SharePoint, OneNote, Power BI, and / or Clarity PPM, with the ability to use these platforms to strengthen governance and transparency.
* Ability to assess adherence to defined processes, translate operational observations into risk\-based conclusions, and drive action with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, meeting facilitation, and follow\-up discipline with strong attention to detail and delivery quality.
* Comfort operating across multiple workstreams, resolving ambiguity, and balancing advisory support with execution rigor.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* CISA, CRISC, PMP, Agile / Scrum, ITIL, or equivalent governance / delivery credentials.
* Knowledge of SDM, Paragon or comparable project governance frameworks, control libraries, and audit / regulatory expectations within financial services.
* Experience supporting documentation governance, control metrics, or broader ICG tower initiatives.

**Qualification**
-----------------

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Project Management, Business Systems, Risk Management, or related field.
* 8\-10\+ years of experience in project governance, infrastructure controls, IT risk, delivery oversight, or related governance functions.

*\- End of Document* *\-*

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

description:

Area of Expertise: Banking Operations


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000112624


  
Step into the role of Transaction Monitoring QC People Leader at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct.


You will manage business operations by driving process efficiency, risk management, compliance, and performance improvement initiatives. Partner with internal stakeholders to optimize operational processes, enhance service delivery, and support the achievement of business objectives through data\-driven decision\-making.


You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:


* Own QC governance across the function, ensuring consistent application of sampling methodology, defect classification, and quality standards.
* Lead quality calibration across QC \& Operations to drive standardization and minimize subjectivity in decision making.
* Drive defect trend analysis and thematic RCA to identify systemic gaps and feed into process enhancements, controls, and training interventions.
* Partner with key stakeholders to run forums, drive accountability and ensure closure of quality actions as per the requirement.
* Apply strong judgement in quality assessment, ensuring accuracy, completeness and adherence to AML/TM policies and procedures.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of AML/TM controls, QC frameworks, and risk\-based assurance to strengthen overall control environment.
* Drive high\-quality coaching and structured feedback to improve investigator capability and embed sustainable quality improvements.

Desirable skills set:


* Strong operations management and process improvement experience with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Excellent analytical skills with experience in KPI reporting, performance monitoring, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.
* Knowledge of risk management, compliance, governance frameworks, and operational controls.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.


This role is based out of Pune.


**Purpose of the role**


To manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives and compliance with relevant regulators.


**Accountabilities**


* Identification of trends and opportunities to improve areas and develop new process and procedures through the monitoring and analysis of operation data and performance metrices.
* Management of operations for a business area and promote efficient processes, risk management and compliance initiatives to support the bank's operations.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders (including business leaders, project manager and SMEs) and external stakeholders (including vendors and service providers) to support business operations and promote alignment with the bank's objectives and SLAs.
* Management of operational professionals and provide guidance, coaching and support to improve colleagues' delivery quality.
* Management and development of KPIs to measure the effectiveness of operation functions, utilising data and technology to support the identification of areas that require improvement.
* Compliance with all regulatory requirements and internal policies related to customer experience.
* Creation of a safe environment for colleagues to speak up, actively and regularly encourage and solicit feedback to ensure people agenda remains focused on the right areas.
* Management of attrition by working closely with HR in implementing retention initiatives for work force.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**


* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Description:

The HR Shared Services Administrator delivers accurate, timely and compliant HR administration across the employee lifecycle, covering onboarding, employee changes, contractual documentation, HR systems,payroll coordination and offboarding. The role provides a consistent and responsive service to employees, managers and the wider People Team, while maintaining accurate records, supporting standardised global processes and ensuring approved HR activities are executed efficiently and with appropriate control.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Employee Lifecycle Administration**

*Drives Results • Ensures Accountability • Customer Focus*

* Manage HR administration across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding through to offboarding.
* Prepare offer letters, contracts and employment documentation using approved country templates.
* Process approved employee changes including promotions, transfers, salary changes, working arrangements and contractual amendments.
* Coordinate probation administration and employee exit processes, ensuring required actions and documentation are completed on time.
* Maintain complete, accurate and compliant employee records and personnel files.

**HR Systems \& Data Administration**

*Ensures Accountability • Drives Results • Collaborates*

* Maintain accurate employee data within Paylocity and other HR systems.
* Manage onboarding workflows and move approved candidates from recruitment through to onboarding.
* Maintain employee master data, organisational structures and reporting relationships.
* Monitor workflow completion and follow up outstanding documentation or actions.
* Maintain high standards of HR data quality, confidentiality and integrity.

**Payroll \& Benefits Coordination**

*Ensures Accountability • Customer Focus • Collaborates*

* Coordinate payroll administration for new starters, employee changes and leavers within agreed payroll deadlines.
* Ensure payroll information and supporting documentation are accurate and complete before submission.
* Support benefits enrolment and routine benefits administration.
* Liaise with Payroll and external providers to resolve routine queries and support accurate employee processing.

**HR Service, Documentation \& Compliance**

*Customer Focus • Collaborates • Courage • Ensures Accountability*

* Act as a first point of contact for routine HR administrative enquiries from employees and managers.
* Manage shared HR mailboxes and provide timely guidance on standard HR processes, documentation and systems.
* Maintain approved HR templates and ensure employment documentation follows relevant country and company requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records and audit trails in accordance with data privacy, document retention and compliance requirements.
* Escalate employee relations, policy or other non\-routine matters to the appropriate HR Business Partner.

**Process Improvement \& Reporting**

*Drives Results • Ensures Accountability • Collaborates*

* Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation and guidance for HR Shared Services activities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service delivery and reduce manual administration through HR system workflows and automation.
* Produce routine HR reports and monitor key activities including onboarding, probation and outstanding employee actions.
* Support HR audits, compliance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives across HR Shared Services.

**Our Values in Action:**

* **Be Humble and Curious:** by learning from colleagues, asking questions and looking for practical ways to improve HR processes and service delivery.
* **Inspire, Empower and Prosper:** by providing reliable HR support that enables employees, managers and colleagues to succeed.
* **Team Up to Be Better:** by working collaboratively across the People Team, Payroll and other functions to deliver a consistent employee experience.
* **Be Passionate About Our Customers:** by providing accurate, responsive and professional HR support to employees and managers.
* **Take Ownership and Get Stuff Done:** by completing HR administration accurately, on time and with clear accountability for follow\-through.
* **Be Eager to Win:** by looking for ways to simplify administration, improve service levels and make better use of HR systems.
* **Build a Better Future:** by supporting scalable, efficient and compliant HR processes that enable Unilode’s continued growth.

**The Small Print**


This role operates within a global HR Shared Services environment supporting employees and managers across multiple countries and time zones. The successful individual will be expected to manage competing priorities while maintaining high standards of accuracy, confidentiality, compliance and customer service.


This job description outlines the general scope and expectations of the role and is not intended to represent a complete or exhaustive list of responsibilities. Duties may evolve in line with business requirements and the continued development of Unilode’s HR Shared Services model.


Requirements:
**Experience \& Skills**

* Experience in HR Administration, HR Operations or HR Shared Services.
* Good understanding of the employee lifecycle and standard HR administration processes.
* Experience preparing employment contracts and HR documentation.
* Experience using an HRIS such as Paylocity or a similar platform.
* Basic understanding of payroll administration and employee change processes.
* Strong organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work within agreed deadlines.
* Strong customer service orientation with a proactive and reliable approach.
* Ability to handle confidential employee information with professionalism and discretion.
* Confidence working with HR systems, employee data and standard process controls.

* Utilize MIS, people analytics, data reporting, and visualization to generate meaningful insights that support business and people decisions. Maintain a high standard of data accuracy across systems and periodically review reports and employee data to ensure reliability.

Partner with HRBPs and relevant COEs to implement initiatives across talent management, organizational development, employee engagement, and other people priorities.

* Promote ethical behavior and professional conduct across the organization. Stay informed about relevant global compliance, employment practices, and benefits requirements to support a compliant and ethical workplace.
* Partner with managers and HR stakeholders to address employee relations matters, including conflict resolution, performance concerns, disciplinary actions, grievances, and other sensitive employee situations, ensuring appropriate and timely resolution.
* Support Compensation \& Benefits (C\&B) and People Operations requirements for the supported business, including compensation benchmarking and analysis, compensation review exercises, benefits\-related data requirements, employee data audits, and other operational activities. Partner closely with relevant COEs and central teams to ensure timely and accurate execution.
* Contribute to central and cross\-functional HR projects beyond the immediate Business Unit, as required. This may include workforce and headcount analysis, compensation or talent analytics, organizational data reviews, benchmarking exercises, HR process improvements, audits, and other ad\-hoc analytical or operational requirements.
* Undertake data\-driven deep dives and special projects based on evolving business or organizational needs. Work with multiple stakeholders to structure ambiguous problems, analyze relevant data, derive actionable insights, and support recommendations and execution.

* 5\+ years of solid HR/Business Partnering experience, preferably within a fast\-paced, high\-growth technology organization.
* Strong understanding of core HR practices, with hands\-on exposure to areas such as employee engagement, performance management, talent management, employee relations, people analytics, and HR operations.

* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with a high degree of discretion and judgment.

* Free lunch \& dinner buffet
* Doorstep cab drop facility
* Education sponsorship

description:
**HR \& Admin Executive / HR Generalist**

**Company:** Ocean Clicks Outsourcing Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time \- On Site (1:00 PM to 11:00 PM; candidates must be flexible with their schedule, as working hours may change depending on office requirements)  
**Experience:** 0–5 years (freshers are welcome if they have a relevant degree in Human Resources)  
**Department:** Human Resources \& Administration  
**Salary:** upto 35k

**About the Role:\-**

We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and people\-oriented **HR \& Admin Executive / HR Generalist** to manage the day\-to\-day HR and administrative operations of our organization.

This role is ideal for someone who can work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, handle employees confidently, coordinate with management, and ensure that the office runs smoothly on a daily basis.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable wearing multiple hats from recruitment and employee support to attendance, payroll coordination, office administration, asset management, vendor coordination, and handling unexpected day\-to\-day requirements.

You will be the **go\-to person for HR, employees, management, and general office\-related requirements.**

**Key Responsibilities:\-\-**

**HR Operations**

* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations and employee\-related activities.
* Handle employee attendance, leave records, and biometric systems.
* Monitor employee attendance and ensure compliance with company policies.
* Prepare and maintain HR records, employee files, and documentation.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, salary\-related information, incentives, deductions, and other payroll requirements.
* Handle employee onboarding and offboarding processes.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, relieving letters, and other HR documents.
* Maintain employee databases and HR records accurately.
* Assist with PF, ESIC, and other basic statutory compliance\-related activities.
* Address employee queries, concerns, and grievances professionally.
* Provide employee support and maintain a positive workplace environment.
* Assist employees with HR\-related and workplace concerns.
* Prepare and issue employee ID cards and maintain related records.

**Recruitment \& Hiring**

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment activities for various positions.
* Source candidates through job portals, recruitment platforms, colleges, references, and other channels.
* Screen CVs and conduct initial candidate screening.
* Schedule and conduct interviews as required.
* Coordinate interview rounds with management.
* Manage candidate communication and follow\-ups.

**Administration \& Office Management**

* Organize and coordinate office events, employee activities, client visits, meetings, and other company activities.
* Act as the primary point of contact for unexpected office requirements and ensure issues are resolved promptly.

**Asset \& Resource Management**

* Maintain records of company assets including laptops, computers, monitors, headphones, keyboards, chairs, and other office equipment.
* Manage allocation and tracking of employee assets.
* Coordinate laptop/device/accessory requirements for new and existing employees.

* Ensure employees have the required equipment and resources to perform their jobs effectively.

**Employee \& Workplace Management**

* Monitor employee breaks and workplace discipline.
* Ensure employees follow company policies regarding attendance, ID cards, workplace conduct, and other internal rules.

* Verify employee incentive information and coordinate with management.
* Assist in maintaining a professional and positive workplace environment.
* Handle employee concerns with maturity, confidentiality, and empathy.
* Support employee engagement activities, celebrations, group activities, and internal events.

**Management Support**

* Schedule meetings, appointments, and internal discussions.
* Coordinate meeting arrangements and ensure relevant participants are informed.
* Assist management with HR, employee, administrative, and operational requirements.

**What We Are Looking For**

The right candidate should be **proactive, responsible, approachable, organized, and capable of identifying and solving problems independently.**

If an employee has an issue, a vendor needs to be coordinated with, an asset needs to be arranged, an interview needs to be scheduled, an office event needs to be organized, or management needs something handled urgently **you should be someone who can take ownership and get it done.**

title: Senior Associate Workforce Planning
description:
**About the Role**
------------------



Support Operations is one of our core operations teams, responsible for making sure that when things go wrong, there's always someone there to make it right. The team designs, manages, and operates a large and growing global network of support centers, with the goal of delivering a world\-class customer experience every time.



We're looking for an experienced Workforce Planner to help develop and scale our support lines of business. This role is central to planning monthly, daily, and hourly staffing levels, and to keeping hiring plans current so we consistently deliver best\-in\-class service. You'll play a key part in improving forecast accuracy, reporting, and how we plan around floor staff utilization and efficiency — for a 24/7/365 organization, wherever it operates.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


**Capacity planning**


* Build and maintain support capacity plan models at the monthly, weekly, and interval level, using a quantitative model to determine the staff required to service forecasted volumes
* Match staffing supply to required staff to ensure efficient service level attainment, and make hiring, ramp, and staff\-reduction recommendations
* Keep capacity plans and assumptions accurate, current, and aligned to source\-of\-truth headcount data, auditing regularly for accuracy
* Ensure alignment from the smallest site/team level of detail up through the broader org\-wide capacity plan
* Maintain documentation of planning methodology, assumptions, and processes, and continually improve the planning tools, models, and templates themselves


**Forecasting \& scenario planning**


* Forecast incoming contact volume using historical and benchmark data, tracking deviations between forecast and actuals on a regular cadence
* Build, update, and present "what\-if" scenarios to evaluate potential changes and support upcoming initiatives, as well as annual, half\-year, and quarterly planning scenarios for long\-range and financial planning
* Build and validate capacity models for new lines of business, queues, or markets, and identify overtime activation needs while ensuring compliance with local labor regulations in each region you support
* Build out and report on seasonality trends for a complex, growing organization


**Performance \& insights**


* Dig into historical data to surface insights that improve support operations, speed, quality, and customer experience
* Monitor service level performance, perform SL\-miss analysis, and feed those insights back into planning


**Staffing \& headcount**


* Guide short\-term staffing adjustments to close current gaps, and partner with Operations to track how staffing is implemented and optimized, driving proactive and corrective improvements
* Reconcile planned vs. actual headcount and budget with Finance/HR, monitor the hiring pipeline against plan, and track new\-hire ramp against expected productivity curves
* Maintain a risk register or contingency plan for capacity gaps such as surges, outages, or attrition spikes, and incorporate attrition, absenteeism, and other shrinkage assumptions into the model


**Cross\-functional partnership**


* Partner with Real Time Analysts for demand insight and outage reporting
* Partner with teams across operations, customer experience, product, engineering, and tools to improve processes and the resulting experience for customers and partners
* Hold regular capacity plan reviews with leadership, and flag service level risks — with supporting analysis and a recommended mitigation plan — for upcoming projects and initiatives
* Own your recommendations end\-to\-end: dig into the data, build the model, set implementation timelines, align partners, test ideas, and measure results

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You're analytical and data\-driven — you love getting into the weeds, and you let data win arguments
* You enjoy tackling complex problems and building something that hasn't existed before
* You're well\-organized and detail\-oriented, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* You follow up and follow through — you execute and get the job done
* You're comfortable in a fast\-paced, constantly changing, team\-oriented environment, and can manage multiple deadlines at once
* You have an owner mentality: quality\-focused, output\-driven, proactive, and always pushing yourself to do better
* You bring creative solutions to big challenges
* You're comfortable operating at the lowest level of detail while also thinking long\-term and inspiring a team
* You're energized by rapid change and constant learning
* You're comfortable pulling data or modeling in Excel/Google Sheets
* You don't give up — if your first plan doesn't work, you have a few more in your back pocket
* You have 4\-6 years of relevant experience, having succeeded in diverse environments (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or similar)
* You have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* You bring hands\-on experience with workforce management software (e.g., NICE, Verint, Genesys, or Aspect) and advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; SQL experience is a plus

**About DoorDash**
==================



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.



DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
=============================================



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
