Job Title: US Recruiter

Location: India (Remote)

Shift: Night Shift (US Hours \- EST/CST/PST alignment)

Experience: 1 \- 4 years in US Recruitment (Non\-IT / Insurance preferred)

**Job Summary**

B.O.D. Services is seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Recruiter to join our Recruitment Department. The Recruiter is a key member of the sourcing team, responsible for identifying, vetting, and placing high\-quality candidates with our insurance agency clients. This role requires strong relationship\-building skills, sound judgment in candidate evaluation, and the ability to manage multiple requirements simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.

**Position Overview**

The Recruiter plays an important role in keeping things running smoothly across the hiring and client processes. In this role, the Recruiter will handle a variety of tasks, support day\-to\-day operations, and help manage both candidate and client activities. He/she will also build strong, positive relationships with everyone involved, from teammates to clients and candidates.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Requirement Management**

* Receive and review new candidate requirements assigned by the Recruiting Manager.
* Review the agent's account and research the agent's website to gain deeper insight into their agency and needs.
* Source and share suitable candidate profiles with the agent within the required 48\-hour window.

**Candidate Sourcing**

* Identify candidates through multiple channels: the existing candidate pool, Indeed applications, LinkedIn candidate referrals, and the Salesforce database.
* Vet and shortlist candidates according to role type (Sales, Service, or Hybrid) and the specific requirements of the agent.
* Screen resumes for employment stability, language skills, and prior insurance experience.

**Candidate Vetting \& Intake**

* Conduct thorough candidate intakes. Ask targeted role\-specific vetting questions.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Prior experience in recruiting, staffing, or talent acquisition preferred; insurance industry experience is a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust with agents and candidates.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple open requirements simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.
* Working knowledge of, or willingness to learn, Salesforce CRM and related recruiting tools.
* Familiarity with insurance industry is an advantage.
* Sound judgment and attention to detail when screening resumes, conducting intakes, and performing reference checks.
* Self\-motivated, adaptable, and results\-driven, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Intern or atleast 1 year of experience.
* Ability to work across several time zones including EST, CST, PST and Mountain time.
* Must be able to accept position without guardian/parent.

title: Workforce Transformation HR Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
===============


The Workforce Transformation Analyst supports the design, analysis, and implementation of initiatives that reshape how the organization's workforce operates — including workforce planning, skills\-based talent strategies, organizational restructuring, automation/AI adoption impacts, and change management. This role combines data analysis, strategic thinking, and project execution to help the organization anticipate future talent needs and adapt its workforce model to meet evolving business demands.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Analyze current workforce data (headcount, skills, roles, costs, attrition) to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and transformation opportunities
* Support workforce planning models that forecast future talent needs based on business strategy, technology adoption, and market trends
* Assess the impact of automation, AI, and process changes on roles, skills requirements, and staffing levels
* Develop skills taxonomies and competency frameworks to support reskilling/upskilling initiatives
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders to design organizational structures that align with strategic goals
* Build dashboards and reports (e.g., in Excel, Power BI, Tableau) to track workforce transformation KPIs and present findings to leadership
* Support change management efforts, including communication plans, training needs assessments, and stakeholder engagement
* Conduct benchmarking and market research on workforce trends, labor market shifts, and industry best practices
* Assist in developing business cases for workforce restructuring, redeployment, or reduction initiatives
* Document processes, playbooks, and standard methodologies for workforce transformation projects

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Organizational Psychology, or related field
* 2–5 years of experience in HR analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, management consulting, or a related analytical role
* Strong proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, modeling); experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) a plus
* Familiarity with HRIS systems (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar)
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings to non\-technical stakeholders
* Project management skills and comfort working across cross\-functional teams

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Master's degree in a related field, or HR certification (SHRM\-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR)
* Experience with change management frameworks (Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter's model)
* Exposure to workforce automation, AI impact assessments, or future\-of\-work research
* Consulting background in organizational transformation or workforce strategy
* Experience with statistical analysis tools (SQL, R, or Python) for advanced workforce modeling

**Key Competencies**
====================

* Analytical rigor and data\-driven decision making
* Strategic and systems thinking
* Stakeholder management and influence
* Adaptability in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Strong written and verbal communication

**Internship Opportunity: Project Coordinator/Scrum Master\- Intern**

**Location:** Remote (Work From Home)  
**Working Hours:** Full\-Time (8 Hours/Day)  
**Stipend:** Performance\-Based (To be decided after successful completion of the first 3 months)  
**Eligibility:** Freshers or candidates looking for internship

**Apply Now:** Send your resume to **career@sutramsolutions.in**

**About Sutram Solutions**

Sutram Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an early\-stage startup building AI\-powered Educational ERP and Learning Management Systems (LMS). Our mission is to transform educational institutions through intelligent automation, seamless digital experiences, and scalable technology.

We are looking for a highly organized, analytical, and proactive P**roject Analyst Intern** to support the end\-to\-end execution of technology and **product development projects**. The intern will work closely with project managers, developers, QA engineers, designers, AI/ML teams, mobile app teams, content teams, and management to ensure projects are properly planned, tracked, tested, validated, documented, and delivered on time. The role involves managing project management tools such as Jira, ClickUp, Trello, or similar platforms, coordinating daily **Scrum activities, collecting and consolidating team status**, maintaining product and delivery pipelines, tracking sprint progress, identifying blockers and delays, coordinating QA activities, validating product functionality, preparing project reports, and supporting continuous improvement. The ideal candidate should have strong organizational skills, attention to detail, communication skills, analytical thinking, ownership, and an interest in **Project Management, Product Management, Business Analysis, QA, and Technology Operations**.

This internship is designed for freshers who are willing to work on real\-world projects while learning industry\-standard software project management.

Internship Overview

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and facilitate daily Scrum or stand\-up meetings and collect status updates from team members.
* Track daily progress of development, QA, AI/ML, mobile app, frontend, backend, and other project teams.
* Maintain Jira, ClickUp, Trello, or other project management tools with accurate task information.
* Create and update tasks, subtasks, user stories, bugs, priorities, owners, deadlines, and statuses.
* Maintain product backlog, sprint backlog, project boards, and delivery pipelines.
* Track tasks through the complete workflow from To Do to In Progress, QA, UAT, and Completed.
* Follow up with team members on pending, overdue, blocked, and high\-priority tasks.
* Identify project blockers, dependencies, risks, and potential delivery delays and escalate them when required.
* Assist in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and project review meetings.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly project status reports for management.
* Prepare and maintain product feature pipelines and delivery plans.
* Track project milestones, sprint goals, feature completion, release readiness, and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate between management, developers, QA engineers, designers, AI/ML teams, mobile teams, and content teams.
* Coordinate QA activities for completed development tasks.
* Perform basic functional testing and user\-level validation of completed features.
* Validate implemented features against requirements, workflows, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes.
* Prepare basic test scenarios and test cases when required.
* Identify functional, UI, workflow, usability, and content\-related issues.
* Log bugs and issues in Jira or the designated project management system.
* Coordinate bug resolution between developers and QA teams and verify fixes after completion.
* Support regression testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Maintain QA status, defect tracking, and release\-readiness information.
* Review requirements and identify missing information, ambiguities, dependencies, and edge cases.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to clarify project and product requirements.
* Assist in preparing feature documentation, acceptance criteria, release notes, and user documentation.
* Validate product workflows, website content, mobile application functionality, ERP features, LMS features, and other digital products.
* Assist in creating product\-related content, feature descriptions, internal documentation, product guides, presentations, and demo material.
* Review marketing and product content to ensure that information accurately represents actual product functionality.
* Maintain project documentation, meeting minutes, action\-item trackers, and decision logs.
* Prepare Excel or Google Sheets reports for project tracking, analysis, and management review.
* Create basic charts, dashboards, and analytics related to project progress and team performance.
* Analyze project data to identify bottlenecks, recurring issues, delays, and process improvement opportunities.
* Track sprint velocity, task completion, defect trends, delivery performance, and project health.
* Support continuous improvement of project execution, Scrum processes, QA workflows, and reporting systems.
* Assist management in preparing project review presentations and performance summaries.
* Take ownership of assigned project coordination activities and ensure timely completion.

Eligibility Criteria

* Freshers or candidates with 0–1 years of experience.
* Students or recent graduates interested in Project Management, Product Management, Business Analysis, QA, or Technology Operations.
* Basic understanding of software development and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) is preferred.
* Basic understanding of Agile and Scrum methodology is preferred.
* Willingness to learn and work with Jira, ClickUp, Trello, or similar project management tools.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines.
* Self\-motivated and capable of working independently.
* Ability to follow up with team members and maintain execution discipline.
* Basic understanding of web and mobile applications is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of QA, software testing, or UAT is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of APIs, databases, frontend, backend, or mobile application development is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Ability to prepare reports, presentations, documentation, and project trackers.
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* Strong ownership and willingness to learn.

Continuation with the company will be entirely performance\-based.

Go through the JD \& fill the Google Form available on the Careers page and submit your application.

description:
**The Company**
 Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
   

  

 We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
   

  

**Meet The Team**
 We’re a collaborative and innovative software quality team focused on ensuring the reliability and performance of Dexcom’s continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems. Our mission is to build quality into every stage of the development lifecycle through smart automation, rigorous testing, and a passion for improving lives. If you're eager to grow your skills while contributing to life\-changing technology, this is the team for you.
   

  

**Where You Come In**
* You participate in building quality into products by writing automated tests and performing ad hoc testing throughout the development cycle.
* You contribute to the development of software requirements and design specifications.
* You design, develop, execute, and maintain both automated and manual test scripts to validate Dexcom CGM software and systems.
* You create verification and validation test plans, traceability matrices, and test reports, and review them with relevant stakeholders.
* You record and track issues using the bug tracking system.
* You analyze test failures and collaborate with development teams to investigate root causes.
* You contribute to continuous improvement of the release process.


**What Makes You Successful**
* You have 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in software development or software test development using Python or other object\-oriented programming languages.
* You have experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* You bring experience in automated test development for API testing.
* You have worked with a variety of automated testing frameworks, including Robot Framework.
* Your strong understanding of API testing, microservices, and distributed systems in cloud environments sets you apart.
* You have experience with automated UI testing.
* You are familiar with cloud platforms like Google Cloud or AWS.
* You have experience with containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* You may have experience in the medical device industry and familiarity with FDA design control processes (highly desired).
* Your knowledge of GCP tools like Airflow, Dataflow, and BigQuery is a plus.
* Experience with distributed event streaming platforms like Kafka is a plus.
* Experience with performance testing is a plus.
* You bring CI/CD experience, especially with cloud\-based technologies.
* You have five or more years of Agile development and test development experience.
* You collaborate effectively across functions to support testing, deployment, and reporting on product performance, quality, security, and stability.
* You are a self\-starter who works well with minimal guidance and communicates clearly both verbally and in writing.


**What You’ll Get**
* A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community.
* A full and comprehensive benefits program.
* Growth opportunities on a global scale.
* Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

* Design and develop switchgear assemblies, electrical panel enclosures, mechanical components, frames, and sheet metal assemblies in compliance with applicable international and national standards such as IEC, UL, and IS.
* Create detailed 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings, assembly drawings, and Bills of Materials (BOMs) using SolidWorks and AutoCAD.
* Manage end\-to\-end type test activities, including sample preparation, documentation, laboratory coordination, test witnessing, and design updates based on test results.
* Travel as required to NABL\- testing laboratories (Such as ERDA ,CPRI ) to coordinate, witness, and ensure the successful completion of product type testing and certification activities. Travel to supplier facilities and customer sites may also be required to support prototype evaluation and technical activities.
* Collaborate closely with the Electrical Design Engineering team to ensure seamless integration of mechanical and electrical systems within switchgear and control panel assemblies.
* Support New Product Development (NPD) activities by developing innovative, manufacturable, and cost\-effective mechanical designs from concept through production release.
* Perform design validation, prototype evaluation, and engineering analysis to verify product performance, functionality, reliability, and compliance with applicable standards.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for cost reduction, product enhancement, standardization, and manufacturing efficiency without compromising safety, quality, or performance.
* Provide technical support to production, fabrication, and assembly teams by resolving design related issues and implementing engineering changes during manufacturing.
* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors for sourcing mechanical components and fabricated parts, ensuring compliance with technical specifications, quality requirements, and cost targets.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **B.E./****B.Tech** **in Mechanical Engineering – Mandatory.**
* Candidates with relevant internship/project experience in sheet metal, electrical panels or industrial product development will be preferred.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* **1–2 years of experience** in Mechanical Design / NPD / Product Development.
* Experience in **LV Control Panel, Switchgear, Electrical Panel, Sheet Metal or Enclosure Manufacturing** is preferred.
* Freshers with strong Mechanical Design and AutoCAD skills may also be considered.

title: Associate Technical Engineer – Cybersecurity
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
   

  

 Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked \#153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full\-stack portfolio of AI\-enabled, AI\-ready, and AI\-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world\-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992\) (ADR: LNVGY).
   

  

 This transformation together with Lenovo’s world\-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
   

  

 Security Operations Centre (SOC) Analyst plays a vital role in Security delivery. As a SOC Analyst, you will be on the front line of Cyber Defense, detecting responding to Cyber Incidents as they happen. You will work with other team members to provide situational awareness through detection, containment, and remediation of IT threats. This job requires great attention to detail and general awareness of Cyber Security tools like SIEM, XDR, EDR, IDS/ IPS, ability understand various logs – network logs, sys logs, Firewall logs. As a SOC Analyst you are expected to have working knowledge in areas of networking, malware analysis, incident response, vulnerability management.
   

  

* Threat vulnerability analysis
* Investigate, document report Information security issues emerging trends
* Analysis response to unknown vulnerabilities


**Responsibilities**
 As a SOC Analyst – Level 1, you will:
   

  

* Monitor security logs and alerts from different security monitoring platforms and sources using SIEM and direct information on an advanced level
* Perform Triage on Incidents detected.
* Submit incidents for a follow\-up to functional maintenance.
* Track progress on incidents that have been submitted from outside of the SOC
* Resolve Incidents as per Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
* Propose and identify automation opportunities resulting from incidents.
* Prepare SOC Management Reports.
* Analyzing preparing daily and monthly reports based on the devices which are being monitored
* Creating Reports and Dashboards based on the customer requirement.
* Creating Reports which helps in providing the logs for the alerts, for finding any possible threats.
* Analyze a variety of network and host\-based security appliance logs (Firewalls, NIDS, HIDS, Sys Logs, etc.) to determine the correct remediation actions and escalation paths.
* Work under supervision of technical lead to accomplish assigned tasks.
* Change Management/ Implementation: Independently implement changes to meet customer infrastructure needs within area of technical responsibility
* Patch and Security Management: Apply patch and security changes per policy."
* Configuration Management: Ensure Configuration Management Database (CMDB) entries are complete and accurate.
* Quality: Provide continual improvement recommendations for direct responsibility area (process improvement, technical standard updates, etc).
* Project Management: Participate in customer and internal projects, including transformation.
* Customer Relationship Management: Set expectations with customers and/or internal businesses/end users within defined parameters.
* Teamwork: Work as part of a team, which may be virtual and/or global. Participate as part of a team and maintains good relationships with team members and customers


**Skill**
 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience
   

  

**Typical Skills Include**
* Sufficient depth and breadth of technical knowledge to be individually responsible for the implementation of a specific deliverable.
* Understanding of technology in direct responsibility (SIEM, XDR, EDR, MDR)
* General understanding of related technologies (Networking, Operating Systems)
* Customer Service
* General Project Management (Basic)
* Customer/Vendor Management (Basic)
* Able to communicate broad and specific concepts with team and to peers.
* Able to produce documentation for use by team and customer.
* Good verbal written communication skills
* Proactive approach to meet exceed goals


**Qualification**
 Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science
   

  

 Understanding of ITIL process
   

  

 Security related certifications (Security\+, CEH) will be an added advantage
   

  

**About Lenovo**
 At Lenovo, we are driven by our vision of
 **Smarter Technology for All** 
 —creating innovative technology that empowers individuals, businesses, and communities around the world. With a global team of more than
 **77,000 employees** 
 serving customers in over
 **180 markets** 
 , Lenovo is a leading technology company delivering intelligent devices, AI\-ready infrastructure, cloud solutions, and world\-class services.
   

  

 Our commitment to innovation, inclusion, and sustainability enables us to solve complex business challenges while creating technology that makes a meaningful difference. As AI reshapes every industry, Lenovo is at the forefront of helping customers realize its full potential through AI\-powered devices, Hybrid AI solutions, intelligent infrastructure, and AI\-enabled services.
   

  

 Joining Lenovo means working alongside talented professionals who are passionate about innovation and continuous learning, with opportunities to build expertise in AI, cybersecurity, cloud, automation, and next\-generation technologies. We empower our people with the tools, training, and global opportunities to grow their careers while contributing to our mission of delivering smarter, more secure, and more intelligent technology for everyone.

title: Generalist / Founder’s Associate — Early Career
description:
**What if your first job let you understand how an entire business works — instead of putting you inside one tiny department?**

I’m looking for a **curious, driven early\-career professional**. You’ll work directly with the Founder, gaining exposure to real business decisions, problems and opportunities that are rarely accessible to someone at the beginning of their career.

This isn't a traditional role with a fixed script.

You might work on operations one day, coordinate with an international client the next, test an AI tool, improve a process, solve a customer problem, work with our CRM, or support a marketing/business initiative.

**The common thread: you'll be expected to think, learn quickly, figure things out and take ownership.**

**About Chess Gaja**

**Chess Gaja** is a global online chess academy founded by **Grandmaster Priyadharshan Kannappan**, serving students across 5**0\+ countries**.

We combine world\-class chess coaching with structured operations, technology and automation to deliver a consistent experience to students and families around the world.

We're a growing business, and we're looking for people who don't just want a job — **but want to grow with the company.**

What you'll work on

The work will evolve as you grow. Depending on what the business needs and where your strengths develop, you could be involved in:

* Improving operational workflows and processes
* Coordinating with international clients, students and internal teams
* Exploring and implementing AI and digital tools
* Working with our CRM and business systems
* Identifying and solving day\-to\-day business problems
* Coordinating with coaches and other stakeholders
* Supporting marketing and business development initiatives
* Finding ways to make existing processes faster, simpler or better

You'll get exposure to multiple parts of the business rather than being confined to one department.

What this role can become

You may start by supporting different areas and learning how the business works.

As you become more capable, you'll progressively move from:

**Learning → Executing → Owning → Leading**

The goal is **not** for you to remain a trainee.

Over time, you'll be trusted with increasingly important projects, processes and business functions.

If you spend the next **1–2 years** here, I want you to come out with something far more valuable than just another job title:

**a strong practical understanding of how a real business works.**

You'll develop practical skills across operations, communication, technology, project coordination, problem\-solving and business fundamentals.

Who we're looking for

You don't need prior corporate experience. Freshers and early\-career professionals welcome

What matters more to us:

**Curiosity** — You genuinely want to understand how things work.

**Initiative** — When you don't know something, you make a reasonable attempt to figure it out before waiting for instructions.

**Common sense** — You can make good decisions without everything being explicitly spelled out.

**Communication** — You can communicate clearly, professionally and politely in English. You'll be interacting with international clients and teams, so strong written communication matters.

**Adaptability** — You're comfortable learning new software, systems and ways of working.

**Reliability** — You follow through on commitments and don't need to be constantly reminded.

**Process discipline** — You take pride in keeping things organized, following up properly and getting the small details right.

**Learning speed** — You pick things up quickly and apply what you've learned.

**Chess is a plus, but not a requirement.** If you play chess or regularly enjoy playing online, we'd love to know. A **1000\+ rating on Chess.com or Lichess** is a bonus, but we're equally happy to hear from casual players.

What you'll get exposure to

One of the advantages of this role is that you'll work with the actual systems and tools used to run a growing international business.

You'll get hands\-on experience with **Zoho One**, including its CRM and business automation capabilities, as well as other digital and AI tools.

You won't just learn these tools theoretically — **you'll use them to solve real business problems.**

This role may not be for you if...

You prefer:

* A rigid job description
* Doing the same type of work every day
* Being told exactly what to do at every step
* Waiting for someone else to solve problems
* A role where learning new tools or skills isn't part of the job

This opportunity is best suited to someone who wants to build **depth through breadth** early in their career and gradually take on more responsibility.

Role Details

* **Location:** Preferably Madurai. Exceptional candidates from elsewhere may also be considered.
* **Role:** Full\-time \| Generalist / Founder’s Associate — Early Career
* **During Probation Salary:** ₹16,000\-₹18,000/month
* **Post Probation Salary:** ₹18,000–₹20,000/month (There is a yearly retention bonus component part of the salary)
* **Experience:** Freshers and early\-career professionals welcome
* **Work environment:** International business serving students and families across 50\+ countries
* **Equipment:** You must have your own reliable laptop and mobile phone, along with a **50\+ Mbps internet connection** at home.

Important Terms — Please Read Before Applying

**Working Hours:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Other shifts, such as **5:00 AM – 2:00 PM** or **12:00 PM – 9:00 PM**, may be assigned after probation based on business requirements.

**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Weekly Off:** Sunday

**Probation:** 3 months

**Notice Period:** 2 months after successful completion of probation

**Joining:** We are looking for **immediate joiners only**.

**Leave Policy:** Our current leave policy can be viewed here:

https://workdrive.zohoexternal.in/external/04a4811f48c16dcc8e85ad7f1e80f32630f47ae0120c3cd4bb048572f17733ed

**Please review these terms carefully before applying.**

Please answer all the screening Qn \- In your own words. We value specific real examples over polished or generic answers.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Can you bring your own device? (Laptop and Mobile Phone)
* Do you have or have the ability to get Internet connection with an upload and download speed above 50Mbps?
* This is a remote role. However, candidates based in or around Madurai are preferred, as occasional visits to our registered office may be required for training, meetings, or coordination.
* Do you play Chess? If yes, please provide your Chess.com/Lichess username and current rating. (Type 'No' if you don't play).
* Tell us about something you learned or figured out on your own without anyone asking you to do it. What was it?
* Why are you interested in a Generalist / Founder’s Associate role rather than a specialized role in a single department?
* Imagine you are assigned a task but don't fully understand what is expected. What would you do?
* What is one skill you would genuinely like to become very good at over the next 12 months, and why?
* If you received another job offer paying ₹5,000 more after 4 months at Chess Gaja, what would make you stay?
* What do you want your career to look like 2 years from now?
* Tell us about a time when nobody was checking whether you were working, but you still had to get something important done. What did you do?
* This is a 6\-day working role, Monday–Saturday, from 9 AM–6 PM, with breaks. The role is remote, but occasional visits to our Madurai office may be required. Are you comfortable with this work arrangement for at least the next 12 months? Please explain.

You should be highly organized, proactive, confident, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment. Excellent communication, presentation, and problem\-solving skills are important.


**Freshers with exceptional communication skills, presentation abilities, and a strong passion to build a career in business and technology are welcome to apply.**

Whether you are an experienced professional or a fresher starting your career, **if you have the right attitude, strong communication and presentation skills, a willingness to learn, and the dedication to grow, we would love to meet you.**


Join a young and ambitious team, work with international clients, gain exposure to global projects, and build your future with a growing technology company.

title: Business Development Executive – IT Services
description:
Sales Business Development Executive – IT Services

**Company:** NextGen Info Solution  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Arrangement:** Fully Remote  
**Experience:** 0–2 years  
**Salary:** ₹1\.5–₹2\.5 lakh per year

About the Company

NextGen Info Solution provides web development and digital marketing services to businesses. Our services include website development, WordPress, eCommerce solutions, mobile applications, SEO, social media marketing, paid advertising, and website maintenance.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Sales Business Development Executive (BDE)** to support our business development activities and help identify and develop new business opportunities.

The role involves prospect research, lead generation, client communication, requirement understanding, follow\-ups, proposal coordination, and supporting the conversion of qualified prospects into clients.

This position is suitable for candidates interested in building a career in **B2B sales, IT services sales, and business development**.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify potential business clients through professional and business\-focused channels.
* Generate and qualify leads for IT and digital marketing services.
* Conduct prospect outreach through email, telephone, LinkedIn, and other approved channels.
* Understand client requirements related to websites, applications, SEO, digital marketing, and related services.
* Conduct introductory and discovery conversations with prospective clients.
* Explain relevant services based on the client's requirements.
* Prepare or coordinate proposals, quotations, and service information.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with prospective clients.
* Keep lead, prospect, and follow\-up information updated in the company's records.
* Coordinate with internal technical or delivery teams when additional project information is required.
* Maintain a professional relationship with prospects and clients.
* Support the development and management of the sales pipeline.
* Work toward agreed sales activity and business development targets.
* Provide regular updates regarding lead status, follow\-ups, opportunities, and potential closures.

Services

The BDE may work on business opportunities related to:

* Website Design and Development
* WordPress Development
* WooCommerce and eCommerce Development
* Custom Web Application Development
* Mobile App Development
* Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
* Social Media Marketing
* Pay\-Per\-Click (PPC) Advertising
* Digital Marketing
* Local SEO
* Website Maintenance and Support

Required Skills

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Professional communication with prospective clients.
* Basic understanding of B2B sales and business development.
* Interest in IT services and digital marketing.
* Ability to research and identify potential prospects.
* Comfortable with telephone, email, and LinkedIn outreach.
* Good follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to understand client requirements and communicate them internally.
* Good organizational and record\-keeping skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Willingness to work toward defined sales and activity goals.

Experience

**Preferred:** 1–2 years of experience in B2B sales, IT services sales, software sales, digital marketing sales, business development, or a related field.

**Freshers:** Candidates with good communication skills, confidence, and an interest in sales and business development may also apply.

Relevant internships, sales experience, customer\-facing experience, or business development experience may be considered.

Salary

**₹1\.5–₹2\.5 lakh per year**

Compensation will depend on the candidate's experience, skills, and suitability for the position.

Work Arrangement

This is a **full\-time remote position**.

The selected candidate will work remotely and communicate with the team through company\-approved communication and collaboration tools.

Candidates should have:

* A reliable internet connection.
* A computer or laptop suitable for professional work.
* A suitable environment for business calls.
* Availability during the company's working hours.

**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM–7:00 PM IST

Performance Expectations

The role may include measurable business development activities such as:

* Prospecting activity
* Qualified leads generated
* Follow\-up activity
* Discovery calls and client meetings
* Proposals and quotations
* Sales pipeline development
* New clients acquired
* Revenue generated
* Achievement of agreed sales targets

Specific targets and performance expectations will be discussed during the selection process.

What We Offer

* Fully remote work arrangement
* Opportunity to work with IT and digital marketing services
* Exposure to B2B sales and business development
* Opportunity to develop client communication and sales skills
* Professional experience in the technology services industry

Who Should Apply

This position may be suitable for candidates who are:

* Interested in sales and business development.
* Comfortable speaking with new prospects.
* Interested in technology and digital services.
* Consistent with follow\-ups.
* Organized and self\-motivated.
* Comfortable working independently.
* Willing to learn about IT and digital marketing services.
* Interested in developing a long\-term career in B2B sales.

Selection Process

Candidates may be evaluated based on communication skills, relevant experience, understanding of sales and business development, and ability to handle practical sales situations.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an online interview and role\-related discussion.

Work Location

**Remote**

Candidates can work from their own location, subject to the company's working\-hour and communication requirements.

Equal Opportunity

NextGen Info Solution evaluates applicants based on relevant skills, experience, qualifications, and suitability for the position. We encourage applications from candidates who meet the requirements of the role.

Pay: ₹180,000\.00 \- ₹240,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

ensuring milestones are met through stakeholder engagement and precise scope, schedule,


and resource management. Act as a strategic link between corporate strategy and field


implementation, driving integrated projects, mitigating risks, and providing transparent

title: Social Media Coordinator | Chennai | Immediate Joinee
description:
**Location:** Chennai  
**Experience:** 6 months – 1 year  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

About the Role

We’re looking for a **Social Media Coordinator** with at least 6 months of hands\-on experience in social media and content.

You’ll work closely with our creative, content and marketing teams to manage and execute social media for a range of brands across **fashion, lifestyle, luxury, beauty, home and eCommerce**.

We’re looking for someone who understands how social media works, keeps up with trends, has a good eye for content and can keep multiple projects moving.

What You’ll Do

* Coordinate day\-to\-day social media activities across multiple client accounts.
* Assist in developing and maintaining **monthly social media calendars**.
* Research and suggest content ideas based on brand objectives, trends, occasions and current conversations.
* Coordinate with copywriters, designers, photographers and other team members to ensure content is delivered on time.
* Schedule and publish **posts, Reels, Stories, carousels and other social media content**.
* Assist with captions, hooks, CTAs and other short\-form social copy.
* Stay updated on **Instagram trends, Reels formats, trending audio and emerging content styles**.
* Research competitors and relevant brands for content inspiration and opportunities.
* Coordinate shoots and gather content requirements from clients and internal teams.
* Manage content calendars, deadlines, approvals and publishing schedules.
* Coordinate client feedback and approvals.
* Ensure approved content is published accurately and on time.
* Monitor basic social media metrics such as **reach, engagement, views and follower growth**.
* Assist with monthly social media reports and content performance analysis.
* Support influencer and creator collaborations, including research and coordination.
* Contribute ideas for **campaigns, Reels, social media series and brand storytelling**.

Incentive eligibility will begin after completion of the first month from the date of joining, subject to satisfactory performance and the Company's applicable incentive policy.

**About** **Airtribe**

Airtribe is an AI\-first upskilling platform for working professionals. From Product Management to Backend Engineering, our programs are designed around real\-world use cases, AI tools, and hands\-on learning.

We work with instructors from companies like Microsoft, Meta, Razorpay, Coinbase, Gojek, and Uber, and have helped 5,000\+ professionals accelerate their careers. Backed by Better Capital, 640 Ventures, and Kunal Shah, we are building a fast\-growing learning platform focused on real outcomes.

**The Context**  
At Airtribe, Business Development is not about pushing sales. It is about helping working professionals make the right career decisions.

As we scale, the volume of learners and conversations increases, but maintaining trust, clarity, and quality in each interaction becomes harder. This role exists to ensure that every learner interaction is thoughtful, consultative, and outcome\-driven, not transactional.

**The Role**  
As a Business Development Associate, you will work closely with learners to understand their goals and guide them toward the right programs. You will own the journey from the first conversation to final enrolment, ensuring clarity, trust, and a strong learner experience throughout.

This is a role built for people who are early in their careers and hungry to grow fast. We will give you the training, the environment, and the support. What we are looking for is the drive to make it count.

**What You'll Own**

* End\-to\-end learner conversations from first touchpoint to enrollment
* Understanding learner goals and guiding them with clarity and empathy
* Follow\-ups, objection handling, and decision support
* Maintaining quality and consistency across all interactions
* Accurate documentation of conversations, follow\-ups, and outcomes
* Building relationships through calls, events, and networking opportunities

**What Problems You'll Solve**

* Helping learners make informed decisions instead of rushed choices
* Reducing drop\-offs caused by confusion or lack of clarity
* Building trust in a high\-volume, fast\-moving sales environment
* Ensuring conversations are consultative, not script\-driven

**How This Role Evolves**

* In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding the product, learner personas, and running effective conversations.
* Over time, you will be expected to improve conversion quality, handle more complex conversations, and contribute to refining sales processes.
* Based on performance, this role can evolve into owning larger pipelines, mentoring junior team members, or moving into high\-impact sales or growth roles.

**What We're Looking For**

* Fresh graduates, freshers with internship experience, or candidates with up to 10 months of experience
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
* Ability to build trust quickly and handle conversations with clarity
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment
* Ownership mindset, proactive and accountable
* A genuine interest in sales and helping people make the right decisions

**Nice to have:**

* Prior internship or experience in sales, inside sales, or customer\-facing roles
* Exposure to EdTech or consultative sales environments

**Compensation and Growth**

* During the 3\-month probation period, the salary will be Rs. 17,000 to 20,000 per month, plus incentives
* On successful confirmation, your fixed pay increases by 90% to 150%, along with incentives
* This is a performance\-driven role, and your growth here is directly tied to the impact you create

**What This Role Is Not**

* This is not a script\-driven or transactional sales role.
* We are not looking for someone who pushes for closures. We are looking for someone who understands learners, builds trust, and helps them make the right decisions.

**Why Join Airtribe**

* High\-impact role with direct business visibility from day one
* A clear and fast growth path in a performance\-driven environment
* Significant salary growth on confirmation
* Collaborative and ambitious team culture
* Comprehensive medical insurance

At **Airtribe,** Business Development is about building trust and driving meaningful outcomes, not just closing deals.

title: Systems Engineer | Defence
description:
**Location:** 
 Sector\-132, Noida, (involves travelling with the team to various test sites across India)
   

  

**Salary (CTC):** 
 ₹6\-7 LPA
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time, On\-site
   

  

**About Zoid\-**
 ZOID is a deep\-tech R\&D startup developing advanced defence and aerospace technologies for the Indian Military and UAV manufacturers. Our work spans AI, electronics, robotics, autonomous systems and UAV platforms.
   

  

 Our current projects include AI\-based FOD detection for naval air stations, GNSS\-denied navigation, aerial intelligent mapping, reusable off\-board missile decoys, vision\-based kinetic strike systems and drone swarming solutions.
   

  

**Role Overview\-**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Systems Engineer** 
 to support the end\-to\-end design, integration, testing, flight operations and deployment of UAV systems.
   

  

 The role requires strong practical knowledge of drone hardware, avionics, flight controllers, power systems, communication links, payload integration and field testing. The candidate must be comfortable manually flying small to medium\-category UAVs and travelling to test locations across India.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities\-**
**UAV Systems \& Integration**
* Lead, design and assemble end\-to\-end integration of UAV subsystems: propulsion, avionics, control, payload and power.
* Hands\-on with various frame designs — Quad/Hex/Octa copters, fixed\-wing, VTOL, etc.
* Select suitable drives, electronic components, sensors and hardware.
* Knowledge of motors, ESCs, propellers — their specs and configuration.
* Configure, integrate, calibrate and auto\-tune flight controllers (Pixhawk, Cube Orange\+, PX4, etc.).
* Analyse flight logs using Mission Planner, QGroundControl or MAVLink tools for pre\- and post\-flight debugging.
* Knowledge of standard flight modes (stabilize, althold, poshold, loiter, land, rtl, guided, auto), fail\-safes (RC, GCS, battery, geofence, EKF) and mission planning.
* Familiar with standard Pixhawk Cube parameters and setting them via Mission Planner.


**Communication \& Networking**
* Ability to configure IP networks — IP addressing, subnet masks, gateways, routing — and get companion computers, flight controllers, payload processors, routers and ground stations talking on the same network.
* Knowledge of serial communication protocols: UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, RS\-232, including baud rates and debugging.
* Understanding of telemetry radios, RC links, video links, mesh networks, Ethernet, LTE/5G modems, VPN/routing and IP\-based payload communication.
* Understanding of MAVLink routing, UDP/TCP endpoints, packet loss, latency and link redundancy.


**Basic RF knowledge** 
 — understanding of what a signal is and the fundamentals behind it.
   

  

**Power System Design**
* Understanding of Li\-ion/LiPo packs, C\-rating, discharge curves, BMS, cell balancing and safe charging/discharging.
* Ability to calculate power Budget, current draw, endurance, payload power and voltage rail requirements.
* Knowledge of PDBs, DC\-DC converters, BECs, fuses, connectors, wire gauge selection and grounding.
* Troubleshoot brownouts, voltage drops, ESC desync, power noise and overheating.


**Sensor \& Payload Integration**
 Integrate EO/IR cameras, gimbals, LiDAR, rangefinders, GNSS/RTK modules, IMUs, magnetometers, payload controllers and RF payloads.
   

  

* Read sensor datasheets and understand interfaces, power needs, mounting constraints and calibration.
* Test payload data flow from sensor → onboard computer → ground station.
* Ability to read datasheets, schematics, pinouts and reference manuals to bring up and test embedded boards.


**Software \& Development**
* Python skills are mandatory for development, log analysis / visualization, automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of Ubuntu / Linux is required, including basic commands (SSH, SCP, mkdir, cd, rm, etc.) and day\-to\-day use of a Linux environment.
* Basic firmware development, flashing, debugging and peripheral interfacing on microcontrollers such as STM32, ESP32, Arduino or similar.


**Qualifications**
**Education:** 
 Diploma or degree in Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or a related field. Equivalent experience also considered.
   

  

**Experience**
* Minimum 3 years in a Avionics Systems Engineer preferably in a startup, R\&D or defence\-tech setup.
* Prior experience in defence/aerospace product testing and deployment.
* Experience building and operating drones from scratch and running day\-to\-day autonomous/semi\-autonomous flights.


**Hands\-on Skills**
* Soldering (board\-level), crimping, wiring, harness building and assembly.
* Integrating flight controllers with ESCs, GPS, power modules, telemetry, RF systems and onboard computers.
* Familiarity with aviation regulations and military standards for UAV development is a plus.


**Core Skills\-**
* Proficiency in MS Office, Canva, AI Tool like Claude.
* Strong problem\-solving — able to think critically and creatively about complex engineering challenges.
* Good communication skills for working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in English is mandatory.


**Additional Requirements**
* Willingness to travel to test sites across India.
* Comfortable working outdoors for extended durations.


**Preferred Skills**
 Beyond the requirements above, any of the following is a big plus:
   

  

* Advanced software experience with C\+\+, ROS and Gazebo.
* Familiarity with embedded processors beyond standard computers — microcontrollers, SBCs, SoCs and FPGA\-based development boards.
* Basic familiarity with FPGA / SoC\-FPGA workflows: HDL, synthesis, bitstream generation, programming and hardware validation using tools like Vivado/Vitis or similar.
* Awareness of different RF architectures, with the judgement to do design and analysis of the subsystems in an RF chain.
* Understanding of antenna theory, types of signals, jamming signals and SDRs


 Skills: debugging,avionics,python,ubuntu / linux,uav

* Understand customer requirements and identify genuine business opportunities.
* Follow up regularly with prospects through phone, email, and WhatsApp.
* Maintain records of all customer interactions.
* Escalate serious or promising leads to management.

**Department:** Quality  
**Designation:** Jr. Quality Engineer  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **Jr. Quality Engineer** to support our Quality Department in maintaining product quality, ensuring compliance with quality standards, and identifying and resolving quality\-related issues in the manufacturing process.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform inspection of incoming materials, in\-process components, and finished products.
* Prepare and maintain inspection reports, quality records, and documentation.
* Conduct dimensional inspection using measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, etc.
* Monitor manufacturing processes to ensure products are manufactured as per drawings and specifications.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and basic GD\&T.
* Identify quality defects and coordinate with Production for corrective actions.
* Support root cause analysis of quality issues and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Assist in maintaining quality standards and procedures as per company requirements.
* Perform first\-piece, in\-process, and final inspections.
* Maintain calibration records of measuring and testing instruments.
* Support internal quality audits and maintain necessary documentation.
* Prepare NCRs and assist in closure of quality\-related issues.
* Coordinate with Production, Stores, and other departments for quality\-related activities.
* Ensure proper identification and segregation of rejected/non\-conforming materials.
* Follow company safety, quality, and environmental procedures.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of quality inspection processes.
* Basic knowledge of engineering drawings and dimensional tolerances.
* Knowledge of measuring instruments and inspection techniques.
* Basic understanding of **5S, Kaizen, 7 QC Tools, CAPA, and Root Cause Analysis** will be preferred.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel.
* Attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.

Qualification

**Diploma / B.Tech / B.E.** in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field.

**ITI candidates with relevant quality inspection experience may also be considered.**

Preferred Candidate

* Freshers with relevant technical knowledge can apply.
* Candidates having **0–2 years of experience in manufacturing, fabrication, engineering, machine shop, or quality inspection** will be preferred.
* Candidates should be willing to work on the shop floor and coordinate closely with the Production team.

Key Performance Areas (KRA)

* In\-process and final inspection accuracy.
* Reduction in rejection and rework.
* Timely identification of quality issues.
* Proper maintenance of quality records.
* Effective coordination with Production for corrective actions.

JOB DESCRIPTION Marketing, Sales \& Technical Support ExecutiveSelexic Pay — Labour Contractor HRMS

**Company:** Deccan India Development Corporation Pvt. Ltd. (DIDC)  
**Product:** Selexic Pay – Labour Contractor Payroll \& HRMS  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Location:** Pune / Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Work Mode:** Field \+ Office \+ Customer Site  
**Department:** Sales \& Customer Success  
**Reporting To:** Business Development Manager / Management

1\. About DIDC

Deccan India Development Corporation Pvt. Ltd. (DIDC) is a technology company focused on building practical digital solutions for businesses and organizations.

We are looking for a dynamic, target\-oriented and technology\-friendly **Marketing, Sales \& Technical Support Executive** to drive the growth of **Selexic Pay**, our specialized Labour Contractor Payroll \& HRMS platform.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for the complete customer journey—from identifying prospects and generating leads to conducting product demonstrations, closing sales, supporting implementation and maintaining customer relationships.

2\. About Selexic Pay

**Selexic Pay** is a specialized HRMS and payroll management solution designed for labour contractors and organizations managing large workforces.

The platform helps businesses manage areas such as:

* Labour/Employee Management
* Employee onboarding
* Aadhaar/PAN/Bank verification
* Attendance management
* Salary processing
* Salary structures
* Advances and loans
* Deductions
* Compliance calculations
* Minimum wages compliance
* Salary slips
* WhatsApp communication
* Client/company management
* Material management
* Pay\-per\-work
* Mobile access
* Payroll and workforce reporting

The candidate will be trained on the complete Selexic Pay platform.

3\. Role Purpose

The primary objective of this role is to **generate revenue and ensure customer success for Selexic Pay in Pune and Mumbai.**

The employee will perform three interconnected functions:

A. Marketing

Create awareness and generate qualified leads.

B. Sales

Convert prospects into paying Selexic Pay customers.

C. Technical Support

Help customers understand, configure and use Selexic Pay successfully.

This is therefore a **revenue \+ customer\-success role**, not a purely administrative support position.

4\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Marketing \& Lead Generation

* Identify potential Selexic Pay customers in assigned territories.
* Conduct market research to identify labour contractors and workforce\-management businesses.
* Identify companies employing/managing large numbers of contract labour.
* Generate leads through:
* Field visits
* Cold calling
* WhatsApp
* Email
* LinkedIn
* References
* Business networking
* Local business associations
* Industry contacts
* Digital campaigns and marketing activities
* Build a database of prospective customers.
* Maintain accurate lead information in the CRM.
* Conduct regular market visits.
* Identify new business opportunities in Pune and Mumbai.
* Participate in exhibitions, seminars, networking events and promotional activities.
* Support DIDC marketing campaigns and local promotional initiatives.

5\. Sales ResponsibilitiesLead → Demo → Follow\-up → Closure

The employee will be responsible for managing the complete sales cycle.

Lead Qualification

Understand:

* Number of employees/labourers
* Number of clients/sites
* Current payroll process
* Attendance process
* Salary processing method
* Compliance requirements
* Current software/Excel usage
* Existing problems
* Decision\-maker
* Budget
* Expected implementation timeline

Product Demonstration

Conduct professional Selexic Pay demonstrations for:

* Labour contractors
* Contractors' HR teams
* Payroll teams
* Accounts teams
* Admin teams
* Business owners
* Company management

Demonstrate the product according to the customer's actual business problem rather than simply showing software screens.

Sales Conversion

* Prepare proposals and quotations.
* Explain packages and pricing.
* Handle objections.
* Conduct follow\-ups.
* Negotiate within approved limits.
* Coordinate with management wherever special pricing is required.
* Close sales.
* Collect required customer information for onboarding.
* Coordinate with the implementation/support team.

6\. Technical Support Responsibilities

The candidate will provide **Level\-1 product support** to Selexic Pay customers.

Responsibilities include:

* Help customers understand Selexic Pay features.
* Assist customers with basic configuration.
* Help users resolve common application issues.
* Guide customers during employee import.
* Assist with attendance data upload.
* Help users understand salary processing.
* Explain salary structures and deductions.
* Assist with basic payroll configuration.
* Help customers understand reports and salary slips.
* Assist customers with WhatsApp\-related workflows.
* Guide customers through application usage.
* Reproduce customer\-reported issues where possible.
* Record issues in the support/ticketing system.
* Escalate technical bugs to the development team.
* Follow up on escalated issues until closure.
* Maintain communication with customers during issue resolution.
* Conduct basic customer training.

**Important:** The employee is not expected to be a software developer.

However, the candidate must have sufficient technical understanding to **diagnose basic problems, understand software workflows and communicate technical issues clearly to the development team.**

7\. Customer Onboarding

After a successful sale, the employee will assist with customer onboarding.

Activities may include:

* Customer information collection
* Product configuration coordination
* Employee data import
* Attendance setup
* Salary configuration
* User creation
* Basic training
* First payroll assistance
* Customer handover
* Follow\-up after implementation

The objective is to ensure that the customer does not simply purchase Selexic Pay but **starts using it successfully.**

8\. Customer Relationship Management

* Maintain regular contact with existing customers.
* Understand customer problems and requirements.
* Identify opportunities for additional modules/add\-ons.
* Generate upselling and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Collect customer feedback.
* Identify dissatisfied customers early.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer issues.
* Maintain long\-term relationships with key customers.
* Generate referrals from satisfied customers.

9\. Field Sales \& Travel

This is a **field\-oriented role**.

The candidate should be comfortable travelling across assigned territories in:

Pune

Pune city and surrounding industrial/business areas.

Mumbai

Mumbai and surrounding business/industrial areas as assigned.

Regular customer meetings, prospect visits, demonstrations and support visits will be part of the job.

**Two\-wheeler ownership and a valid driving licence will be preferred.**

10\. Daily Responsibilities

A typical working day may include:

* Prospect research
* Cold calls
* Lead follow\-up
* Customer meetings
* Field visits
* Product demonstrations
* Proposal preparation
* Sales follow\-up
* Customer support
* CRM updates
* Customer onboarding
* Internal coordination
* Daily activity reporting

The candidate will be expected to maintain proper records of:

* Calls
* Leads
* Meetings
* Demos
* Follow\-ups
* Opportunities
* Closures
* Customer issues
* Support activities

11\. Key Performance Indicators — KPIs

Performance will be measured using a combination of **activity, sales and customer\-success metrics.**

Marketing KPIs

* New leads generated
* Qualified leads
* New prospects added to CRM
* Market visits
* Networking activities
* Campaign participation

Sales KPIs

* Customer meetings

Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly motivated and highly organized Talent Acquisition Intern to join our team at Instawork. In this role, you will get hands\-on experience working on end\-to\-end recruitment, serving as the critical bridge between our hiring teams and prospective candidates.
   

  

 If you enjoy speaking with people, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and want to build a strong foundation in human resources and talent acquisition, this opportunity is a great starting point.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage End\-to\-End Recruitment: Support the full recruitment lifecycle for various open positions.

* Interview Coordination: Take ownership of lining up and scheduling interviews between candidates and internal hiring teams.
* Candidate Communication: Manage ongoing follow\-ups, gather feedback, and ensure a smooth and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Data Management: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of calls, candidate statuses, and interview schedules.


**Requirements**
* Excellent verbal communication skills with a confident and professional phone presence.
* Strong organizational skills, multitasking abilities, and exceptional attention to detail (crucial for interview coordination).
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume calling environment.
* Prior experience in HR, recruitment, or customer\-facing roles is preferred but not mandatory.


**Compensation \& Benefits** 
  

  

* 💰 Base Stipend: ₹20,000 per month
* 🍱 Food Allowance: ₹200 per day
* Perks \& Benefits:
+ Collaborative team culture and vibrant office environment.
+ Hands\-on exposure to full\-cycle talent acquisition and HR operations.
+ Strong career growth opportunities by learning the core mechanics of tech and business hiring.


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.

* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
   

  

 Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

 Talent Acquisition:

* Monitor training effectiveness and employee development metrics.
* Analyze workforce data and identify HR trends.
* Provide actionable HR insights and recommendations to leadership.

description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in\-office.**
 The Catalog Operations Team is a vital part of the Accommodations Division, responsible for accurately onboarding, activating, and readying Priceline's hotel supply for customers. By managing the end\-to\-end process of adding properties to our catalog and maintaining catalog quality, the team ensures a healthy selection of hotels for our customers.

* Highlight opportunities you see in the data, and collaborate with teammates to prioritize and turn them into improvements and experiments.
* Help test and provide feedback on new tools, procedures, and automation related to catalog content quality.

* 1–2 years of experience in an operations or analytics‑focused role (e.g.: operations/business analyst).
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write queries and perform analysis.
* Experience using AI tools (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Perplexity) for analysis, automation, or workflow optimization.
* Experience working with dashboards in BI tools such as Tableau.
* Experience using work‑tracking such as Jira to manage tasks and track issues.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data findings to non‑technical partners.
* Experience in a fast‑paced environment.
* Experience helping design or deploy AI‑powered solutions in real workflows (preferred).

* Background in travel or hospitality, or experience working with operations (preferred; strong interest is also welcome).

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Position Summary** 





 Pivot Apparel is seeking a detail\-oriented and analytically driven Business Analyst to support our Global Planning and Strategy organization across all channels \- Wholesale, Retail Stores, and E\-Commerce. This role partners closely across the planning and merchandising ecosystem to turn large, complex data sets into clear, actionable recommendations that drive sales, inventory productivity, and margin across all categories \- apparel and non\-apparel. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience within a specialty contemporary apparel brand and is fluent in retail math, open\-to\-buy principles, and the cross\-functional rhythm of a merchandising organization.
 




**What You'll Do** 




**•** 
**Partner with Merchandise Planning to build, maintain, and analyze seasonal sales, margin, and inventory plans at the department, class, and SKU level across all categories.** 




**•** 

 Support Demand Forecasting by validating forecast accuracy, identifying trend shifts, and surfacing risks or opportunities in the sales forecast versus plan and versus prior year.
 




**•** 

 Collaborate with Buying teams to analyze open\-to\-buy (OTB) positions, style/color productivity, and vendor performance, providing recommendations on receipt flow, chase opportunities, and markdown risk.
 




**•** 

 Work with Allocation \& Replenishment to evaluate weeks of supply (WOS), sell\-through, and in\-stock performance by door/DC and channel, recommending allocation strategy adjustments.
 




**•** 

 Support Store Planning with door\-level financial plans, cluster/segmentation analysis, and space or fixture productivity insights.
 




**•** 

 Build and maintain reporting tools and dashboards (Excel\-based and/or BI platforms) that synthesize large, multi\-source data sets into digestible, decision\-ready outputs for cross\-functional partners.
 




**•** 

 Conduct ad hoc analyses — such as 80/20 (Pareto) reviews, price elasticity, wholesale specialty account reconciliation, and style/color performance — to inform buy, allocation, and pricing decisions.
 




**•** 

 Reconcile and validate data across multiple source systems (buy files, POS, financial plans, vendor files) to ensure a single source of truth for cross\-functional decision\-making.
 




**•** 

 Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations and action plans that non\-analytical stakeholders can act on quickly.
 




**•** 

 Act as a connective thread across Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising, Design, Marketing, Finance, Production, and Logistics — ensuring data, timelines, and decisions stay aligned across functions.
 




**•** 

 Support seasonal calendar milestones (line sheet reviews, buy meetings, financial reconciliations, market prep) with timely, accurate analysis.
 




**What You Bring** 




**•** 
**2\-3\+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Merchandise Planning, Buying, or Allocation role within a specialty contemporary apparel brand, with exposure to multiple categories.** 




**•** 

 Strong command of retail math and understanding of nomenclature including inventory turn, seasonality, GMROI, cumulative sell\-through, sell\-through %, markdown %, and receipt flow planning.
 




**•    Learned in Open\-to\-Buy interpretation and management.** 




**•** 

 Demonstrated ability to work confidently with large, complex data sets — pulling, cleaning, reconciling, and synthesizing data from multiple sources into clear recommendations and action plans, not just reports.
 




**•** 

 Advanced Excel skills required (pivot tables, complex formulas, SUMIFS/INDEX\-MATCH, data modeling); experience with BI or planning tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or an OTB/allocation planning system) is a plus.
 




**•** 

 Working knowledge of how Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising, Design, Marketing, Finance, Production, and Logistics collaborate across the seasonal calendar, and how decisions in one function ripple into the others.
 




**•** 

 Strong business acumen paired with sharp attention to detail — comfortable moving between big\-picture strategic recommendations and granular data validation.
 




**•** 

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present analysis and recommendations clearly to both analytical and non\-analytical stakeholders.
 




**•** 

 Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced, seasonal retail environment.
 




**•** 

 Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Merchandising, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 




**Preferred Qualifications** 




**•** 

 Experience supporting non\-apparel or hardlines categories in addition to apparel.
 




**•** 

 Familiarity with store planning concepts such as door clustering, space productivity, and fixture/adjacency planning.
 




**•** 

 Exposure to demand forecasting or elasticity modeling, and an understanding of the operational factors (allocation, replenishment, buy depth) that can mask or influence price signals.
 




**Why Join Pivot Apparel** 



* You'll work at the intersection of data and product, helping shape how Pivot Apparel plans, buys, and delivers merchandise across all categories and channels. This role offers high visibility with senior Planning and Allocation leadership and the opportunity to directly influence buy strategy, inventory health, and store\-level performance
