title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**About The Role**
 For decades, every fast\-moving company has been held back by smart people doing manual, repetitive work that should not require smart people. You will be part of a team whose job is to make every team at HackerRank \- from Go\-To\-Market to Finance to Product \- dramatically more effective, by building AI agents, automations, and platform capabilities that eliminate the work that should not be manual in the first place.
   

  

 Most engineering roles put you deep inside one product surface. This one puts you across the whole company. In a given month you might be building a data analytics agent that answers ad\-hoc product questions in Slack, writing an MCP connector that gives AI agents access to internal tooling, or designing the eval harness that lets the team ship agent changes without regressions.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Embed with internal teams \- from Marketing to Product to Finance \- to map workflows and identify the real bottlenecks which can be impacted by AI.
* Scope, prototype, and ship AI agents and automations that eliminate high\-leverage manual work across the company.
* Own agents end\-to\-end after launch: monitor quality, triage failures, review outputs, and iterate based on real usage data.
* Design and build the shared AI Agents platform: orchestration, routing, reusable components, access controls, logging, rate limiting.
* Build evaluation harnesses that measure agent quality programmatically, catch regressions before they reach users, and give the team confidence to ship changes.
* Author and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors that give AI agents access to HackerRank's internal tools, APIs, and data systems.
* Own the outputs you ship. Write and review code with the same rigor you would apply to any production system \- secure, well\-tested, and maintainable.


**Who You Are**
* 1\-4 years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production systems, not just demos or prototypes.
* Strong Python skills and solid fundamentals across the stack \- you can build and deploy a service, wire it to APIs and databases, and keep it running.
* Hands\-on experience building with LLMs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) in production, including prompt engineering, context management, tool use, and debugging failure modes at real scale.
* You have built or operated structured evaluation pipelines for AI systems with metrics and regression detection.
* You diagnose before you build. You discover what is actually hampering productivity before jumping to a solution, and you are as likely to recommend a simple script or process change as a full agent.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to drive loosely defined problems to working solutions.
* Fluency with AI tools and agents \- not just as a user, but as someone who builds production systems on top of them and understands their failure modes deeply enough to debug and improve them.


**Even better if you have**
* Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK or similar).
* Hands\-on experience authoring MCP servers or building tool connectors for AI agents.
* Experience with RAG pipelines grounded in structured data models \- vector databases, hybrid search, re\-ranking \- and AI observability tooling (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry).


**You will thrive in this role if**
* You are as comfortable writing Python, reading an agent trace log, and sitting with a finance team to map their workflow. You ship things end\-to\-end and take pride in systems that are clean under the hood and actually get used.
* Ambiguity motivates you. You can work with non\-technical stakeholders where direction evolves, and you turn loose ideas into working automations that get adopted.
* You use AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut. You have built real fluency with LLMs and agents, and you actively look for ways to raise the quality and pace of your work through them \- while understanding their failure modes well enough to catch regressions before users do.

The successful candidate is technically sharp, eager to grow, and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced innovation environment within a global enterprise.

**AI/ML Model Development**
* Build, train, and evaluate ML models, contributing to the full model lifecycle from data preparation through to deployment.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model experimentation; document findings clearly.
* Support model validation, testing, and performance benchmarking activities.


 Generative AI \& LLM Applications
   

  

* Develop and maintain GenAI\-powered applications including chatbots, summarization tools, document processing pipelines, and internal copilots.
* Implement prompt engineering patterns, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and tool\-augmented agents using established frameworks.
* Participate in the evaluation of new LLM capabilities and contribute to internal proof\-of\-concepts.


**AI Infrastructure \& MLOps**
* Support the building and maintenance of ML pipelines, including data ingestion, preprocessing, training automation, and model serving.
* Manage and monitor deployed models; identify and escalate performance degradation, drift, or anomalies.
* Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code for AI workloads across cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).


 AI Governance \& Quality
   

  

* Assist in producing governance documentation: model cards, data lineage records, and risk assessment inputs.
* Implement monitoring and logging frameworks to support auditability and compliance requirements.
* Apply responsible AI checklists and flag potential bias, fairness, or privacy concerns during development.


**Collaboration \& Delivery**

* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and technical design discussions.

title: Junior Full Stack Developer — MERN, RAG & Agentic AI
description:
**Junior Full Stack Developer — MERN, RAG \& Agentic AI** 




*1–2 years' experience · Full\-time* 




  





**About the role** 




 We're hiring a senior full stack engineer to architect, build, and scale a production\-grade AI platform built on the MERN stack, with deep retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic AI components at its core.
 



 You'll work across the entire stack — from React front\-ends, through Node.js and Express APIs, to MongoDB and vector data layers — and own the integration of large language models, retrieval systems, and multi\-agent orchestration that powers the product.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role for someone who has shipped real RAG and LLM\-powered systems in production and is fluent in both modern web architecture and the AI tooling ecosystem.
 



**Tech stack you'll work with** 



* **Frontend:** 
 React.js (Hooks, functional components), modern state management (Redux, Zustand, or RTK Query), client\-side routing, responsive UI.
* **Backend:** 
 Node.js, Express.js, RESTful API design (GraphQL a plus), authentication / authorization, caching, logging.
* **Database:** 
 MongoDB — schema design, indexing, aggregation pipelines, query optimization.
* **AI / LLM layer:** 
 OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open\-source models (Llama, Mistral, Cohere) integrated behind a unified provider\-routing layer.
* **Retrieval:** 
 Vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector; embedding\-based search; chunking and reranking strategies.
* **Agentic patterns:** 
 Tool use, multi\-agent orchestration, prompt flow management, context\-window handling, guardrails and safety mechanisms.
* **Infrastructure:** 
 AWS, GCP, or Azure; Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar); container orchestration a plus.
* **Security:** 
 End\-to\-end encryption, SSO, role\-based access control, audit logging, secrets and API\-key management, rate limiting.



**What you'll be responsible for** 



* Designing and building end\-to\-end RAG pipelines — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval strategies, and reranking.
* Building multi\-agent orchestration logic — tool use, context management, prompt flows, and guardrails for LLM\-based features.
* Implementing a multi\-model routing layer that selects the appropriate LLM per task and manages cost, latency, and quality trade\-offs.
* Developing robust Node.js and Express APIs to coordinate retrieval and generation workflows.
* Building responsive, performant React interfaces for AI\-driven user experiences.
* Designing for scalability, observability, and security across the full stack.
* Establishing engineering best practices — unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing; code review; CI/CD discipline.
* Mentoring junior and mid\-level engineers and contributing to architectural decisions.



**Required skills** 



* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–2 years as a full stack engineer, with at least 1 years focused on the MERN stack.
* Strong production experience building RAG\-based applications — not just prototypes or proofs of concept.
* Hands\-on integration of LLMs with vector / embedding\-based retrieval systems.
* Working knowledge of agentic patterns — tool calling, multi\-agent coordination, context\-window management, and guardrails.
* Strong API design skills (REST; GraphQL a plus).
* Cloud deployment and containerization experience (Docker; Kubernetes a plus).
* Solid grasp of authentication, caching, logging, observability, and security for AI\-integrated web applications.
* Strong debugging, performance\-tuning, and problem\-solving skills across the stack.
* Clear communication and the ability to collaborate with product, data, and AI/ML teammates.



**Bonus points** 



* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, and quality measurement for retrieval and generation.
* MLOps and observability for AI systems — latency, cost, drift, and retrieval\-quality monitoring.
* Event\-driven or microservices architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or pub/sub) for AI workloads.
* ETL / ELT data pipelines for preparing and maintaining knowledge bases.
* Familiarity with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or similar).
* Open\-source contributions in the RAG, agent, LLM, or MERN ecosystems.



**How to Apply** 




  





 Interested candidates can share their resume and relevant project details at:
 



**hr@quanterian.com**

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
At Prodigal, we are building AI Agents for loan servicing and collections. Founded in 2018 by IITB alumni, our journey began when our founders Shantanu and Sangram faced the antiquated the $13B\+ lending/collections industry was mostly using pen and paper and decided to build the first real intelligence layer for debt recovery.
   

  

 Today, we stand at the forefront of a seismic shift in the industry, building Agentic AI applications for loan servicing and collections. Powered by our cutting\-edge platform, Prodigal’s Intelligence Engine (PIE), we’re creating the next\-generation agentic workforce \- one that empowers companies to achieve unprecedented levels of operational excellence and intelligence.
   

  

 With over 100\+ enterprise customers across North America and backing from Y Combinator, Accel and Menlo Ventures, we are the fastest growing AI company in consumer finance.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an AI Engineer to join the proAgent team and work on the systems that power our autonomous voice agents in live financial conversations. You'll work alongside a small, high\-agency team where you will have real ownership over features and components from day one.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You'll be deep in the code \- building agent logic, integrating speech models, tuning prompts, and debugging gnarly real\-time issues. You don't need to have done all of this before, but you need to be the kind of engineer who figures things out fast, takes feedback well, and ships.
   

  

**What You'll Do (TL;DR version)**
**Agent Loop \& Reasoning**
* Build and maintain components of the agentic runtime that powers multi\-turn financial conversations \- covering payment negotiations, compliance guardrails, and objection handling
* Implement context management logic that tracks consumer state, conversation history, and business rules across long, branching dialogues
* Write and iterate on primitives that balance conversational fluidity with structured reasoning \- the agent needs to feel human while making verifiable decisions


**Voice AI Systems**
* Work on our real\-time voice pipeline with a target of sub\-1s latency across transcription, reasoning, and synthesis
* Contribute to VAD tuning and turn\-taking logic that makes conversations feel natural
* Help evaluate and integrate speech models (STT, TTS, speech\-to\-speech) \- we currently work with ElevenLabs and Cartesia for TTS, and Deepgram for STT, and are always exploring what's next
* Debug streaming audio and WebRTC issues in production


**LLM Infrastructure**
* Write and refine prompts, implement orchestration flows, and contribute to model routing logic
* Build components of our evaluation framework \- helping measure agent quality across conversation quality, empathy, and compliance adherence
* Stay curious about new models and tools \- flag opportunities and contribute to build\-vs\-integrate discussions


**What You Bring**
* 2 – 5 years of hands\-on engineering experience, with good exposure to building or working with ML or AI systems in production.
* Solid Python fundamentals \- you are comfortable writing clean, maintainable code and debugging production issues.
* Some experience working with LLMs: prompt engineering, API integrations, or building simple pipelines or agents.
* High bias for action \- you don't wait to be told exactly what to do, and you push yourself to ship rather than over\-engineer.
* Strong fundamentals in Python; familiarity with TypeScript is a plus.
* Eager to learn in a fast\-moving environment, take ownership of your work, and ask good questions.


**Even Better**
* Exposure to voice AI: speech recognition, synthesis, or telephony systems \- even if only through personal projects or coursework
* Any background or interest in fintech, lending, or collections
* You've tinkered with Twilio, LiveKit, ElevenLabs, or similar real\-time infrastructure
* You've built a small agentic system \- even a side project \- that combines LLM reasoning with structured actions
* Familiarity with streaming protocols, WebRTC, or low\-latency system design


**Why This Role**
* Real ownership from day one: The Applied AI team behind proAgent is small in size, high in talent density. You'll own components, ship features, and see your work in live consumer conversations within weeks.
* Frontier work: voice AI that reasons, decides, and acts is one of the hardest problems in applied AI. You'll be learning by doing on problems most engineers never touch.
* Strong mentorship: you'll work directly with senior engineers and the AI Lead who will invest in your growth \- this is a place to level up fast.
* High leverage early career: the decisions you make and the code you write will impact millions of financial conversations. Rare for an early\-career role.


 From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast\-paced, intellectually\-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US.
   

  

 To learn more about us \- please visit the following:
   

  

 Our Story \- https://www.prodigaltech.com/our\-story
   

  

 What shapes our thinking \- https://link.prodigaltech.com/our\-thesis
   

  

 Our website \- https://www.prodigaltech.com/

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Darwinbox**
 Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1200\+ global enterprises to manage their 4\.5million\+ employees across 130\+ countries. Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: DP World, JG Summit, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
   

  

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 The way Darwinbox is evolving is unlike anything we have seen before. AI is transforming our platform, our customer experience, and the future of HR technology; this role will be at the forefront of turning that vision into reality. You will help bring our AI ambition to life in the field, working on high\-impact problems with strategic customers while shaping how Darwinbox scales its next generation of intelligent products. This is the founding cohort of an entirely new function at Darwinbox — the first FDEs will shape how the team operates, which customer engagements get the embedded model first, and how it scales. You will work zero layers removed from the customer and touch a stack broader than any pure product engineering role allows: the Darwinbox platform, Python at production scale, the LLM stack of your choice (Claude, GPT, Gemini), MCP servers, agent frameworks, and whatever the customer happens to run on their side.
   

  

**You’ll experience a culture of:**
* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper\-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment


**About The Role**
 The Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with Darwinbox's most strategic enterprise customers to ship production\-grade AI agents and Agentic Flows on the Darwinbox HCM platform inside each customer's environment. The role centres on three skill areas: production Python engineering for AI agents, deployment of LLM applications (prompt engineering at scale, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation frameworks), and architecting REST API and webhook integrations with payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning, and ERP systems. You will work hands\-on inside customer environments on HR workflow problems that exceed the platform's standard configuration surfaces.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Embed with 2–3 strategic enterprise customers in parallel as the technical owner of the Darwinbox deployment in their environment.
* Run discovery with CHROs, HRBPs, and HRIS leads to surface the real problem behind the stated ask and translate it into a working technical design.
* Deliver a working prototype within \~1 week of engagement kick\-off, codify repeatable deployment patterns, and channel field insights into the Darwinbox platform roadmap.
* Design and ship production\-grade AI agents on the Darwinbox platform for HR workflows including leave, performance, attendance, onboarding/exit automation, and HR decision support.
* Architect custom integrations between Darwinbox and customer\-side payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning platforms, and ERP stacks using REST APIs, webhooks, and event\-driven patterns.
* Travel 25–40 percent of the time to customer sites across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East as required.


**Required**
**What we are looking for**
* Hands\-on production Python engineering for enterprise SaaS, integrations, and AI agent development.
* Production deployment of LLM applications: prompt engineering at scale, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
* REST API and webhook integration design for systems interoperability (payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning, ERP) with production\-grade auth.
* Customer discovery and technical translation with senior enterprise stakeholders (CHROs, HRBPs, HRIS leads).
* Production LLM experience and willingness to travel 25–40 percent — candidates with only academic/demo AI exposure or hard travel constraints are unlikely to be the right fit.


**Preferred**
* HCM domain knowledge across payroll, performance, attendance, talent, and recruitment workflows.
* MCP server implementation or agent framework experience (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and AI observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse).
* TypeScript or Java in addition to Python; multilingual capability across Hindi, English, or additional Indian / SEA languages.
* Former technical founder experience, or experience in enterprise SaaS environments such as Salesforce (Agentforce), Atlassian, Databricks, Uniphore, UnifyApps, Sprinklr, Freshworks, Zoho, or similar settings with hands\- on AI deployment work.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* 1–4 years of professional software engineering experience, including customer\-facing (Hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related quantitative discipline; no certifications required.

description:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients.
   

  

**Why us?**
 🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry\-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.
   

  

 🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast\-paced, high\-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.
   

  

 🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.
   

  

 🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.
   

  

 💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting\-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.
   

  

 Key Deliverables — What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Deliver scalable AI\-enabled data ingestion and processing services.
   

  

 Build reliable pipelines for extracting, transforming, and processing large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
   

  

 Successfully deploy AI/ML models or LLM\-powered services into production.
   

  

 Ensure high system availability, performance, and operational visibility.
   

  

 Deliver clean, maintainable, well\-tested, and production\-ready code.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable AI\-powered data ingestion and processing platforms using Python. Build intelligent data pipelines, web crawling solutions, and AI/ML services that process structured and unstructured data while ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and develop web crawling, data ingestion, and AI\-powered processing solutions using Python.
* Build scalable data pipelines for processing HTML, PDF, and other structured/unstructured data sources.
* Develop REST APIs to support AI/ML services and data processing workflows.
* Implement AI/ML models or integrate LLMs for document parsing, classification, summarization, and information extraction.
* Design and optimize background processing, task scheduling, and distributed workloads.
* Build monitoring, logging, and observability for AI pipelines and backend services.
* Collaborate with Product, Data Science, DevOps, and Engineering teams to deliver production\-ready AI solutions.


 First 90 Days — Objectives
   

  

 Day 30: Understand the AI platform, data processing architecture, and development standards.
   

  

 Deliver enhancements to backend services or AI processing pipelines.
   

  

 Day 60: Independently build and deploy AI\-powered data processing components and APIs.
   

  

 Integrate AI/ML models into production workflows with monitoring and logging.
   

  

 Day 90: Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI\-enabled backend services and data pipelines.
   

  

 Optimize model inference, pipeline performance, and system reliability.
   

  

**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 2\-3 years of Python development experience with FastAPI, Django, or similar frameworks.
* Strong experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, or LLM application development.
* Experience with web scraping frameworks such as Scrapy or Playwright.
* Hands\-on experience with NLP, document processing, or information extraction techniques.
* Experience integrating LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or similar) using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex.
* Strong knowledge of REST APIs, asynchronous programming, and distributed task processing (Celery, RabbitMQ, Kafka).
* Experience parsing HTML, XML, and PDF documents using BeautifulSoup, lxml, or PyMuPDF.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and scalable data processing.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, or search platforms such as OpenSearch/Elasticsearch.
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and application monitoring.


**Nice To Have**
 Experience with RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) architectures.
   

  

 Knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or pgvector.
   

  

 Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
   

  

 Exposure to MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or model serving frameworks.
   

  

 Experience with Kubernetes and cloud\-native deployments.
   

  

 Knowledge of OCR, computer vision, or multimodal AI models.
   

  

**Interested?**
 If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.
   

  

 CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 Build backend services in Node.js/TypeScript that talk to the Solana RPC layer, listen to on\-chain events, and keep blockchain state in sync with our off\-chain systems
   

  

 Design data models in MongoDB for operational data and ClickHouse for high\-volume analytics
   

  

 Own the backend powering the Dabba Explorer \- APIs for real\-time hotspot status, staking positions, reward claims, and token burn/mint events
   

  

 Build integrations with Solana DEXs, DePIN partner protocols
   

  

 Participate in design and architecture decisions \- we're a small team, your opinions on how things should be built actually matter here
   

  

 Take ownership of on\-chain security \- reviewing programs for common vulnerabilities, writing adversarial test cases, and preparing programs for third\-party audits
   

  

 Write tests that actually cover the hard stuff \- not just happy paths, but edge cases, failure modes, arithmetic boundary conditions, and simulated attack scenarios against a locally spun\-up validator state
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 You've spent 2\+ years shipping on Solana mainnet, programs with real users, real tokens, and real stakes if something goes wrong
   

  

 Deep Anchor experience: PDA derivation and canonical bump handling, writing secure CPIs with correct privilege escalation and signer seed validation, custom account constraints and discriminator checks, zero\-copy deserialization for large account state, compute unit budgeting, and multisig upgrade authority flows
   

  

 Experience with on\-chain token mechanics: SPL tokens, emission schedules, burn instructions, staking/vesting contracts
   

  

 Strong Node.js/TypeScript skills on the backend: REST APIs, background workers, event\-driven systems, solid async patterns
   

  

 MongoDB for operational data, ClickHouse for analytics, Redis for caching and queues \- should be comfortable across all of these platforms
   

  

 Comfortable with the basics of DevOps: Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and deploying to cloud environments. You don't need to be running Kubernetes, but you shouldn't need to hand off a deployment either
   

  

 Someone who's genuinely comfortable owning integrations \- reading third\-party docs, making it work, and not waiting for someone to hand you a spec
   

  

 A good eye for on\-chain security: missing signer checks, unchecked arithmetic, insecure CPI targets, PDA substitution attacks \- you know these and you think about them before someone else points them out
   

  

 Backend security isn't an afterthought for you either \- you understand how to harden services that are directly handling wallet interactions and token flows
   

  

 You write tests like someone who's been burned before \- unit tests for individual instructions, integration tests that run against a local validator with realistic state, and E2E tests that simulate entire user journeys

 DePIN protocol experience, MongoDB and Clickhouse expertise
   

  

 Production Node.js backend experience — REST APIs, services, and event\-driven workers

title: EMBEDDED FIRMWARE ENGINEER
description:
**ABOUT US:**




  





 Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private\-sector satellite mass\-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high\-volume manufacturing.
 



  





 As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end\-to\-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost\-effective, high\-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.
 



  





  





**JOB SUMMARY:**




  





 As an
 **Embedded Firmware Engineer** 
 , you will own the full development lifecycle for high\-reliability, 32\-bit SoC, SoM, and microcontroller platforms powering our flight systems and payloads. You will work at the hardware\-software boundary—architecting boot flows, designing custom device drivers, and developing register\-level code built to withstand extreme operational constraints.
 



  





 In this role, you will collaborate closely with hardware, systems, and mission engineering teams. Your core success metrics center on system uptime, zero\-defect firmware builds, hardware\-in\-the\-loop validation accuracy, and adherence to safety\-critical aerospace coding standards.
 



  





  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**




  




* **Firmware Architecture \& Design:** 
 Architect, develop, and test low\-level embedded firmware for 32\-bit SoCs, SoMs, and MCUs (ARM Cortex\-M/A) deployed on orbital hardware.
* **Low\-Level Hardware Integration:** 
 Write register\-level drivers, custom bootloaders, and Board Support Packages (BSPs) while optimizing memory mapping and interrupt handling.
* **Communication \& Protocol Implementation:** 
 Develop and validate robust data pipelines across UART, SPI, I2C, USB, and Ethernet (UDP).
* **Board Bring\-Up \& Debugging:** 
 Lead board bring\-up by interpreting hardware schematics and utilizing JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and FPGA debugging tools.
* **Safety \& Reliability Standards:** 
 Enforce rigorous code quality via unit testing, static analysis, structured peer reviews, and adherence to safety\-critical compliance frameworks.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner with RF, power, and payload engineers to support system integration, environmental testing, and root\-cause analysis.



  





  





**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR?**




  




* **Education \& Experience:** 
 B.E./B.Tech in ECE, EEE, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience with 3–5 years of professional embedded firmware development.
* **Core Language Proficiency:** 
 Advanced proficiency in
 **Embedded C/C\+\+** 
 targeting resource\-constrained systems.
* **Processor Expertise:** 
 Hands\-on development on 32\-bit architectures (ARM Cortex\-M/A, STM32, NXP, TI, ESP32, Renesas).
* **RTOS \& Boot Flow:** 
 Demonstrated experience with
 **FreeRTOS** 
 (or equivalent RTOS), memory management, interrupt handling, and custom bootloader development.
* **Hardware Debugging:** 
 Proven ability to read schematics and debug at the bench using JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
* **Toolchains \& VCS:** 
 Experience with Git workflows, CMake/Make, and GCC\-based or vendor toolchains (Keil, IAR).



  





  





**PREFERRED \& NICE\-TO\-HAVE:**




  




* **Safety\-Critical Standards:** 
 Exposure to
 **MISRA C** 
 , DO\-178, IEC 61508, ISO 26262, or PTP 1588\.
* **Aerospace Domain Knowledge:** 
 Familiarity with radiation\-tolerant architectures, space payload telemetry, or mission\-critical embedded systems.
* **Test Automation:** 
 Experience building automated unit tests, HIL test setups, and CI/CD pipelines for firmware.



  





  





**WHY JOIN AZISTA SPACE?**




  




* **Real Flight Impact:** 
 Write software that actively flies in orbit and powers critical orbital constellations.
* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** 
 Work across the entire product lifecycle from blank\-canvas architecture to on\-orbit commissioning.
* **Pioneering Ecosystem:** 
 Be part of India's commercial space revolution with access to state\-of\-the\-art testing labs and satellite manufacturing infrastructure.
* **Engineering\-First Culture:** 
 Collaborate alongside top\-tier aerospace, RF, and hardware engineers solving hard physics and software challenges.

 Employment Type: Full Time
   

  

 Educational Qualification: Bachelor’s or higher degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent
   

  

 Work Experience: 2\-5 yrs
   

  

**Role Description**
 Pixxel is seeking a self\-motivated and detail\-oriented Embedded Linux Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will drive the design of cutting\-edge payload systems for Pixxel’s satellites from concept to production while ensuring that they meet the required standards. This role requires a strong understanding of embedded programming, operating systems (Linux, RTOS, etc.), and build systems (Yocto, PetaLinux, etc.).
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Duties**
* Closely collaborate with systems engineers to define the specifications, lead the software design/implementation, and integrate/validate software in a larger system.
* Mentor/coach engineers in the team to drive outcomes.
* Translate mission requirements and various satellite subsystem requirements into reliable flight software for Pixxel’s satellites.


**Minimum Requirements**
* 2\-5 years of hands\-on software design and development experience on complex embedded computing platforms.
* Strong in C/C\+\+ programming, data structures and algorithms
* Well\-versed with RTOS/Linux and ARM/RISC\-V processor architecture
* Hands\-on experience in designing and debugging user and kernel space drivers
* Experience with build tools, board support packages, bootloaders, and memory management
* Good debugging skills using Software/Hardware debuggers.
* Experience with CI/ID and using version control software (preferably Git).


**Preferred Requirements**
* Master’s degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering, Embedded Programming, or similar field
* Experience in designing safety/mission\-critical products is a bonus
* Knowledge of, or experience with, any of the following is a plus
+ AMD (previously Xilins), Microsemi, or related System on Chips (SoCs)
+ Yocto
+ Static analyzers and formal verification tools


**Candidate Acumen**
 A strong desire to work in a less\-structured, high\-growth, fast\-paced start\-up environment. The ideal candidate brings a track record of success in a similar role, strong interpersonal skills and a can\-do attitude.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Health insurance coverage
* Unlimited leaves \& flexible working hours
* Role\-based remote work and work\-from\-home benefit
* Relocation assistance
* Professional Mental Wellness services
* Creche facility for primary caregivers (limited to India)
* Employee Stock Options for all hires


**About Pixxel**
 Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first three commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5\-meter resolution and 135\+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.
   

  

 Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18\-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full\-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI\-powered analytics.
   

  

 Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in\-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high\-frequency imagery with AI\-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in\-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.
   

  

 Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission\-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long\-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space\-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.
   

  

 Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.
   

  

 For more information, see ourCareers page or follow Pixxel onLinkedIn andX/Twitter.
   

  

 Culture
   

  

 Pixxel is an organization where we enable our employees to work on world\-changing problems that they are passionate about, and a place where they can be their best selves day in and day out while ensuring they have fun every day.
   

  

 Central to our employee\-first ethos is a commitment to ensuring that every team member feels valued and heard. We nurture a healthy and supportive work environment where we prioritise well\-being and growth in all aspects of life

title: Wissenschaftl. Mitarbeitende*r (w/m/d) – Sichere KI für Robotik
description:
Sie möchten daran arbeiten, dass
 **Mensch und Roboter künftig sicher und zuverlässig im Team zusammenarbeiten** 
 ? In diesem Forschungsprojekt verbinden Sie
 **formale Sicherheitsmechanismen mit multimodalen Large\-Language\-Modellen auf eingebetteten Systemen** 
 . Ziel ist es, autonome Robotersysteme so zu entwickeln, dass sie auch bei komplexen Aufgaben – etwa in der großskaligen Montage – intelligent agieren, ihre Umgebung verstehen und gleichzeitig höchste Sicherheitsanforderungen erfüllen.
   

  

**Das Machen Sie Möglich**
 Sie ermöglichen den sicheren Betrieb von Robotern, die auf der Basis von Vision\-Language\-Action\-Modellen (VLA) im Team mit einem Menschen autonom Aufgaben planen und ausführen. Dazu erforschen Sie konkret, wie man den Output der VLA\-Modelle für formale Sicherheitsmechnismen auf Basis von Kontrakten zugänglich macht (Neuro\-Symbolisches Reasoning) und wie diese Mechanismen für Feedback und Training des VLA\-Modells genutzt werden können. Bei der Ausführung der Aktionen erforschen Sie einen Fallback\-Mechanismus, der im Falle einer Beeinträchtigung der KI\-Funktionen dennoch ein minimal akzeptables Roboterverhalten gewährleistet. Das Forschungsprojekt wird in enger internationaler Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern in Taiwan durchgeführt. Im Rahmen dieser Kooperation arbeiten Sie auch vor Ort mit den Projektpartnern zusammen. Hierfür sind während der Projektlaufzeit mehrfach Forschungsaufenthalte in Taiwan von jeweils etwa ein bis zwei Monaten vorgesehen.
   

  

**Das Bringen Sie Mit**
* Master\-Abschluss Informatik oder vergleichbar
* Erfahrungen mit der Programmierung von leistungsfähigen eingebetteten Systemen, idealerweise inkl. Beschleuniger (GPU/NPU)
* Grundkenntnisse von formalen oder semi\-formalen Methoden (z.B. Model\-Checking)
* Kenntnisse im Bereich Scheduling und Echtzeitsysteme
* Bereitschaft zu mehrwöchigen Forschungsaufenthalten in Taiwan im Rahmen der internationalen Projektzusammenarbeit


**Das Bieten Wir Ihnen**
* Freuen Sie sich auf ein menschlich angenehmes und fachlich interessantes Arbeitsumfeld
* Wir unterstützen Sie aktiv bei Ihrer beruflichen Weiterqualifikation
* Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie sind uns wichtig – dies unterstützen wir u.a. mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice
* Toleranz, Offenheit und Chancengleichheit gegenüber Personen aller Geschlechter (m/w/d) sind uns wichtig
* Unseren seit Jahren steigenden Frauenanteil möchten wir gerne weiterhin wachsen lassen
* Bewerbungen schwerbehinderter Menschen bevorzugen wir bei fachlicher Eignung
* Ihre Stelle ist befristet auf zwei Jahre und wird nach TV\-L Gruppe E13 vergütet


 OFFIS ist ein 1991 gegründetes, international ausgerichtetes, anwendungsorientiertes Forschungs\- und Entwicklungsinstitut für Informatik mit Sitz im niedersächsischen Oldenburg. In durchschnittlich 70 laufenden Projekten leistet OFFIS mit seinen rund 200 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern Forschung und prototypische Entwicklungsarbeit auf höchstem internationalem Niveau in den Bereichen Energie, Gesellschaft, Gesundheit und Produktion. Dabei kooperiert OFFIS mit weltweit über 700 Partnern aus Wirtschaft und Wissenschaft.

title: Senior Robotics Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 GE Vernova’s Advanced Research business is the central innovation engine for GE’s portfolio of energy businesses, which is unified under one banner called GE Vernova. The research organization is made up of 300\+ researchers representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline. Collectively, they are driving major research programs and initiatives to decarbonize power, accelerate renewables, and promote electrification and the creation of a 21st century grid fit to power a zero\-carbon energy future.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Robotics Engineer to develop advanced automation solutions for manufacturing processes across GE Vernova’s operations. The ideal candidate will possess a strong robotics and controls background with hands\-on expertise in implementing automation solutions in manufacturing environments. This role will focus on designing and deploying robotic systems while leveraging principles of lean to optimize production lines and workflows.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Roles and responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of cutting\-edge robotic and automation solutions for manufacturing lines, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
* Collaborate closely with manufacturing teams to analyze existing workflows, identify automation opportunities, and implement innovative solutions that improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Develop and program industrial robots, including their kinematics, motion planning, and application\-specific tasks.
* Integrate robotic systems with supervisory control systems and other manufacturing equipment, ensuring seamless interoperability.
* Apply machine vision technologies, including camera systems and image processing algorithms, for part recognition, inspection, and alignment.
* Travel to manufacturing sites as needed to collaborate with plant teams, understand operational processes, and evaluate implementation success.
* Conduct feasibility studies, proof\-of\-concepts, and prototyping for new robotic and automation technologies tailored to specific manufacturing challenges.
* Develop quick proof\-of\-concepts and demonstrate their value in a lab environment prior to full\-scale deployment.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues in deployed systems, ensuring maximum equipment uptime and performance.
* Maintain detailed technical documentation, including designs, programming approaches, system architecture, and lessons learned.
* Stay abreast of advances in robotics, automation, and manufacturing technologies by attending conferences, reviewing literature, and fostering collaboration with academic and industry partners.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers in robotics and automation concepts, fostering knowledge sharing across the team.
* Drive innovation by contributing to intellectual property development and filing patents related to robotics and automation solutions.


**Required Qualifications**
* PhD in Robotics, Controls, Mechatronics, or a related field from a top\-ranked university (India or abroad), OR a master’s degree with demonstrated industry excellence and practical experience.
* 8–13 years of hands\-on experience implementing robotics and automation solutions in manufacturing environments.
* Strong foundational knowledge in robotic systems, including kinematics, dynamics, and control systems.
* Proficient in robot programming (e.g., ABB, Fanuc, KUKA, Mitsubishi, or Universal Robots), including offline programming tools and simulation environments.
* Experience with machine vision systems (e.g., OpenCV, Cognex, or Halcon) and their integration to enhance automation workflows.
* Solid understanding of manufacturing concepts and a track record of deploying automation solutions in real\-world scenarios.
* Proficiency in relevant programming languages (e.g., Python, C\+\+, MATLAB), industrial automation tools, and control system design software.
* Willingness to travel to manufacturing sites and work closely with plant teams to evaluate processes and implement automation solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to critically assess manufacturing challenges and design innovative solutions that address operational inefficiencies.
* Ability to develop quick proof\-of\-concepts and demonstrate the value in a lab environment prior to full\-scale industrial deployment.
* Strong leadership skills, with proven capability to guide teams through technical challenges and project execution.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills to collaborate across diverse teams of engineers, product managers, and manufacturing teams.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Proficiency in integrating AIML with robotics to enhance automation capabilities and decision\-making.
* Expertise in lean manufacturing principles, process optimization, and waste reduction within production lines.
* Proficiency in integrating robots into industrial automation environments, including PLCs, SCADA systems, and IoT\-enabled devices.
* Familiarity with digital twin technologies and their use in optimizing robotics and automation deployments.
* Publication and patenting experience demonstrating thought leadership in robotics and automation.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity and data integrity concerns related to automation and robotics systems in manufacturing environments.

 Yes

title: Product Associate
description:
**The Short Version**




  





**Who we’re looking for:** 
 A Product Associate who thinks in terms of problems, systems, and leverage \- and operates in an AI\-native way to build and deliver outcomes. You’re someone who is equally comfortable structuring ambiguous problems and getting your hands dirty building and testing solutions, with a strong bias toward action and real\-world validation.
 



  





**What the role is about:** 
 At Kraftshala, product sits at the intersection of student experience, revenue (admissions, sales, marketing), and internal operations. You will identify high\-impact problems across these areas and take them from idea to outcome. A defining part of this role is the ability to translate ideas into working solutions quickly — using AI\-assisted prototyping, APIs, and lightweight systems to test, iterate, and refine before scaling with engineering.
 



  





**What makes this role meaningful:** 
 You will operate across multiple parts of the business with clear ownership and a direct connection between what you build and the outcomes it drives. The environment values speed, clarity of thought, and a problem\-first approach — with strong emphasis on AI\-enabled execution.
 



  





**Why you should apply:** 



* You’ll get the opportunity to work across multiple high\-stakes problem areas
* You will operate with high autonomy and faster execution cycles, moving beyond documentation\-heavy product work into actually building, testing, and validating solutions yourself.
* This role enables you to develop an AI\-native way of working \- where you can prototype quickly, automate workflows, and run rapid experiments instead of waiting on long development cycles.



 If you’re looking for a role where you can own meaningful problems, build quickly, and see the impact of your work end\-to\-end, this is the role for you.
 



  





**About us:** 
 Kraftshala is India’s largest higher\-education institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.
 



  





 We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.
 



  





**The Detailed Version**




  





 As a Product Associate at Kraftshala, you will own high\-impact problems across students, internal teams (admissions, sales, placements, operations, marketing), and external users. You will operate across the full lifecycle — from problem identification and structuring to solution design, execution, and measurable outcomes.
 



  





 A core expectation in this role is the ability to increase your execution leverage — using AI\-assisted prototyping, LLM integrations, and modular systems to move from idea to usable output quickly, validate in real contexts, and refine before scaling.
 



  





**What you’ll own:** 




  




* Problem Discovery \& Structuring: Identify and prioritize high\-impact problems across student journeys, revenue funnels, and internal workflows.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Number of validated problems, clarity of problem definition, stakeholder alignment
* Solution Design with Business Context: Design solutions grounded in user needs, operational constraints, and business impact.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Expected vs actual impact, solution adoption, problem\-solution fit
* AI\-Assisted Prototyping \& Rapid Build: Use AI\-assisted prototyping, prompt engineering, and tools (e.g., Cursor, Replit, Claude, Copilot) to build MVPs, workflows, or automations quickly.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Time from idea to prototype, number of experiments run, validation rate before engineering involvement
* Execution \& Delivery with Engineering: Work with engineering to productionize and scale validated solutions.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Sprint predictability, on\-time delivery %, rework, cycle time
* Workflow Automation \& Systems Improvement: Build and improve internal tools, AI\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and integrations to reduce manual effort and increase efficiency.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Reduction in manual effort, turnaround time improvement, process efficiency gains
* Iteration, Experimentation \& Impact Ownership: Run tight build\-measure\-learn loops and continuously refine solutions.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Feature adoption, conversion improvement, operational efficiency, experiment velocity



  





**How you’ll operate:** 



* You move fluidly between problem thinking and hands\-on building
* You use AI as a force multiplier across workflows and execution
* You design AI\-in\-the\-loop systems where AI drafts, routes, summarizes, or assists decisions
* You prioritize speed to insight over perfect upfront planning
* You think in systems, not just features



  





**Monthly Outcomes**




  





**Month 1:** 



* Build strong understanding of users, systems, and business priorities
* Identify and validate at least 2 meaningful problem areas
* Ship at least one improvement (feature, workflow, or automation)



  





**Month 2:** 



* Own planning and alignment with engineering
* Translate validated problems into clear solutions
* Prototype and test before scaling
* Roll out at least one meaningful system improvement



  





**Month 3\+:** 



* Deliver 2–3 high\-impact initiatives per quarter
* Contribute to and progressively take ownership of a problem\-led roadmap
* Improve execution speed through better systems and iteration loops
* Become a trusted problem solver for cross\-functional teams



  





**Must Haves:**




  




* 18\-24 months of product management experience for any digital product or online platform
 *(We’re not fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level.)*
* Hands\-on experience or strong inclination toward AI\-assisted prototyping, LLM integrations / prompt engineering, RAG, AI evals, or agent workflows (preferred)
* Exposure to sales, marketing, or operational workflows
* Strong execution orientation with a bias for action
* Experience or demonstrated interest in building or improving internal tools or systems
* Familiarity or willingness to get hands\-on with APIs, integrations, and modern tooling



  





**Selection Process:**




  





 As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30\-60 minutes.
 



  




1. **Setting Expectations:** 
 This will be a call to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.
2. **Technical Exercise:** 
 This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
3. **Conversation 1:** 
 This will be a detailed assessment review conversation to go over your submission for the technical exercise along with other competencies required for the role.
4. **Conversation 2:** 
 A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode.
5. **Extending an offer:** 
 If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.



  





**Location:** 




 Delhi
 



  





**Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors
 
 here
 
 .**

title: Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Role: Product Manager**
**Location: Bengaluru**
**What You’ll Do**
 We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better.
   

  

 As a Product Manager in our Product department, you’ll have the chance to:
   

  

* Ideate, vision, validate and help build key data management features which is at the core of MiQ’s data\-driven programmatic media offering.
* Collaborate with product stakeholders to research, validate and prioritize new features that align with business priorities
* Identify and work closely with key internal and external partners to ensure that MIQ product roadmap is additive
* Integrate usability studies, research and market analysis into product requirements
* Lead the ideation, technical development, launch and continued adoption of features you build
* Drive product development with a team of world\-class engineers \& data scientists.
* Define, collect and analyse metrics that inform the success of the product


**Who are your stakeholders?**
* Internal and enterprise users, alongside finance, corresponding product teams and surrounding teams across the business with be your primary stakeholders
* Product stakeholders across the product and tech team, such as platform product managers, engineers, data scientists, and UX/UI designers will be your secondary stakeholders


**What You’ll Bring**
* Prior Experience in Product Management for a minimum of 2\+ years
* Prior exposure to advertising technology is preferable
* Prior experience in an analytical or technology\-oriented role
* Prior experience of stakeholder interaction, managing conflicting requirements/priorities across stakeholders
* Willingness to try new technologies and ability to grasp and learn quickly
* Comfort with numbers and a quantitative approach to solve problems


 We’ve highlighted some key skills, experience and requirements for this role. But please don’t worry if you don’t meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that’s a fit for this role, or another opportunity at MiQ.
   

  

 If you have a passion for the role, please still apply.
   

  

**What impact will you create?**
 Campaign Management is the central hub of all live campaigns \- from booking sign off to close and invoice, it provides a central view point of cost, performance and profit in real time. You will be helping build key functionality to save traders time and provide the foundations to enable surrounding product capabilities, such as reporting and optimisation.
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
 Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it’s where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact across our entire global business.
   

  

 MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.

**Job Description**
**Job Description – Product Manager, Hematology**
 Reporting To: Marketing Lead – Hematology
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Product Manager – Hematology will support the execution of strategic priorities across the Hematology portfolio, with accountability for Reimbursed Business strategy execution, brand marketing initiatives, congress and conference management, disease awareness programs, sales force capability building, and portfolio\-wide project governance. The role will partner closely with Senior Product Managers and cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure execution excellence, deliver impactful customer engagement initiatives, generate actionable business insights, and drive organizational effectiveness across the Hematology franchise.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Reimbursed Business (RB) Strategy \& Execution

* Coordinate and track key RB projects and strategic priorities.
* Monitor performance of reimbursed accounts and programs and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop execution frameworks, communication materials and performance reviews supporting RB initiatives.
* Brand Promotions, Strategic Initiatives \& Analytics
* Develop promotional and engagement materials in partnership with Medical, Regulatory, Legal and Compliance teams.
* Support strategic initiatives across Darzalex and the Bispecifics portfolio.
* Drive analytics, performance tracking and insight generation to support business decisions.
* Monitor campaign effectiveness and recommend optimization opportunities.
* Support planning and execution of key brand campaigns and customer engagement initiatives.
* Hematology Conferences, Congresses \& Customer Activations
* Own end\-to\-end planning and execution of Hematology participation in third\-party conferences and scientific meetings.
* Lead promotional stalls, booth activities, scientific sessions, digital standees and customer engagement activations.
* Manage agencies, vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution.
* Ensure all activities comply with organizational and industry requirements.
* Conduct post\-event evaluations and derive actionable insights.
* Disease Awareness \& Partnership Programs
* Lead Hematology disease\-awareness initiatives across priority tumor areas.
* Support development and execution of strategic partnerships with professional societies, institutions and ecosystem stakeholders.
* Drive omnichannel awareness and stakeholder engagement programs.
* Monitor and evaluate campaign impact against defined KPIs.
* Sales Force Training \& Capability Building
* Drive planning and execution of training programs across the Hematology portfolio.
* Support development of product training, campaign briefings, launch readiness and competitive preparedness modules.
* Build capabilities that enhance scientific knowledge and customer engagement effectiveness.
* Monitor training outcomes and address capability gaps through targeted interventions.

* Lead cross\-functional strategic projects across the Hematology portfolio.
* Serve as a central coordination point between Marketing, Medical Affairs, Sales, Market Access, Finance, Regulatory and external partners.
* Drive governance processes, milestone tracking and action planning.
* Maintain dashboards and trackers for leadership reviews and business updates.
* Identify risks, bottlenecks and interdependencies and proactively drive solutions.
* Support annual business planning, strategic reviews and launch readiness initiatives.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA from a reputed institute with specialization in Marketing.
* 3–6 years of pharmaceutical marketing experience; Hematology or any other therapy experience is preferred.
* Strong analytical, project management and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in congress management, promotional material development and field engagement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic Thinking
* Business Acumen
* Execution Excellence
* Project Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Marketing Analytics
* Brand Management
* Congress \& Event Management
* Training \& Capability Building
* Learning Agility.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 A high\-potential marketer with strong execution discipline, analytical rigor and the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously. The individual should be comfortable working across brands, collaborating with senior stakeholders, driving field execution and taking ownership of high\-visibility projects that shape the growth trajectory of the Hematology franchise.

 Reimbursed Business (20%)
   

  

* Execution of annual RB initiatives: ≥95% completed on time
* Monthly RB reporting: 100% on\-time delivery
* Strategic project milestone adherence: ≥90%
* Stakeholder satisfaction: \>4\.2/5
* Action\-item closure within timelines: ≥90%

* Promotional material delivery: ≥95% on time
* MLR approval efficiency: ≥90% approved within first/second review cycle
* Strategic initiative execution: ≥90% versus annual plan
* Analytics and business reviews: 100% on time


 Congresses \& External Engagements (20%)
   

  

* 100% execution of approved congresses
* Budget adherence within ±5%
* Vendor deliverables ≥95% on time
* Post\-event report within 10 working days
* Stakeholder satisfaction \>4\.2/5


 Disease Awareness \& Partnerships (15%)
   

  

* ≥90% campaign plan execution
* ≥90% partnership milestones achieved

* ≥90% strategic projects completed on time

* Execute 95%\+ of annual Hematology marketing initiatives within agreed timelines and budget.

* Investigation, and a sense for where recurring workflows can be automated rather than just executed

* Python/R for data exploration

description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
   

  

 Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
   

  

 Ensures adherence to agreed PM guidelines and operation standards on behalf of PMO Head or PMO Manager.
   

  

**Job Description – Software Project Manager**
* Plan, coordinate and supervise site preparations and advise customers and contractors for the installation of SHS software products and related hardware, to ensure efficient and timely execution of installations and upgrades according to technical and safety regulations and maximize customer satisfaction.


**Major Responsibilities**
* Review of SHS sales orders and contract upgrades for the assigned region to ensure the deliverables are compatible and achievable
* Coordinate and supervise site preparations with customers, in order to ensure sites are contractually compliant for SHS products installations
* Provide project management services by planning SHS activities and resources for installation of SHS products on prepared customer sites, to ensure installations and upgrades can be carried out from start to end according to plans established and contracts agreed with customers
* Collect documents of Acceptance Test results, to ensure that all contractual conditions are met according to schedule for final handover of the installation project to the customers
* Plan, design and manage the implementation of all new system installations and large system upgrades, to ensure highest quality whilst minimizing costs
* Interface externally with customers and 3rd party vendors / architects for the timely execution of projects to ensure that they can perform their work according to established installation project plans and that necessary actions are taken to resolve issues and problems
* Record all information resulting from project meetings and site inspections with customers, SHS installation engineers and external contractors, in order to provide all parties, the necessary information to enable them to perform their activities according to established installation project plans
* Maintain procedures and tools such as Task\-Ray, Dashboard, Gantt charts, Travel reports, check lists and escalation reports to enable all parties to perform their activities according to established installation project plans
* Interface internally with Installation Supervisors/Peer Project Managers / sales organization / order processing / centralized services to provide them the necessary technical support on installations and optimize customer relations
* Develop and maintain close working relationships between SHS sales, order processing, installation teams, applications teams, Global and regional service managers, to achieve smooth processing of customer orders according to installation and upgrade plans and provide regular reports on ongoing installation projects
* Monitor installation process indicators and conduct debriefings, in order to track issues and take corrective actions to solve problems and ensure installations are carried out according to established installation project plans. Monitor customer facility preparation and coordinate equipment shipment schedules to ensure timely and effective installation and commissioning of equipment
* At completion of a project, collect relevant documents such as but not limited to:
* Acceptance Test results
* Acceptance Letters and/or Installation Verification Forms
* Customer configuration information
* to ensure that all contractual conditions are met according to schedule for final handover of the installation project to the customer and local SHS Service
* Provide accurate data for revenue recognition to ensure accurate forecasting.
* Review / approve documentation flow per project to use consistent work methods
* Perform other duties as assigned
* As a subject matter expert, delivers product and/or procedural training to other project managers.

title: Engineer- Project Planning & Control
description:
**Candidate Profile** 





 The candidate will be responsible for planning and monitoring machine manufacturing projects from order release through component procurement, machining, fabrication, assembly, testing, and final dispatch. The role will also involve identifying machining requirements for outsourcing, developing reliable machining vendors and ensuring components are completed and handed over to the Kitting Store group\-wise as per the project schedule.
 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilties** 




  





 1\. Project Planning \& Control
 



  





 \- Prepare detailed project plans, schedules and timelines for machine manufacturing projects.
 



 \- Monitor project progress against planned targets and identify delays at an early stage.
 



 \- Track critical\-path activities and ensure timely completion of critical components.
 



 \- Coordinate with Design, Purchase, Production, Quality, Assembly and other departments.
 



 \- Prepare daily/weekly project status reports and MIS.
 



 \- Develop recovery plans for delayed activities and follow up until closure.
 



 \- Ensure projects are completed within committed delivery schedules.
 



  





 2\. Machining \& Outsourcing Planning
 



  





 \- Understand machining processes such as turning, milling, VMC/HMC, CNC machining, grinding, drilling, boring, EDM,Wire cut etc.
 



 \- Review drawings/BOMs and identify components or machining operations suitable for outsourcing.
 



 \- Plan machining activities based on internal capacity, machine availability and project priorities.
 



 \- Coordinate with vendors for machining of components as per drawing, quality and delivery requirements.
 



  





 3\.Surface Treatment Management:
 



  





 \- Coordinate and monitor surface treatment processes after machining, such as plating, coating, painting, anodizing, blackening, heat treatment or other specified treatments as applicable.
 



 \- Identify surface treatment requirements from drawings, BOMs and technical specifications.
 



 \- Coordinate with approved surface treatment vendors and ensure components are processed as per required specifications.
 



 \-Plan surface treatment activities in line with the project schedule to avoid delays.
 



 Ensure proper inspection and documentation of surface\-treated components before receiving them into stores.
 



 \- Follow up on quality issues, rejections and rework related to surface treatment.
 



  





 4\. Vendor Development
 



  





 \- Identify and develop suitable machining vendors based on machine capability, capacity, quality and delivery performance.
 



 \- Conduct technical evaluation of new vendors.
 



 \- Negotiate and finalize machining requirements in coordination with theVendor.
 



 \- Monitor vendor performance and take corrective actions for quality or delivery issues.
 



 \- Develop alternate vendors for critical and high\-risk components.
 



  





 5\. Project Coordination
 



  





 \- Conduct regular project review meetings and follow up on action points.
 



 \- Maintain project\-wise component status and pending lists.
 



 \- Highlight/Escalation potential risks related to machining, vendors, materials, capacity and delivery.
 



 \- Coordinate priority changes according to project requirements.
 



  





 6\. Documentation \& Reporting
 



  





 \- Maintain project schedules, BOM/component tracking, vendor status and delivery plans.
 



 \- Prepare project progress reports and management dashboards.
 



 \- Track planned vs. actual (Gantt Chart) completion of major activities.
 



 \- Maintain records of delayed components, reasons and corrective actions.
 



 \- Support management in project status reviews and decision\-making.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





 \- Diploma / BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
 



 \- Experience in machine manufacturing, special\-purpose machines, industrial machinery or engineering projects preferred.
 



 \- Good practical knowledge of machining processes and engineering drawings.
 



 \- Experience in machining outsourcing and vendor development will be highly preferred.
 



 \- Good knowledge of project planning, scheduling and follow\-up.
 



 \- Strong coordination and communication skills.
 



 \- Good knowledge of MS Excel and project planning tools.
 



 \- Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
 



 \- Strong problem\-solving and follow\-up skills.

**Job Description:**
**The Role**
 This position is for a Technical Program Manager (TPM), within the Program Management Office (PMO) at SiFive. The primary charter for this group is to plan and manage the execution of processor core IP development programs from initial engineering scoping through product release. As a TPM at SiFive, you will work with engineers passionate about designing industry\-leading CPU cores and the tools, software and infrastructure to realize that vision, as well as a product marketing team focused on bringing RISC\-V to new markets. SiFive is a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with lots of opportunities, and we are looking for people who are as excited as we are about bringing new IP and complete solutions to market predictably, quickly, and at a high level of quality. An ideal candidate will have experience with bringing processor IP to production, as well as familiarity with the software development and release process. Experience managing hardware development programs using AGILE methodology is a plus.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Collaborate with stakeholders/technical leads in cross\-functional teams to develop schedule, resourcing allocation, and overall plan to meet program goals.
* Build a plan for effective execution, monitoring/tracking and identifying critical paths, program risks and issues, from planning through execution, delivery, and support phases.
* Co\-ordinate cross\-functional group activities, track dependencies. Drive teams to meet schedules and goals.
* Participate in technical discussions, be able to resolve high\-level project issues.
* Lead tasks, issues reporting and resolution.
* Responsible for effective and consistent communication and reporting of overall program status.
* Participate in developing, improving project, program management, and product life cycle processes.


**Requirements:**
* Experience with CPU technology and associated software and tools development.
* Ability to facilitate technical discussions and can drive engineering decisions.
* Proficiency with Git/Github, JIRA, Confluence.
* Excellent organization, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Experience with project and program management tools and processes for effective, efficient planning and execution is a strong plus.
* BS/MS degree in EE, CE, CS or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.

 India
