title: Apprentice - Project Management
description:
**Job Description**
 The Apprentice–Trainee will support the project team in learning and performing essential tasks that contribute to the successful delivery of Oceaneering projects. Working under the guidance of experienced staff, you will assist with basic project coordination, documentation, and communication while developing foundational skills in project controls and teamwork. This role offers hybrid work options based on project needs and may include domestic and international travel up to 25% of the year as part of your training and development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Learn about the company tools, processes, and procedures.
* Learn project lifecycle and project execution activities from experienced professionals.
* Gain knowledge, skills, and experience throughout the internship.
* Learn how to maintain all relevant documentation as per the regional project management practices (SoW documents, change requests, schedules, risk register etc.)
* Understand project specific deliverables, timelines, contractual terms and conditions \& agreements.
* Support project management professionals on project deliverables.
* Learn how to Communicate regular and effective project updates to all stakeholders.


 NON\-ESSENTIAL
   

  

* Assist with any other duties as and when required.
* Undertake specific assignments/tasks as instructed by management.
* Demonstrates high level of initiative to accomplish individual objectives assigned as well as team goals.


**Required**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
**Graduate In Engineering (Preferred In Mechanical Or Allied Branch).**
 DESIRED
   

  

**Familiarity With Project Management Terminologies (Preferred With Some Certification)**
 Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
   

  

**About Us**
 Oceaneering is a global provider of engineered services and products, primarily to the offshore energy industry. We develop products and services for use throughout the lifecycle of an offshore oilfield, from drilling to decommissioning. We operate the world's premier fleet of work class ROVs. Additionally, we are a leader in offshore oilfield maintenance services, umbilicals, subsea hardware, and tooling. We also use applied technology expertise to serve the defense, material handling, aerospace, science, and renewable energy industries.
   

  

**Overview**
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
 Since year 2003, Oceaneering’s India Center has been an integral part of operations for Oceaneering’s robust product and service offerings across the globe. This center caters to diverse business needs, from oil and gas field infrastructure, subsea robotics to automated material handling \& logistics.
   

  

 Our multidisciplinary team offers a wide spectrum of solutions, encompassing Subsea Engineering, Robotics, Automation, Control Systems, Software Development, Asset Integrity Management, Inspection, ROV operations, Field Network Management, Graphics Design \& Animation, and more.
   

  

 In addition to these technical functions, Oceaneering India Center plays host to several crucial business functions, including Finance, Supply Chain Management (SCM), Information Technology (IT), Human Resources (HR), and Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE).
   

  

 Our world class infrastructure in India includes modern offices, industry\-leading tools and software, equipped labs, and beautiful campuses aligned with the future way of work. Oceaneering in India as well as globally has a great work culture that is flexible, transparent, and collaborative with great team synergy.
   

  

 At Oceaneering India Center, we take pride in “Solving the Unsolvable” by leveraging the diverse expertise within our team. Join us in shaping the future of technology and engineering solutions on a global scale.

title: Project Manager - Power Electronics Converters
description:
**Job Description: Project Manager – Power Electronics Converter Development (3–5 Years Experience)**
**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented
 **Project Manager** 
 with
 **3–5 years of experience** 
 in
 **power electronics product development** 
 to lead end\-to\-end execution of converter\-based projects (DC\-DC / AC\-DC). The role involves cross\-functional coordination, technical understanding, supplier engagement, and ensuring timely delivery aligned with cost, quality, and performance targets.

* Track supplier deliverables, lead times, and risks

* Develop and track mitigation plans
* Handle change management and deviations effectively
* Escalate critical issues in a structured and timely manner

+ Supplier alternatives
+ Value engineering initiatives

* Support design reviews, validation plans, and testing milestones
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability


**Documentation \& Reporting**
* Maintain:
+ Project plans
+ Risk registers
+ Meeting minutes
+ Status reports

* Prepare and present periodic project updatesincluding:
+ Milestones
+ Risks \& mitigation
+ Cost \& resource status
+ Support required


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical / Electronics / Power Electronics Engineering
* PMP /Scrum master certification is a plus
* 3–5 years of experiencein:
+ Power electronics product development OR
+ Engineering project management in electronics domain


**Required Skills**
**Technical Skills**
* Basic understanding of:
+ Power electronics converters (DC\-DC, AC\-DC)
+ PCB development lifecycle
+ Thermal and EMI considerations

* Familiarity with tools (preferred):
+ MS Project / Excel\-based trackers
+ MS Visio


**Project Management Skills**
* Strong planning, scheduling, and coordination capability
* Experience with structured methodologies (APQP, Stage\-Gate preferred)
* Ability to manage multiple vendors and cross\-functional teams


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making
* Ability to work under tight timelines and dynamic environments
* High level of ownership and accountability


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in industrial, automotive, or railway power electronics applications
* Exposure to:
+ Industrialization activities
+ Supply chain coordination
+ Prototype to production transition


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* On\-time milestone achievement
* Cost adherence vs. plan
* Risk closure effectiveness
* Supplier delivery performance
* Quality of project documentation and reporting

title: Scrum Master
description:
Facilitate core Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective) to help the team deliver committed outcomes each sprint.
   

  

 Coach the team on Agile/Scrum fundamentals and reinforce agreed working agreements, Definition of Ready, and Definition of Done.
   

  

 Partner with the Product Owner to support healthy backlog refinement, clear acceptance criteria, and a shared understanding of priorities.
   

  

 Remove or escalate impediments in a timely manner and help the team navigate blockers, risks, and dependencies with guidance from more senior Scrum Masters or leaders.
   

  

 Use Jira/Azure Boards (or similar tools) to maintain accurate boards, sprint metrics, and team transparency (e.g., sprint progress, throughput/velocity trends, and impediment logs).
   

  

 Promote collaboration across engineering, product, and partner functions to improve flow, quality, and predictability of delivery.
   

  

 Support continuous improvement by helping the team identify, prioritize, and track actions from retrospectives.

title: Specialist, Technology Delivery
description:
**Role: Specialist, Technology Delivery** 




 Role Overview
 



 We are seeking a talented Specialist, Technology Delivery to oversee the successful execution of product and project deliverables for our customers. The ideal candidate will possess a strong blend of leadership, accountability, product development, problem\-solving abilities, and communication skills.
 



 In addition to delivery execution, this role is responsible for coaching Agile teams toward higher levels of effectiveness, fostering psychologically safe team environments, and driving continuous improvement through data\-informed decision making.
 



 The Specialist, Technology Delivery will lead a development team and collaborate closely with other teams to ensure delivery of products on time and within budget and scope. This role plays a critical part in representing and advocating for the Agile team at the program level, balancing stakeholder needs with team sustainability and delivery health.
 



 This role is vital to fostering strong relationships, driving positive change, and enabling teams to deliver high\-quality, customer\-centric outcomes.
 



 Core Responsibilities
 


  

  
* Deeply understand the context of capabilities and epics (created by Product Management) in order to effectively break down, create, and refine user stories with development team members, including clearly articulating functional and non\-functional requirements and user story acceptance criteria.
* Support teams in facilitating Agile ceremonies, including daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint reviews.
* Coach Agile teams beyond ceremony facilitation by improving team maturity, enabling self\-management, and guiding teams toward ownership of outcomes.
* Lead and oversee the successful delivery of products, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and meet defined quality standards and requirements.
* Lead and inspire project teams, fostering a collaborative, results\-driven culture.
* Promote effective and transparent communication across teams and stakeholders.
* Cultivate a psychologically safe team environment where all voices are heard and healthy conflict is managed constructively.
* Maintain a strong pulse on team health, morale, and engagement, proactively addressing challenges that impact performance.
* Establish and sustain a culture of continuous improvement (kaizen), leveraging retrospectives, experimentation, and feedback loops.
* Promote learning, capability building, and cross\-functional collaboration within and across teams.
* Encourage teams to adopt a mindset of ongoing growth, adaptability, and performance optimization.
* Prioritize commitments with development teams while incorporating product feedback to maximize customer value.
* Ensure prioritization decisions optimize value delivery, focusing on outcomes rather than output.
* Partner with Product Management to align team execution with product vision and business goals.
* Effectively communicate work in progress, outcomes, and delivery status to stakeholders, accommodating and negotiating needs while maintaining alignment with organizational priorities.
* Act as the primary advocate for the Agile team, representing team needs, constraints, and trade\-offs to stakeholders and leadership.
* Protect team focus by managing external demands and minimizing unnecessary disruptions.
* Identify and manage dependencies collaboratively across teams.
* Proactively coordinate with internal and external teams to optimize end\-to\-end delivery flow.
* Ensure alignment between team\-level execution and broader program objectives.
* Rapidly identify, communicate, and escalate risks and impediments with appropriate urgency.
* Continuously assess risks by evaluating probability, impact, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to develop and execute effective risk mitigation strategies through to resolution.
* Track and socialize team performance goals and metrics, including velocity and capacity.
* Analyze delivery metrics such as flow efficiency, cycle time, and throughput to identify systemic issues.
* Use data to inform planning, forecasting, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Facilitate the creation, maintenance, and accountability of team ways of working.
* Maintain proper tool hygiene for team artifacts, including user stories, backlogs, dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Continuously improve team and departmental delivery practices.
* Develop a strong understanding of the team's technical work and systems to effectively guide delivery decisions and facilitate meaningful discussions.
* Act as a translator between technical and non\-technical stakeholders when necessary.
* Contribute to the Delivery Management community of practice by sharing knowledge, mentoring peers, and promoting cross\-team alignment.
* Support consistency and excellence in delivery management practices across the organization.

 This role is a phenomenal launchpad for a junior designer looking to master the complexities of scaling the UX process across diverse product managers, developers, and global stakeholders. Based in our Chennai office, you will handle well\-defined, high\-impact design challenges. You will get immediate, hands\-on exposure to cutting\-edge design frontiers, such as crafting conversational AI assistants within spatial map environments, mapping seamless cloud connectivity for rugged field hardware, and turning complex data collection into intuitive mobile modules.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* Core Product Redesign \& AI Integration: Assist Senior UX Designers with core application overhauls and modules, focusing directly on the development of an intelligent AI assistant integrated within our geospatial map viewers.
* Feature Migration \& Scaling: Help detail the migration of critical field data collection capabilities into our core platform ecosystem and its corresponding vertical market editions.
* Cloud Connectivity Design: Support peer designers in detailing how field hardware connects dynamically to cloud applications, incorporating contextual cloud\-tips to enhance user onboarding across verticals.
* Research \& Customer Validation: Support user research and synthesis during field site visits for high\-priority initiatives, while leading customer validation efforts for interactive prototypes and new feature designs.
* Cross\-Functional Agile Alignment: Work closely with cross\-functional global engineering and PM teams on well\-defined design tasks, leveraging our central style guide to maintain impeccable visual consistency.

* Agile Frameworks: Practical experience or structural familiarity working with UX processes inside an Agile product development environment.
* Growth Mindset: An eager, proactive "learn\-by\-doing" attitude, an appreciation for beautiful detail, a strong team spirit, and a willingness to accept creative direction.


**Bonus Points For**
* AI Prototyping: Direct project experience or a demonstrable interest in designing conversational AI tools and leveraging AI\-assisted prototyping workflows.
* Emerging Trends: Familiarity with emerging design technologies, modern mobile micro\-interactions, or spatial UI concepts.
* Originality: A proven readiness to actively pitch your own unique, original creative ideas while collaborating inside a structured enterprise framework.

From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

 At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture.
